/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fn_GetActuallyAvailableCopies]    Script Date: 21.05.2026 19:52:45 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetActuallyAvailableCopies](@BookID INT)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @ReservedCount INT;
    
    -- Считаем количество зарезервированных (но не выданных) книг
    SELECT @ReservedCount = ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0)
    FROM RequestItems ri
    INNER JOIN BookRequests br ON ri.RequestID = br.ID_Request
    WHERE ri.BookID = @BookID
      AND ri.StatusID IN (1, 2)  -- 1=Ожидает, 2=Зарезервирована
      AND br.StatusID NOT IN (4, 5, 6);  -- не Выдана, не Отменена, не Просрочена
    
    DECLARE @AvailableCopies INT;
    SELECT @AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies FROM Books WHERE IDBook = @BookID;
    
    -- Реально доступно = AvailableCopies - зарезервированные
    RETURN @AvailableCopies - ISNULL(@ReservedCount, 0);
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fn_CheckBooksAvailability]    Script Date: 21.05.2026 19:52:45 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_CheckBooksAvailability](
    @BookID INT,
    @RequestedQuantity INT,
    @ForDate DATE
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT 
        b.IDBook,
        b.TitleBook,
        b.TotalCopies,
        b.AvailableCopies,
        @RequestedQuantity AS RequestedQuantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.AvailableCopies >= @RequestedQuantity THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS IsAvailable,
        ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0) AS ReservedQuantity,
        b.AvailableCopies - ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0) AS ActuallyAvailable,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.AvailableCopies - ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0) >= @RequestedQuantity THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS CanReserve
    FROM [dbo].[Books] b
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[RequestItems] ri ON b.IDBook = ri.BookID 
        AND ri.StatusID = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована')
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[BookReservations] br ON ri.ID_RequestItem = br.RequestItemID 
        AND br.StatusID = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[ReservationStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Активна')
        AND br.ReservedForDate <= @ForDate
        AND br.ReservedUntil > @ForDate
    WHERE b.IDBook = @BookID
    GROUP BY b.IDBook, b.TitleBook, b.TotalCopies, b.AvailableCopies
)
GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_FundMovement]    Script Date: 21.05.2026 19:52:45 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_FundMovement] AS
-- Индивидуальные выдачи
SELECT 
    'individual' AS IssuanceType,
    i.IssuanceId AS Id,
    i.IssuanceDate,
    i.PlannedReturnDate,
    i.ReturnDate,
    i.Status,
    r.ReaderID AS RecipientId,
    CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', r.MiddleName) AS RecipientName,
    'Читатель' AS RecipientType,
    g.GroupCode AS GroupCode,
    '' AS TeacherName,
    '' AS StudentName,
    b.IDBook AS BookId,
    b.TitleBook AS BookTitle,
    b.InventaryNumber,
    1 AS Quantity,
    NULL AS ReturnedQuantity,
    (CASE WHEN i.ReturnDate IS NULL AND i.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IsOverdue,
    DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), i.PlannedReturnDate) AS DaysRemaining,
    i.Notes
FROM BookIssuance i
INNER JOIN ReaderForm r ON i.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
INNER JOIN Books b ON i.BookId = b.IDBook
LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID

UNION ALL

-- Групповые выдачи (детализированные по книгам)
SELECT 
    'group' AS IssuanceType,
    gi.GroupIssuanceId AS Id,
    gi.IssuanceDate,
    gi.PlannedReturnDate,
    gi.ReturnDate,
    gi.Status,
    g.GroupID AS RecipientId,
    g.GroupCode AS RecipientName,
    'Группа' AS RecipientType,
    g.GroupCode AS GroupCode,
    t.LastName + ' ' + t.FirstName AS TeacherName,
    s.LastName + ' ' + s.FirstName AS StudentName,
    b.IDBook AS BookId,
    b.TitleBook AS BookTitle,
    b.InventaryNumber,
    git.Quantity,
    git.ReturnedQuantity,
    (CASE WHEN gi.ReturnDate IS NULL AND gi.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IsOverdue,
    DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), gi.PlannedReturnDate) AS DaysRemaining,
    gi.Notes
FROM GroupBookIssuance gi
INNER JOIN Groups g ON gi.GroupId = g.GroupID
INNER JOIN ReaderForm t ON gi.TeacherId = t.ReaderID
INNER JOIN ReaderForm s ON gi.StudentId = s.ReaderID
INNER JOIN GroupIssuanceItems git ON gi.GroupIssuanceId = git.GroupIssuanceId
INNER JOIN Books b ON git.BookId = b.IDBook
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_UserInfo] AS
SELECT 
    u.ID_User,
    u.Surname,
    u.Name,
    u.Patronymic,
    u.Login,
    r.ReaderID,
    r.CardNumber,
    r.LastName,
    r.FirstName,
    r.MiddleName,
    r.TypeID,
    rt.TypeName,
    r.GroupID,
    g.GroupCode
FROM Users u
LEFT JOIN ReaderForm r ON u.ReaderID = r.ReaderID
LEFT JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ConfirmBookIssuance]
    @RequestID INT,
    @LibrarianID INT,
    @IssuanceType NVARCHAR(20)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @IssuedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Выдана')
    DECLARE @IssuedItemStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Выдана')
    DECLARE @FulfilledStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[ReservationStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Выполнена')
    DECLARE @ReadyNotificationTypeID INT = (SELECT ID_Type FROM [dbo].[NotificationTypes] WHERE TypeName = 'Готова к выдаче')
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает')
    DECLARE @ReservedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована')
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        DECLARE @UserID INT
        DECLARE @UserTypeID TINYINT
        DECLARE @GroupID INT
        DECLARE @LessonName NVARCHAR(200)
        DECLARE @PlannedReturnDate DATE
        
        SELECT 
            @UserID = UserID,
            @UserTypeID = UserTypeID,
            @GroupID = GroupID,
            @LessonName = LessonName
        FROM [dbo].[BookRequests]
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        SET @PlannedReturnDate = DATEADD(DAY, 30, GETDATE())
        
        IF @IssuanceType = 'group' AND @GroupID IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @GroupIssuanceId INT
            
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[GroupBookIssuance] (
                GroupId, TeacherId, SubjectName, IssuanceDate, 
                PlannedReturnDate, Status, Notes
            ) VALUES (
                @GroupID, @UserID, @LessonName, GETDATE(),
                @PlannedReturnDate, 'Выдана', 
                N'Создано по заявке №' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10))
            )
            
            SET @GroupIssuanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
            
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[GroupIssuanceItems] (GroupIssuanceId, BookId, Quantity, ReturnedQuantity)
            SELECT 
                @GroupIssuanceId,
                ri.BookID,
                ri.Quantity,
                0
            FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] ri
            WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID AND ri.StatusID IN (@PendingStatusID, @ReservedStatusID)
            
            UPDATE b
            SET b.CopiesInUse = b.CopiesInUse + ri.Quantity,
                b.AvailableCopies = b.TotalCopies - b.CopiesInUse
            FROM [dbo].[Books] b
            INNER JOIN [dbo].[RequestItems] ri ON b.IDBook = ri.BookID
            WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[BookIssuance] (BookId, ReaderId, IssuanceDate, PlannedReturnDate, Status, Notes)
            SELECT 
                ri.BookID,
                @UserID,
                GETDATE(),
                @PlannedReturnDate,
                'Выдана',
                N'Создано по заявке №' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10))
            FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] ri
            WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID AND ri.StatusID IN (@PendingStatusID, @ReservedStatusID)
        END
        
        UPDATE [dbo].[RequestItems]
        SET StatusID = @IssuedItemStatusID, IssuedQuantity = Quantity
        WHERE RequestID = @RequestID AND StatusID IN (@PendingStatusID, @ReservedStatusID)
        
        UPDATE [dbo].[BookRequests]
        SET StatusID = @IssuedStatusID, IssuedDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        UPDATE [dbo].[BookReservations]
        SET StatusID = @FulfilledStatusID
        WHERE RequestItemID IN (
            SELECT ID_RequestItem FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] WHERE RequestID = @RequestID
        )
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[RequestNotifications] (RequestID, NotificationTypeID, Message, IsRead)
        VALUES (@RequestID, @ReadyNotificationTypeID, 
            N'Книги по заявке №' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N' выданы', 0)
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        SELECT @RequestID AS IssuanceId
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_CreateBookRequest]    Script Date: 21.05.2026 19:52:46 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CreateBookRequest]
    @UserID INT,
    @UserTypeID TINYINT,
    @GroupID INT = NULL,
    @LessonName NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @LessonDate DATE,
    @LessonTime TIME = NULL,
    @BookItems NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @RequestNumber NVARCHAR(20) OUTPUT,
    @RequestID INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @NewStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Новая')
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает')
    DECLARE @NewNotificationTypeID INT = (SELECT ID_Type FROM [dbo].[NotificationTypes] WHERE TypeName = 'Новая заявка')
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Генерируем номер заявки (ЗАЯВ-20260422-0001)
        DECLARE @DatePart NVARCHAR(8) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112)
        DECLARE @Sequence INT
        
        SELECT @Sequence = ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(RequestNumber, 13, 4) AS INT)), 0) + 1
        FROM [dbo].[BookRequests]
        WHERE SUBSTRING(RequestNumber, 5, 8) = @DatePart
        
        SET @RequestNumber = 'ЗАЯВ-' + @DatePart + '-' + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(@Sequence AS NVARCHAR(4)), 4)
        
        -- Создаём заявку
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[BookRequests] (
            RequestNumber, UserID, UserTypeID, GroupID, LessonName, 
            LessonDate, LessonTime, StatusID, RequestDate, ExpirationDate
        ) VALUES (
            @RequestNumber, @UserID, @UserTypeID, @GroupID, @LessonName,
            @LessonDate, @LessonTime, @NewStatusID, GETDATE(), 
            DATEADD(DAY, 1, @LessonDate)
        )
        
        SET @RequestID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
        
        -- Парсим и добавляем элементы заявки
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[RequestItems] (RequestID, BookID, Quantity, StatusID)
        SELECT 
            @RequestID,
            CAST(LEFT(value, CHARINDEX(':', value) - 1) AS INT),
            CAST(RIGHT(value, LEN(value) - CHARINDEX(':', value)) AS INT),
            @PendingStatusID
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BookItems, ',')
        WHERE value != ''
        
        -- Создаём уведомление для библиотекаря
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[RequestNotifications] (RequestID, NotificationTypeID, Message, IsRead)
        VALUES (@RequestID, @NewNotificationTypeID, 
            N'Новая заявка №' + @RequestNumber + N' от пользователя ID ' + CAST(@UserID AS NVARCHAR(10)), 0)
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_CreateGroupIssuance]    Script Date: 21.05.2026 19:52:46 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CreateGroupIssuance]
    @GroupId INT,
    @TeacherId INT,
    @StudentId INT,
    @PlannedReturnDate DATETIME,
    @SubjectName NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @BookIds NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @GroupIssuanceId INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @StatusIssued INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Выдана%');
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Создаем запись о групповой выдаче
        INSERT INTO GroupBookIssuance (
            GroupId, TeacherId, StudentId, IssuanceDate, PlannedReturnDate, SubjectName, Notes, Status
        ) VALUES (
            @GroupId, @TeacherId, @StudentId, GETDATE(), @PlannedReturnDate, @SubjectName, @Notes, N'Выдана'
        );
        
        SET @GroupIssuanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        
        -- Парсим ID книг
        DECLARE @Books TABLE (BookId INT);
        INSERT INTO @Books (BookId)
        SELECT CAST(value AS INT)
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BookIds, ',')
        WHERE value != '' AND ISNUMERIC(value) = 1;
        
        -- Проверка: все ли книги имеют AvailableCopies >= 1
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM Books b
            INNER JOIN @Books t ON b.IDBook = t.BookId
            WHERE b.AvailableCopies < 1
        )
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('Недостаточно доступных экземпляров одной или нескольких книг!', 16, 1);
            RETURN;
        END
        
        -- Добавляем книги в выдачу
        INSERT INTO GroupIssuanceItems (GroupIssuanceId, BookId, Quantity, ReturnedQuantity)
        SELECT @GroupIssuanceId, BookId, 1, 0 FROM @Books;
        
        -- Обновляем счетчики книг (один раз, с правильной формулой)
        UPDATE b
        SET 
            b.CopiesInUse = b.CopiesInUse + 1,
            b.AvailableCopies = b.TotalCopies - (b.CopiesInUse + 1),
            b.StatusBook = CASE 
                WHEN b.TotalCopies - (b.CopiesInUse + 1) <= 0 THEN @StatusIssued
                ELSE b.StatusBook
            END
        FROM Books b
        INNER JOIN @Books t ON b.IDBook = t.BookId;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CreateGroupIssuanceWithBooks]
    @GroupId INT,
    @TeacherId INT,
    @StudentId INT,
    @PlannedReturnDate DATETIME,
    @SubjectName NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @BookIds NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @GroupIssuanceId INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        INSERT INTO GroupBookIssuance (
            GroupId, TeacherId, StudentId, SubjectName, PlannedReturnDate, Notes, Status
        ) VALUES (
            @GroupId, @TeacherId, @StudentId, @SubjectName, @PlannedReturnDate, @Notes, N'Выдана'
        );
        
        SET @GroupIssuanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        
        DECLARE @Books TABLE (BookId INT, RowNum INT IDENTITY(1,1));
        
        INSERT INTO @Books (BookId)
        SELECT CAST(value AS INT)
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BookIds, ',')
        WHERE value != '' AND ISNUMERIC(value) = 1;
        
        INSERT INTO GroupIssuanceItems (GroupIssuanceId, BookId, Quantity)
        SELECT @GroupIssuanceId, BookId, 1
        FROM @Books;
        
        UPDATE b
        SET b.CopiesInUse = b.CopiesInUse + 1,
            b.AvailableCopies = b.TotalCopies - b.CopiesInUse
        FROM Books b
        INNER JOIN @Books t ON b.IDBook = t.BookId;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        SELECT @GroupIssuanceId AS GroupIssuanceId;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CreateIndividualIssuance]
    @BookId INT,
    @ReaderId INT,
    @PlannedReturnDate DATETIME,
    @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @IssuanceId INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @AvailableCopies INT;
    DECLARE @StatusIssued INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Выдана%');
    DECLARE @StatusAvailable INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%В наличии%');
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Проверяем доступное количество
        SELECT @AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies 
        FROM Books 
        WHERE IDBook = @BookId;
        
        IF @AvailableCopies < 1
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('Недостаточно экземпляров книги для выдачи', 16, 1);
            RETURN;
        END
        
        -- Создаем запись о выдаче
        INSERT INTO BookIssuance (
            BookId, ReaderId, IssuanceDate, PlannedReturnDate, Notes, Status
        ) VALUES (
            @BookId, @ReaderId, GETDATE(), @PlannedReturnDate, @Notes, N'Выдана'
        );
        
        SET @IssuanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        
        -- Обновляем количество книг
        UPDATE Books 
        SET 
            CopiesInUse = CopiesInUse + 1,
            AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies - 1,
            StatusBook = @StatusIssued
        WHERE IDBook = @BookId;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ReserveBooks]
    @RequestID INT,
    @ReserveDays INT = 3
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @ProcessingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'В обработке')
    DECLARE @ReservedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована')
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает')
    DECLARE @ActiveStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[ReservationStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Активна')
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        DECLARE @RequestDate DATE
        DECLARE @ReservedUntil DATETIME
        DECLARE @UserID INT
        
        SELECT @RequestDate = LessonDate, @UserID = UserID
        FROM [dbo].[BookRequests] 
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        SET @ReservedUntil = DATEADD(DAY, @ReserveDays, @RequestDate)
        
        -- Резервируем книги
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[BookReservations] (RequestItemID, BookID, ReservedBy, ReservedForDate, ReservedUntil, StatusID)
        SELECT 
            ri.ID_RequestItem,
            ri.BookID,
            @UserID,
            @RequestDate,
            @ReservedUntil,
            @ActiveStatusID
        FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] ri
        WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID 
          AND ri.StatusID = @PendingStatusID
        
        -- Обновляем статус элементов заявки
        UPDATE [dbo].[RequestItems]
        SET StatusID = @ReservedStatusID, ReservedUntil = @ReservedUntil
        WHERE RequestID = @RequestID AND StatusID = @PendingStatusID
        
        -- Обновляем статус заявки
        UPDATE [dbo].[BookRequests]
        SET StatusID = @ProcessingStatusID, ProcessingDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS ReservedCount
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ReserveBooksAtomic]    Script Date: 21.05.2026 19:52:46 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ReserveBooksAtomic]
    @RequestID INT,
    @UserID INT,
    @ReserveDays INT = 3
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
    
    DECLARE @ProcessingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'В обработке');
    DECLARE @ReservedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestItemStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована');
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestItemStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает');
    DECLARE @ActiveStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM ReservationStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Активна');
    DECLARE @RequestDate DATE;
    
    SELECT @RequestDate = LessonDate FROM BookRequests WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID;
    DECLARE @ReservedUntil DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, @ReserveDays, @RequestDate);
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Временная таблица для книг, которые нужно зарезервировать
        DECLARE @BooksToReserve TABLE (
            BookTitle NVARCHAR(150),
            AuthorName NVARCHAR(300),
            Quantity INT,
            IDBook INT,
            IsReserved BIT DEFAULT 0
        );
        
        -- Получаем книги из заявки по названию и автору
        INSERT INTO @BooksToReserve (BookTitle, AuthorName, Quantity)
        SELECT DISTINCT
            b.TitleBook,
            ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
            ri.Quantity
        FROM RequestItems ri
        JOIN Books b ON ri.BookID = b.IDBook
        LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
        WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID AND ri.StatusID = @PendingStatusID;
        
        -- Проверяем и резервируем книги
        DECLARE @Title NVARCHAR(150), @Author NVARCHAR(300), @ReqQuantity INT, @ReservedCount INT;
        DECLARE @ErrorMsg NVARCHAR(500) = '';
        
        DECLARE book_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FORWARD_ONLY READ_ONLY FOR
            SELECT BookTitle, AuthorName, Quantity FROM @BooksToReserve;
        
        OPEN book_cursor;
        FETCH NEXT FROM book_cursor INTO @Title, @Author, @ReqQuantity;
        
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            -- Считаем доступные экземпляры по названию и автору
            SELECT @ReservedCount = COUNT(*) 
            FROM Books b
            LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
            WHERE b.TitleBook = @Title
              AND ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') = @Author
              AND b.StatusBook = 1;
            
            IF @ReservedCount < @ReqQuantity
            BEGIN
                SET @ErrorMsg = @ErrorMsg + 
                    @Title + ': нужно ' + CAST(@ReqQuantity AS NVARCHAR(10)) + 
                    ', доступно ' + CAST(@ReservedCount AS NVARCHAR(10)) + CHAR(13);
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- Резервируем нужное количество экземпляров
                UPDATE @BooksToReserve
                SET IsReserved = 1
                WHERE BookTitle = @Title;
                
                -- Обновляем статус выбранных книг
                UPDATE TOP (@ReqQuantity) b
                SET b.StatusBook = 3  -- Статус "Выдана" (временно зарезервирована)
                FROM Books b
                LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                WHERE b.TitleBook = @Title
                  AND ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') = @Author
                  AND b.StatusBook = 1;
            END
            
            FETCH NEXT FROM book_cursor INTO @Title, @Author, @ReqQuantity;
        END
        
        CLOSE book_cursor;
        DEALLOCATE book_cursor;
        
        IF @ErrorMsg != ''
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('Недостаточно экземпляров книг:%s', 16, 1, @ErrorMsg);
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            RETURN;
        END
        
        -- Обновляем статус элементов заявки
        UPDATE RequestItems 
        SET StatusID = @ReservedStatusID, ReservedUntil = @ReservedUntil
        WHERE RequestID = @RequestID AND StatusID = @PendingStatusID;
        
        -- Обновляем статус заявки
        UPDATE BookRequests 
        SET StatusID = @ProcessingStatusID, ProcessingDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        PRINT 'Резервирование успешно выполнено для заявки ' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10));
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        PRINT 'Ошибка: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ReturnBook]    Script Date: 21.05.2026 19:52:46 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ReturnBook]
    @IssuanceType NVARCHAR(20),
    @IssuanceId INT,
    @ReturnDate DATETIME = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @StatusAvailable INT = 1;
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        IF @ReturnDate IS NULL
            SET @ReturnDate = GETDATE();
        
        IF @IssuanceType = 'individual'
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @BookId INT;
            
            SELECT @BookId = BookId 
            FROM BookIssuance 
            WHERE IssuanceId = @IssuanceId;
            
            UPDATE BookIssuance 
            SET ReturnDate = @ReturnDate, 
                Status = N'Возвращена'
            WHERE IssuanceId = @IssuanceId;
            
            UPDATE Books 
            SET 
                CopiesInUse = CopiesInUse - 1,
                AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies + 1,
                StatusBook = @StatusAvailable
            WHERE IDBook = @BookId;
            
        END
        ELSE IF @IssuanceType = 'group'
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @BookIdForGroup INT, @Quantity INT, @ReturnedQuantity INT;
            DECLARE @RemainingToReturn INT;
            
            DECLARE book_cursor CURSOR FOR
            SELECT BookId, Quantity, ReturnedQuantity
            FROM GroupIssuanceItems 
            WHERE GroupIssuanceId = @IssuanceId;
            
            OPEN book_cursor;
            FETCH NEXT FROM book_cursor INTO @BookIdForGroup, @Quantity, @ReturnedQuantity;
            
            WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
                SET @RemainingToReturn = @Quantity - @ReturnedQuantity;
                
                IF @RemainingToReturn > 0
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE Books 
                    SET 
                        CopiesInUse = CopiesInUse - @RemainingToReturn,
                        AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies + @RemainingToReturn,
                        StatusBook = @StatusAvailable
                    WHERE IDBook = @BookIdForGroup;
                    
                    UPDATE GroupIssuanceItems 
                    SET ReturnedQuantity = @Quantity
                    WHERE GroupIssuanceId = @IssuanceId AND BookId = @BookIdForGroup;
                END
                
                FETCH NEXT FROM book_cursor INTO @BookIdForGroup, @Quantity, @ReturnedQuantity;
            END;
            
            CLOSE book_cursor;
            DEALLOCATE book_cursor;
            
            UPDATE GroupBookIssuance 
            SET ReturnDate = @ReturnDate, 
                Status = N'Возвращена'
            WHERE GroupIssuanceId = @IssuanceId;
        END
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            
        IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'book_cursor') >= 0
        BEGIN
            CLOSE book_cursor;
            DEALLOCATE book_cursor;
        END
        
        DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
        RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, 16, 1);
    END CATCH
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fn_GetActuallyAvailableCopies]    Script Date: 15.05.2026 18:00:44 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE  FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetActuallyAvailableCopies](@BookID INT)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @ReservedCount INT;
    
    -- Считаем количество зарезервированных (но не выданных) книг
    SELECT @ReservedCount = ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0)
    FROM RequestItems ri
    INNER JOIN BookRequests br ON ri.RequestID = br.ID_Request
    WHERE ri.BookID = @BookID
      AND ri.StatusID IN (1, 2)  -- 1=Ожидает, 2=Зарезервирована
      AND br.StatusID NOT IN (4, 5, 6);  -- не Выдана, не Отменена, не Просрочена
    
    DECLARE @AvailableCopies INT;
    SELECT @AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies FROM Books WHERE IDBook = @BookID;
    
    -- Реально доступно = AvailableCopies - зарезервированные
    RETURN @AvailableCopies - ISNULL(@ReservedCount, 0);
END

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fn_CheckBooksAvailability]    Script Date: 15.05.2026 18:00:44 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_CheckBooksAvailability](
    @BookID INT,
    @RequestedQuantity INT,
    @ForDate DATE
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT 
        b.IDBook,
        b.TitleBook,
        b.TotalCopies,
        b.AvailableCopies,
        @RequestedQuantity AS RequestedQuantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.AvailableCopies >= @RequestedQuantity THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS IsAvailable,
        ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0) AS ReservedQuantity,
        b.AvailableCopies - ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0) AS ActuallyAvailable,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.AvailableCopies - ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0) >= @RequestedQuantity THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS CanReserve
    FROM [dbo].[Books] b
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[RequestItems] ri ON b.IDBook = ri.BookID 
        AND ri.StatusID = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована')
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[BookReservations] br ON ri.ID_RequestItem = br.RequestItemID 
        AND br.StatusID = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[ReservationStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Активна')
        AND br.ReservedForDate <= @ForDate
        AND br.ReservedUntil > @ForDate
    WHERE b.IDBook = @BookID
    GROUP BY b.IDBook, b.TitleBook, b.TotalCopies, b.AvailableCopies
)
GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_FundMovement]    Script Date: 15.05.2026 18:00:44 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_FundMovement] AS
-- Индивидуальные выдачи
SELECT 
    'individual' AS IssuanceType,
    i.IssuanceId AS Id,
    i.IssuanceDate,
    i.PlannedReturnDate,
    i.ReturnDate,
    i.Status,
    r.ReaderID AS RecipientId,
    CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', r.MiddleName) AS RecipientName,
    'Читатель' AS RecipientType,
    g.GroupCode AS GroupCode,
    '' AS TeacherName,
    '' AS StudentName,
    b.IDBook AS BookId,
    b.TitleBook AS BookTitle,
    b.InventaryNumber,
    1 AS Quantity,
    NULL AS ReturnedQuantity,
    (CASE WHEN i.ReturnDate IS NULL AND i.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IsOverdue,
    DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), i.PlannedReturnDate) AS DaysRemaining,
    i.Notes
FROM BookIssuance i
INNER JOIN ReaderForm r ON i.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
INNER JOIN Books b ON i.BookId = b.IDBook
LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID

UNION ALL

-- Групповые выдачи (детализированные по книгам)
SELECT 
    'group' AS IssuanceType,
    gi.GroupIssuanceId AS Id,
    gi.IssuanceDate,
    gi.PlannedReturnDate,
    gi.ReturnDate,
    gi.Status,
    g.GroupID AS RecipientId,
    g.GroupCode AS RecipientName,
    'Группа' AS RecipientType,
    g.GroupCode AS GroupCode,
    t.LastName + ' ' + t.FirstName AS TeacherName,
    s.LastName + ' ' + s.FirstName AS StudentName,
    b.IDBook AS BookId,
    b.TitleBook AS BookTitle,
    b.InventaryNumber,
    git.Quantity,
    git.ReturnedQuantity,
    (CASE WHEN gi.ReturnDate IS NULL AND gi.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IsOverdue,
    DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), gi.PlannedReturnDate) AS DaysRemaining,
    gi.Notes
FROM GroupBookIssuance gi
INNER JOIN Groups g ON gi.GroupId = g.GroupID
INNER JOIN ReaderForm t ON gi.TeacherId = t.ReaderID
INNER JOIN ReaderForm s ON gi.StudentId = s.ReaderID
INNER JOIN GroupIssuanceItems git ON gi.GroupIssuanceId = git.GroupIssuanceId
INNER JOIN Books b ON git.BookId = b.IDBook
GO

	[Name] [nvarchar](50) NOT NULL,
	[Patronymic] [nvarchar](50) NULL,
	[Login] [nvarchar](30) NOT NULL,

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_UserInfo]    Script Date: 15.05.2026 18:00:44 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_UserInfo] AS
SELECT 
    u.ID_User,
    u.Surname,
    u.Name,
    u.Patronymic,
    u.Login,
    r.ReaderID,
    r.CardNumber,
    r.LastName,
    r.FirstName,
    r.MiddleName,
    r.TypeID,
    rt.TypeName,
    r.GroupID,
    g.GroupCode
FROM Users u
LEFT JOIN ReaderForm r ON u.ReaderID = r.ReaderID
LEFT JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ConfirmBookIssuance]
    @RequestID INT,
    @LibrarianID INT,
    @IssuanceType NVARCHAR(20)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @IssuedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Выдана')
    DECLARE @IssuedItemStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Выдана')
    DECLARE @FulfilledStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[ReservationStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Выполнена')
    DECLARE @ReadyNotificationTypeID INT = (SELECT ID_Type FROM [dbo].[NotificationTypes] WHERE TypeName = 'Готова к выдаче')
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает')
    DECLARE @ReservedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована')
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        DECLARE @UserID INT
        DECLARE @UserTypeID TINYINT
        DECLARE @GroupID INT
        DECLARE @LessonName NVARCHAR(200)
        DECLARE @PlannedReturnDate DATE
        
        SELECT 
            @UserID = UserID,
            @UserTypeID = UserTypeID,
            @GroupID = GroupID,
            @LessonName = LessonName
        FROM [dbo].[BookRequests]
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        SET @PlannedReturnDate = DATEADD(DAY, 30, GETDATE())
        
        IF @IssuanceType = 'group' AND @GroupID IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @GroupIssuanceId INT
            
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[GroupBookIssuance] (
                GroupId, TeacherId, SubjectName, IssuanceDate, 
                PlannedReturnDate, Status, Notes
            ) VALUES (
                @GroupID, @UserID, @LessonName, GETDATE(),
                @PlannedReturnDate, 'Выдана', 
                N'Создано по заявке №' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10))
            )
            
            SET @GroupIssuanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
            
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[GroupIssuanceItems] (GroupIssuanceId, BookId, Quantity, ReturnedQuantity)
            SELECT 
                @GroupIssuanceId,
                ri.BookID,
                ri.Quantity,
                0
            FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] ri
            WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID AND ri.StatusID IN (@PendingStatusID, @ReservedStatusID)
            
            UPDATE b
            SET b.CopiesInUse = b.CopiesInUse + ri.Quantity,
                b.AvailableCopies = b.TotalCopies - b.CopiesInUse
            FROM [dbo].[Books] b
            INNER JOIN [dbo].[RequestItems] ri ON b.IDBook = ri.BookID
            WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[BookIssuance] (BookId, ReaderId, IssuanceDate, PlannedReturnDate, Status, Notes)
            SELECT 
                ri.BookID,
                @UserID,
                GETDATE(),
                @PlannedReturnDate,
                'Выдана',
                N'Создано по заявке №' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10))
            FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] ri
            WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID AND ri.StatusID IN (@PendingStatusID, @ReservedStatusID)
        END
        
        UPDATE [dbo].[RequestItems]
        SET StatusID = @IssuedItemStatusID, IssuedQuantity = Quantity
        WHERE RequestID = @RequestID AND StatusID IN (@PendingStatusID, @ReservedStatusID)
        
        UPDATE [dbo].[BookRequests]
        SET StatusID = @IssuedStatusID, IssuedDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        UPDATE [dbo].[BookReservations]
        SET StatusID = @FulfilledStatusID
        WHERE RequestItemID IN (
            SELECT ID_RequestItem FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] WHERE RequestID = @RequestID
        )
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[RequestNotifications] (RequestID, NotificationTypeID, Message, IsRead)
        VALUES (@RequestID, @ReadyNotificationTypeID, 
            N'Книги по заявке №' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N' выданы', 0)
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        SELECT @RequestID AS IssuanceId
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CreateBookRequest]
    @UserID INT,
    @UserTypeID TINYINT,
    @GroupID INT = NULL,
    @LessonName NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @LessonDate DATE,
    @LessonTime TIME = NULL,
    @BookItems NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @RequestNumber NVARCHAR(20) OUTPUT,
    @RequestID INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @NewStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Новая')
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает')
    DECLARE @NewNotificationTypeID INT = (SELECT ID_Type FROM [dbo].[NotificationTypes] WHERE TypeName = 'Новая заявка')
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Генерируем номер заявки (ЗАЯВ-20260422-0001)
        DECLARE @DatePart NVARCHAR(8) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112)
        DECLARE @Sequence INT
        
        SELECT @Sequence = ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(RequestNumber, 13, 4) AS INT)), 0) + 1
        FROM [dbo].[BookRequests]
        WHERE SUBSTRING(RequestNumber, 5, 8) = @DatePart
        
        SET @RequestNumber = 'ЗАЯВ-' + @DatePart + '-' + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(@Sequence AS NVARCHAR(4)), 4)
        
        -- Создаём заявку
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[BookRequests] (
            RequestNumber, UserID, UserTypeID, GroupID, LessonName, 
            LessonDate, LessonTime, StatusID, RequestDate, ExpirationDate
        ) VALUES (
            @RequestNumber, @UserID, @UserTypeID, @GroupID, @LessonName,
            @LessonDate, @LessonTime, @NewStatusID, GETDATE(), 
            DATEADD(DAY, 1, @LessonDate)
        )
        
        SET @RequestID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
        
        -- Парсим и добавляем элементы заявки
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[RequestItems] (RequestID, BookID, Quantity, StatusID)
        SELECT 
            @RequestID,
            CAST(LEFT(value, CHARINDEX(':', value) - 1) AS INT),
            CAST(RIGHT(value, LEN(value) - CHARINDEX(':', value)) AS INT),
            @PendingStatusID
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BookItems, ',')
        WHERE value != ''
        
        -- Создаём уведомление для библиотекаря
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[RequestNotifications] (RequestID, NotificationTypeID, Message, IsRead)
        VALUES (@RequestID, @NewNotificationTypeID, 
            N'Новая заявка №' + @RequestNumber + N' от пользователя ID ' + CAST(@UserID AS NVARCHAR(10)), 0)
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CreateGroupIssuance]
    @GroupId INT,
    @TeacherId INT,
    @StudentId INT,
    @PlannedReturnDate DATETIME,
    @SubjectName NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @BookIds NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @GroupIssuanceId INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @StatusIssued INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Выдана%');
    DECLARE @StatusAvailable INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%В наличии%');
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Создаем запись о групповой выдаче
        INSERT INTO GroupBookIssuance (
            GroupId, TeacherId, StudentId, IssuanceDate, PlannedReturnDate, SubjectName, Notes, Status
        ) VALUES (
            @GroupId, @TeacherId, @StudentId, GETDATE(), @PlannedReturnDate, @SubjectName, @Notes, N'Выдана'
        );
        
        SET @GroupIssuanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        
        -- Парсим ID книг
        DECLARE @Books TABLE (BookId INT, RowNum INT IDENTITY(1,1));
        
        INSERT INTO @Books (BookId)
        SELECT CAST(value AS INT)
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BookIds, ',')
        WHERE value != '' AND ISNUMERIC(value) = 1;
        
        -- Добавляем книги в выдачу
        INSERT INTO GroupIssuanceItems (GroupIssuanceId, BookId, Quantity, ReturnedQuantity)
        SELECT @GroupIssuanceId, BookId, 1, 0
        FROM @Books;
        
        -- Обновляем количество книг
        UPDATE b
        SET 
            b.CopiesInUse = b.CopiesInUse + 1,
            b.AvailableCopies = b.TotalCopies - b.CopiesInUse,
            b.StatusBook = @StatusIssued
        FROM Books b
        INNER JOIN @Books t ON b.IDBook = t.BookId;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CreateIndividualIssuance]
    @BookId INT,
    @ReaderId INT,
    @PlannedReturnDate DATETIME,
    @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @IssuanceId INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @AvailableCopies INT;
    DECLARE @StatusIssued INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Выдана%');
    DECLARE @StatusAvailable INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%В наличии%');
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Проверяем доступное количество
        SELECT @AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies 
        FROM Books 
        WHERE IDBook = @BookId;
        
        IF @AvailableCopies < 1
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('Недостаточно экземпляров книги для выдачи', 16, 1);
            RETURN;
        END
        
        -- Создаем запись о выдаче
        INSERT INTO BookIssuance (
            BookId, ReaderId, IssuanceDate, PlannedReturnDate, Notes, Status
        ) VALUES (
            @BookId, @ReaderId, GETDATE(), @PlannedReturnDate, @Notes, N'Выдана'
        );
        
        SET @IssuanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        
        -- Обновляем количество книг
        UPDATE Books 
        SET 
            CopiesInUse = CopiesInUse + 1,
            AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies - 1,
            StatusBook = @StatusIssued
        WHERE IDBook = @BookId;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ReserveBooks]
    @RequestID INT,
    @ReserveDays INT = 3
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @ProcessingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'В обработке')
    DECLARE @ReservedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована')
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает')
    DECLARE @ActiveStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[ReservationStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Активна')
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        DECLARE @RequestDate DATE
        DECLARE @ReservedUntil DATETIME
        DECLARE @UserID INT
        
        SELECT @RequestDate = LessonDate, @UserID = UserID
        FROM [dbo].[BookRequests] 
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        SET @ReservedUntil = DATEADD(DAY, @ReserveDays, @RequestDate)
        
        -- Резервируем книги
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[BookReservations] (RequestItemID, BookID, ReservedBy, ReservedForDate, ReservedUntil, StatusID)
        SELECT 
            ri.ID_RequestItem,
            ri.BookID,
            @UserID,
            @RequestDate,
            @ReservedUntil,
            @ActiveStatusID
        FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] ri
        WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID 
          AND ri.StatusID = @PendingStatusID
        
        -- Обновляем статус элементов заявки
        UPDATE [dbo].[RequestItems]
        SET StatusID = @ReservedStatusID, ReservedUntil = @ReservedUntil
        WHERE RequestID = @RequestID AND StatusID = @PendingStatusID
        
        -- Обновляем статус заявки
        UPDATE [dbo].[BookRequests]
        SET StatusID = @ProcessingStatusID, ProcessingDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS ReservedCount
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ReserveBooksAtomic]    Script Date: 15.05.2026 18:00:44 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE   PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ReserveBooksAtomic]
    @RequestID INT,
    @UserID INT,
    @ReserveDays INT = 3
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
    
    DECLARE @ProcessingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'В обработке');
    DECLARE @ReservedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestItemStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована');
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestItemStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает');
    DECLARE @ActiveStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM ReservationStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Активна');
    DECLARE @RequestDate DATE;
    
    SELECT @RequestDate = LessonDate FROM BookRequests WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID;
    DECLARE @ReservedUntil DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, @ReserveDays, @RequestDate);
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Временная таблица для книг, которые нужно зарезервировать
        DECLARE @BooksToReserve TABLE (
            BookTitle NVARCHAR(150),
            AuthorName NVARCHAR(300),
            Quantity INT,
            IDBook INT,
            IsReserved BIT DEFAULT 0
        );
        
        -- Получаем книги из заявки по названию и автору
        INSERT INTO @BooksToReserve (BookTitle, AuthorName, Quantity)
        SELECT DISTINCT
            b.TitleBook,
            ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
            ri.Quantity
        FROM RequestItems ri
        JOIN Books b ON ri.BookID = b.IDBook
        LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
        WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID AND ri.StatusID = @PendingStatusID;
        
        -- Проверяем и резервируем книги
        DECLARE @Title NVARCHAR(150), @Author NVARCHAR(300), @ReqQuantity INT, @ReservedCount INT;
        DECLARE @ErrorMsg NVARCHAR(500) = '';
        
        DECLARE book_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FORWARD_ONLY READ_ONLY FOR
            SELECT BookTitle, AuthorName, Quantity FROM @BooksToReserve;
        
        OPEN book_cursor;
        FETCH NEXT FROM book_cursor INTO @Title, @Author, @ReqQuantity;
        
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            -- Считаем доступные экземпляры по названию и автору
            SELECT @ReservedCount = COUNT(*) 
            FROM Books b
            LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
            WHERE b.TitleBook = @Title
              AND ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') = @Author
              AND b.StatusBook = 1;
            
            IF @ReservedCount < @ReqQuantity
            BEGIN
                SET @ErrorMsg = @ErrorMsg + 
                    @Title + ': нужно ' + CAST(@ReqQuantity AS NVARCHAR(10)) + 
                    ', доступно ' + CAST(@ReservedCount AS NVARCHAR(10)) + CHAR(13);
            END
            ELSE
            BEGIN
                -- Резервируем нужное количество экземпляров
                UPDATE @BooksToReserve
                SET IsReserved = 1
                WHERE BookTitle = @Title;
                
                -- Обновляем статус выбранных книг
                UPDATE TOP (@ReqQuantity) b
                SET b.StatusBook = 3  -- Статус "Выдана" (временно зарезервирована)
                FROM Books b
                LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                WHERE b.TitleBook = @Title
                  AND ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') = @Author
                  AND b.StatusBook = 1;
            END
            
            FETCH NEXT FROM book_cursor INTO @Title, @Author, @ReqQuantity;
        END
        
        CLOSE book_cursor;
        DEALLOCATE book_cursor;
        
        IF @ErrorMsg != ''
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('Недостаточно экземпляров книг:%s', 16, 1, @ErrorMsg);
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            RETURN;
        END
        
        -- Обновляем статус элементов заявки
        UPDATE RequestItems 
        SET StatusID = @ReservedStatusID, ReservedUntil = @ReservedUntil
        WHERE RequestID = @RequestID AND StatusID = @PendingStatusID;
        
        -- Обновляем статус заявки
        UPDATE BookRequests 
        SET StatusID = @ProcessingStatusID, ProcessingDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        PRINT 'Резервирование успешно выполнено для заявки ' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10));
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        PRINT 'Ошибка: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ReturnBook]    Script Date: 15.05.2026 18:00:44 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ReturnBook]
    @IssuanceType NVARCHAR(20),
    @IssuanceId INT,
    @ReturnDate DATETIME = NULL
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @StatusAvailable INT = 1;
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        IF @ReturnDate IS NULL
            SET @ReturnDate = GETDATE();
        
        IF @IssuanceType = 'individual'
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @BookId INT;
            
            SELECT @BookId = BookId 
            FROM BookIssuance 
            WHERE IssuanceId = @IssuanceId;
            
            UPDATE BookIssuance 
            SET ReturnDate = @ReturnDate, 
                Status = N'Возвращена'
            WHERE IssuanceId = @IssuanceId;
            
            UPDATE Books 
            SET 
                CopiesInUse = CopiesInUse - 1,
                AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies + 1,
                StatusBook = @StatusAvailable
            WHERE IDBook = @BookId;
            
        END
        ELSE IF @IssuanceType = 'group'
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @BookIdForGroup INT, @Quantity INT, @ReturnedQuantity INT;
            DECLARE @RemainingToReturn INT;
            
            DECLARE book_cursor CURSOR FOR
            SELECT BookId, Quantity, ReturnedQuantity
            FROM GroupIssuanceItems 
            WHERE GroupIssuanceId = @IssuanceId;
            
            OPEN book_cursor;
            FETCH NEXT FROM book_cursor INTO @BookIdForGroup, @Quantity, @ReturnedQuantity;
            
            WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
                SET @RemainingToReturn = @Quantity - @ReturnedQuantity;
                
                IF @RemainingToReturn > 0
                BEGIN
                    UPDATE Books 
                    SET 
                        CopiesInUse = CopiesInUse - @RemainingToReturn,
                        AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies + @RemainingToReturn,
                        StatusBook = @StatusAvailable
                    WHERE IDBook = @BookIdForGroup;
                    
                    UPDATE GroupIssuanceItems 
                    SET ReturnedQuantity = @Quantity
                    WHERE GroupIssuanceId = @IssuanceId AND BookId = @BookIdForGroup;
                END
                
                FETCH NEXT FROM book_cursor INTO @BookIdForGroup, @Quantity, @ReturnedQuantity;
            END;
            
            CLOSE book_cursor;
            DEALLOCATE book_cursor;
            
            UPDATE GroupBookIssuance 
            SET ReturnDate = @ReturnDate, 
                Status = N'Возвращена'
            WHERE GroupIssuanceId = @IssuanceId;
        END
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            
        IF CURSOR_STATUS('local', 'book_cursor') >= 0
        BEGIN
            CLOSE book_cursor;
            DEALLOCATE book_cursor;
        END
        
        DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
        RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, 16, 1);
    END CATCH
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fn_GetActuallyAvailableCopies]    Script Date: 22.05.2026 11:53:45 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetActuallyAvailableCopies](@BookID INT)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @AvailableCopies INT;
    
    -- Доступно = количество книг со статусом "В наличии"
    SELECT @AvailableCopies = COUNT(*)
    FROM Books 
    WHERE IDBook = @BookID AND StatusBook = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE N'%В наличии%');
    
    RETURN ISNULL(@AvailableCopies, 0);
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fn_GetActuallyAvailableForIssue]    Script Date: 22.05.2026 11:53:45 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
create FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetActuallyAvailableForIssue](@BookID INT)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @IssuedCount INT;
    DECLARE @TotalCopies INT;
    
    -- Считаем количество выданных книг
    SELECT @IssuedCount = ISNULL(SUM(CopiesInUse), 0)
    FROM Books
    WHERE IDBook = @BookID;
    
    -- Получаем общее количество
    SELECT @TotalCopies = TotalCopies
    FROM Books
    WHERE IDBook = @BookID;
    
    -- Доступно для выдачи = Всего - Выдано (резервы НЕ вычитаем!)
    RETURN @TotalCopies - @IssuedCount;
END
GO
/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fn_GetActuallyAvailableForRequest]    Script Date: 22.05.2026 11:53:45 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_GetActuallyAvailableForRequest](@BookID INT)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @ReservedCount INT;
    DECLARE @IssuedCount INT;
    DECLARE @TotalCopies INT;
    
    -- Считаем только ПОДТВЕРЖДЁННЫЕ (зарезервированные) книги, не "Ожидает"
    SELECT @ReservedCount = ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0)
    FROM RequestItems ri
    INNER JOIN BookRequests br ON ri.RequestID = br.ID_Request
    WHERE ri.BookID = @BookID
      AND ri.StatusID = 2  -- ТОЛЬКО 2=Зарезервирована (убрали 1=Ожидает)
      AND br.StatusID NOT IN (4, 5, 6);  -- не Выдана, не Отменена, не Просрочена
    
    -- Считаем количество выданных книг
    SELECT @IssuedCount = ISNULL(SUM(CopiesInUse), 0)
    FROM Books
    WHERE IDBook = @BookID;
    
    -- Получаем общее количество
    SELECT @TotalCopies = TotalCopies
    FROM Books
    WHERE IDBook = @BookID;
    
    -- Доступно для заявки = Всего - Выдано - Зарезервировано (подтверждённые)
    RETURN @TotalCopies - @IssuedCount - ISNULL(@ReservedCount, 0);
END
GO

/****** Object:  UserDefinedFunction [dbo].[fn_CheckBooksAvailability]    Script Date: 22.05.2026 11:53:45 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fn_CheckBooksAvailability](
    @BookID INT,
    @RequestedQuantity INT,
    @ForDate DATE
)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN
(
    SELECT 
        b.IDBook,
        b.TitleBook,
        b.TotalCopies,
        b.AvailableCopies,
        @RequestedQuantity AS RequestedQuantity,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.AvailableCopies >= @RequestedQuantity THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS IsAvailable,
        ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0) AS ReservedQuantity,
        b.AvailableCopies - ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0) AS ActuallyAvailable,
        CASE 
            WHEN b.AvailableCopies - ISNULL(SUM(ri.Quantity), 0) >= @RequestedQuantity THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS CanReserve
    FROM [dbo].[Books] b
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[RequestItems] ri ON b.IDBook = ri.BookID 
        AND ri.StatusID = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована')
    LEFT JOIN [dbo].[BookReservations] br ON ri.ID_RequestItem = br.RequestItemID 
        AND br.StatusID = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[ReservationStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Активна')
        AND br.ReservedForDate <= @ForDate
        AND br.ReservedUntil > @ForDate
    WHERE b.IDBook = @BookID
    GROUP BY b.IDBook, b.TitleBook, b.TotalCopies, b.AvailableCopies
)
GO

/****** Object:  View [dbo].[vw_FundMovement]    Script Date: 22.05.2026 11:53:45 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[vw_FundMovement] AS
-- Индивидуальные выдачи
SELECT 
    'individual' AS IssuanceType,
    i.IssuanceId AS Id,
    i.IssuanceDate,
    i.PlannedReturnDate,
    i.ReturnDate,
    i.Status,
    r.ReaderID AS RecipientId,
    CONCAT(r.LastName, ' ', r.FirstName, ' ', r.MiddleName) AS RecipientName,
    'Читатель' AS RecipientType,
    g.GroupCode AS GroupCode,
    '' AS TeacherName,
    '' AS StudentName,
    b.IDBook AS BookId,
    b.TitleBook AS BookTitle,
    b.InventaryNumber,
    1 AS Quantity,
    NULL AS ReturnedQuantity,
    (CASE WHEN i.ReturnDate IS NULL AND i.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IsOverdue,
    DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), i.PlannedReturnDate) AS DaysRemaining,
    i.Notes
FROM BookIssuance i
INNER JOIN ReaderForm r ON i.ReaderId = r.ReaderID
INNER JOIN Books b ON i.BookId = b.IDBook
LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID

UNION ALL

-- Групповые выдачи (детализированные по книгам)
SELECT 
    'group' AS IssuanceType,
    gi.GroupIssuanceId AS Id,
    gi.IssuanceDate,
    gi.PlannedReturnDate,
    gi.ReturnDate,
    gi.Status,
    g.GroupID AS RecipientId,
    g.GroupCode AS RecipientName,
    'Группа' AS RecipientType,
    g.GroupCode AS GroupCode,
    t.LastName + ' ' + t.FirstName AS TeacherName,
    s.LastName + ' ' + s.FirstName AS StudentName,
    b.IDBook AS BookId,
    b.TitleBook AS BookTitle,
    b.InventaryNumber,
    git.Quantity,
    git.ReturnedQuantity,
    (CASE WHEN gi.ReturnDate IS NULL AND gi.PlannedReturnDate < GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IsOverdue,
    DATEDIFF(day, GETDATE(), gi.PlannedReturnDate) AS DaysRemaining,
    gi.Notes
FROM GroupBookIssuance gi
INNER JOIN Groups g ON gi.GroupId = g.GroupID
INNER JOIN ReaderForm t ON gi.TeacherId = t.ReaderID
INNER JOIN ReaderForm s ON gi.StudentId = s.ReaderID
INNER JOIN GroupIssuanceItems git ON gi.GroupIssuanceId = git.GroupIssuanceId
INNER JOIN Books b ON git.BookId = b.IDBook
GO

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ConfirmBookIssuance]    Script Date: 22.05.2026 11:53:46 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ConfirmBookIssuance]
    @RequestID INT,
    @LibrarianID INT,
    @IssuanceType NVARCHAR(20)
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @IssuedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Выдана')
    DECLARE @IssuedItemStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Выдана')
    DECLARE @FulfilledStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[ReservationStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Выполнена')
    DECLARE @ReadyNotificationTypeID INT = (SELECT ID_Type FROM [dbo].[NotificationTypes] WHERE TypeName = 'Готова к выдаче')
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает')
    DECLARE @ReservedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована')
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        DECLARE @UserID INT
        DECLARE @UserTypeID TINYINT
        DECLARE @GroupID INT
        DECLARE @LessonName NVARCHAR(200)
        DECLARE @PlannedReturnDate DATE
        
        SELECT 
            @UserID = UserID,
            @UserTypeID = UserTypeID,
            @GroupID = GroupID,
            @LessonName = LessonName
        FROM [dbo].[BookRequests]
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        SET @PlannedReturnDate = DATEADD(DAY, 30, GETDATE())
        
        IF @IssuanceType = 'group' AND @GroupID IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            DECLARE @GroupIssuanceId INT
            
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[GroupBookIssuance] (
                GroupId, TeacherId, SubjectName, IssuanceDate, 
                PlannedReturnDate, Status, Notes
            ) VALUES (
                @GroupID, @UserID, @LessonName, GETDATE(),
                @PlannedReturnDate, 'Выдана', 
                N'Создано по заявке №' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10))
            )
            
            SET @GroupIssuanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
            
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[GroupIssuanceItems] (GroupIssuanceId, BookId, Quantity, ReturnedQuantity)
            SELECT 
                @GroupIssuanceId,
                ri.BookID,
                ri.Quantity,
                0
            FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] ri
            WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID AND ri.StatusID IN (@PendingStatusID, @ReservedStatusID)
            
            UPDATE b
            SET b.CopiesInUse = b.CopiesInUse + ri.Quantity,
                b.AvailableCopies = b.TotalCopies - b.CopiesInUse
            FROM [dbo].[Books] b
            INNER JOIN [dbo].[RequestItems] ri ON b.IDBook = ri.BookID
            WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID
        END
        ELSE
        BEGIN
            INSERT INTO [dbo].[BookIssuance] (BookId, ReaderId, IssuanceDate, PlannedReturnDate, Status, Notes)
            SELECT 
                ri.BookID,
                @UserID,
                GETDATE(),
                @PlannedReturnDate,
                'Выдана',
                N'Создано по заявке №' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10))
            FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] ri
            WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID AND ri.StatusID IN (@PendingStatusID, @ReservedStatusID)
        END
        
        UPDATE [dbo].[RequestItems]
        SET StatusID = @IssuedItemStatusID, IssuedQuantity = Quantity
        WHERE RequestID = @RequestID AND StatusID IN (@PendingStatusID, @ReservedStatusID)
        
        UPDATE [dbo].[BookRequests]
        SET StatusID = @IssuedStatusID, IssuedDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        UPDATE [dbo].[BookReservations]
        SET StatusID = @FulfilledStatusID
        WHERE RequestItemID IN (
            SELECT ID_RequestItem FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] WHERE RequestID = @RequestID
        )
        
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[RequestNotifications] (RequestID, NotificationTypeID, Message, IsRead)
        VALUES (@RequestID, @ReadyNotificationTypeID, 
            N'Книги по заявке №' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10)) + N' выданы', 0)
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        SELECT @RequestID AS IssuanceId
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CreateBookRequest]
    @UserID INT,
    @UserTypeID TINYINT,
    @GroupID INT = NULL,
    @LessonName NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @LessonDate DATE,
    @LessonTime TIME = NULL,
    @BookItems NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @RequestNumber NVARCHAR(20) OUTPUT,
    @RequestID INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @NewStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Новая')
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает')
    DECLARE @NewNotificationTypeID INT = (SELECT ID_Type FROM [dbo].[NotificationTypes] WHERE TypeName = 'Новая заявка')
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Генерируем номер заявки (ЗАЯВ-20260422-0001)
        DECLARE @DatePart NVARCHAR(8) = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112)
        DECLARE @Sequence INT
        
        SELECT @Sequence = ISNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(RequestNumber, 13, 4) AS INT)), 0) + 1
        FROM [dbo].[BookRequests]
        WHERE SUBSTRING(RequestNumber, 5, 8) = @DatePart
        
        SET @RequestNumber = 'ЗАЯВ-' + @DatePart + '-' + RIGHT('0000' + CAST(@Sequence AS NVARCHAR(4)), 4)
        
        -- Создаём заявку
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[BookRequests] (
            RequestNumber, UserID, UserTypeID, GroupID, LessonName, 
            LessonDate, LessonTime, StatusID, RequestDate, ExpirationDate
        ) VALUES (
            @RequestNumber, @UserID, @UserTypeID, @GroupID, @LessonName,
            @LessonDate, @LessonTime, @NewStatusID, GETDATE(), 
            DATEADD(DAY, 1, @LessonDate)
        )
        
        SET @RequestID = SCOPE_IDENTITY()
        
        -- Парсим и добавляем элементы заявки
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[RequestItems] (RequestID, BookID, Quantity, StatusID)
        SELECT 
            @RequestID,
            CAST(LEFT(value, CHARINDEX(':', value) - 1) AS INT),
            CAST(RIGHT(value, LEN(value) - CHARINDEX(':', value)) AS INT),
            @PendingStatusID
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BookItems, ',')
        WHERE value != ''
        
        -- Создаём уведомление для библиотекаря
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[RequestNotifications] (RequestID, NotificationTypeID, Message, IsRead)
        VALUES (@RequestID, @NewNotificationTypeID, 
            N'Новая заявка №' + @RequestNumber + N' от пользователя ID ' + CAST(@UserID AS NVARCHAR(10)), 0)
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CreateGroupIssuance]
    @GroupId INT,
    @TeacherId INT,
    @StudentId INT,
    @PlannedReturnDate DATETIME,
    @SubjectName NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @BookIds NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @GroupIssuanceId INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @StatusIssued INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Выдана%');
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Создаем запись о групповой выдаче
        INSERT INTO GroupBookIssuance (
            GroupId, TeacherId, StudentId, IssuanceDate, PlannedReturnDate, SubjectName, Notes, Status
        ) VALUES (
            @GroupId, @TeacherId, @StudentId, GETDATE(), @PlannedReturnDate, @SubjectName, @Notes, N'Выдана'
        );
        
        SET @GroupIssuanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        
        -- Парсим ID книг
        DECLARE @Books TABLE (BookId INT);
        INSERT INTO @Books (BookId)
        SELECT CAST(value AS INT)
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BookIds, ',')
        WHERE value != '' AND ISNUMERIC(value) = 1;
        
        -- Проверка: все ли книги имеют AvailableCopies >= 1
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM Books b
            INNER JOIN @Books t ON b.IDBook = t.BookId
            WHERE b.AvailableCopies < 1
        )
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('Недостаточно доступных экземпляров одной или нескольких книг!', 16, 1);
            RETURN;
        END
        
        -- Добавляем книги в выдачу
        INSERT INTO GroupIssuanceItems (GroupIssuanceId, BookId, Quantity, ReturnedQuantity)
        SELECT @GroupIssuanceId, BookId, 1, 0 FROM @Books;
        
        -- Обновляем счетчики книг (один раз, с правильной формулой)
        UPDATE b
        SET 
            b.CopiesInUse = b.CopiesInUse + 1,
            b.AvailableCopies = b.TotalCopies - (b.CopiesInUse + 1),
            b.StatusBook = CASE 
                WHEN b.TotalCopies - (b.CopiesInUse + 1) <= 0 THEN @StatusIssued
                ELSE b.StatusBook
            END
        FROM Books b
        INNER JOIN @Books t ON b.IDBook = t.BookId;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CreateGroupIssuanceWithBooks]
    @GroupId INT,
    @TeacherId INT,
    @StudentId INT,
    @PlannedReturnDate DATETIME,
    @SubjectName NVARCHAR(200) = NULL,
    @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @BookIds NVARCHAR(MAX),
    @GroupIssuanceId INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        INSERT INTO GroupBookIssuance (
            GroupId, TeacherId, StudentId, SubjectName, PlannedReturnDate, Notes, Status
        ) VALUES (
            @GroupId, @TeacherId, @StudentId, @SubjectName, @PlannedReturnDate, @Notes, N'Выдана'
        );
        
        SET @GroupIssuanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        
        DECLARE @Books TABLE (BookId INT, RowNum INT IDENTITY(1,1));
        
        INSERT INTO @Books (BookId)
        SELECT CAST(value AS INT)
        FROM STRING_SPLIT(@BookIds, ',')
        WHERE value != '' AND ISNUMERIC(value) = 1;
        
        INSERT INTO GroupIssuanceItems (GroupIssuanceId, BookId, Quantity)
        SELECT @GroupIssuanceId, BookId, 1
        FROM @Books;
        
        UPDATE b
        SET b.CopiesInUse = b.CopiesInUse + 1,
            b.AvailableCopies = b.TotalCopies - b.CopiesInUse
        FROM Books b
        INNER JOIN @Books t ON b.IDBook = t.BookId;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        SELECT @GroupIssuanceId AS GroupIssuanceId;
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_CreateIndividualIssuance]
    @BookId INT,
    @ReaderId INT,
    @PlannedReturnDate DATETIME,
    @Notes NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,
    @IssuanceId INT OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @StatusIssued INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE N'%Выдана%');
    DECLARE @StatusAvailable INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE N'%В наличии%');
    DECLARE @StatusReserved INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE N'%Зарезервирована%');
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Проверяем статус книги (должна быть "В наличии" или "Зарезервирована")
        DECLARE @CurrentStatus INT;
        SELECT @CurrentStatus = StatusBook FROM Books WHERE IDBook = @BookId;
        
        IF @CurrentStatus NOT IN (@StatusAvailable, @StatusReserved)
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('Книга не может быть выдана (статус: %d)', 16, 1, @CurrentStatus);
            RETURN;
        END
        
        -- Создаем запись о выдаче
        INSERT INTO BookIssuance (
            BookId, ReaderId, IssuanceDate, PlannedReturnDate, Notes, Status
        ) VALUES (
            @BookId, @ReaderId, GETDATE(), @PlannedReturnDate, @Notes, N'Выдана'
        );
        
        SET @IssuanceId = SCOPE_IDENTITY();
        
        -- Меняем статус книги на "Выдана"
        UPDATE Books 
        SET 
            CopiesInUse = CopiesInUse + 1,
            AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies - 1,
            StatusBook = @StatusIssued
        WHERE IDBook = @BookId;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ReserveBooks]
    @RequestID INT,
    @ReserveDays INT = 3
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
    DECLARE @ProcessingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'В обработке')
    DECLARE @ReservedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована')
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[RequestItemStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает')
    DECLARE @ActiveStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM [dbo].[ReservationStatuses] WHERE StatusName = 'Активна')
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        DECLARE @RequestDate DATE
        DECLARE @ReservedUntil DATETIME
        DECLARE @UserID INT
        
        SELECT @RequestDate = LessonDate, @UserID = UserID
        FROM [dbo].[BookRequests] 
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        SET @ReservedUntil = DATEADD(DAY, @ReserveDays, @RequestDate)
        
        -- Резервируем книги
        INSERT INTO [dbo].[BookReservations] (RequestItemID, BookID, ReservedBy, ReservedForDate, ReservedUntil, StatusID)
        SELECT 
            ri.ID_RequestItem,
            ri.BookID,
            @UserID,
            @RequestDate,
            @ReservedUntil,
            @ActiveStatusID
        FROM [dbo].[RequestItems] ri
        WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID 
          AND ri.StatusID = @PendingStatusID
        
        -- Обновляем статус элементов заявки
        UPDATE [dbo].[RequestItems]
        SET StatusID = @ReservedStatusID, ReservedUntil = @ReservedUntil
        WHERE RequestID = @RequestID AND StatusID = @PendingStatusID
        
        -- Обновляем статус заявки
        UPDATE [dbo].[BookRequests]
        SET StatusID = @ProcessingStatusID, ProcessingDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS ReservedCount
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ReserveBooksAtomic]    Script Date: 22.05.2026 11:53:46 ******/

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[sp_ReserveBooksAtomic]
    @RequestID INT,
    @UserID INT,
    @ReserveDays INT = 3
AS
BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;
    SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;
    
    DECLARE @ProcessingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'В обработке');
    DECLARE @ReservedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestItemStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Зарезервирована');
    DECLARE @PendingStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestItemStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает');
    DECLARE @BookReservedStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE N'%Зарезервирована%');
    DECLARE @BookAvailableStatusID INT = (SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE N'%В наличии%');
    DECLARE @RequestDate DATE;
    
    SELECT @RequestDate = LessonDate FROM BookRequests WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID;
    DECLARE @ReservedUntil DATETIME = DATEADD(DAY, @ReserveDays, @RequestDate);
    
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRANSACTION;
        
        -- Проверяем доступность книг (только статус "В наличии")
        DECLARE @BookID INT, @ReqQuantity INT, @Available INT;
        DECLARE @ErrorMsg NVARCHAR(500) = '';
        
        DECLARE book_cursor CURSOR LOCAL FORWARD_ONLY READ_ONLY FOR
            SELECT BookID, Quantity FROM RequestItems WHERE RequestID = @RequestID AND StatusID = @PendingStatusID;
        
        OPEN book_cursor;
        FETCH NEXT FROM book_cursor INTO @BookID, @ReqQuantity;
        
        WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            -- Проверяем количество книг со статусом "В наличии"
            SELECT @Available = COUNT(*) 
            FROM Books 
            WHERE IDBook = @BookID AND StatusBook = @BookAvailableStatusID;
            
            IF @Available < @ReqQuantity
            BEGIN
                SET @ErrorMsg = @ErrorMsg + 'Недостаточно экземпляров для книги ID=' + CAST(@BookID AS NVARCHAR(10)) + CHAR(13);
            END
            
            FETCH NEXT FROM book_cursor INTO @BookID, @ReqQuantity;
        END
        
        CLOSE book_cursor;
        DEALLOCATE book_cursor;
        
        IF @ErrorMsg != ''
        BEGIN
            RAISERROR('%s', 16, 1, @ErrorMsg);
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
            RETURN;
        END
        
        -- МЕНЯЕМ СТАТУС КНИГ С "В НАЛИЧИИ" НА "ЗАРЕЗЕРВИРОВАНА"
        UPDATE b
        SET b.StatusBook = @BookReservedStatusID
        FROM Books b
        INNER JOIN RequestItems ri ON b.IDBook = ri.BookID
        WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestID 
          AND ri.StatusID = @PendingStatusID
          AND b.StatusBook = @BookAvailableStatusID;
        
        -- Обновляем статус элементов заявки
        UPDATE RequestItems 
        SET StatusID = @ReservedStatusID, ReservedUntil = @ReservedUntil
        WHERE RequestID = @RequestID AND StatusID = @PendingStatusID;
        
        -- Обновляем статус заявки
        UPDATE BookRequests 
        SET StatusID = @ProcessingStatusID, ProcessingDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE ID_Request = @RequestID;
        
        COMMIT TRANSACTION;
        
        PRINT 'Резервирование успешно выполнено для заявки ' + CAST(@RequestID AS NVARCHAR(10));
        
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
        PRINT 'Ошибка: ' + ERROR_MESSAGE();
        THROW;
    END CATCH
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[sp_ReturnBook]    Script Date: 22.05.2026 11:53:46 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
