=== ФАЙЛ: ./Diplom_Bibl/Pages/AdmissionBook.xaml.cs ===
﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using Diplom_Bibl.Helpers;
using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class AdmissionBook : Page
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;
        private int? _currentReceiptId = null;
        private ObservableCollection<dynamic> _allReceipts;

        private class UserItem
        {
            public int ID_User { get; set; }
            public string FullName { get; set; } = "";
        }

        private class SupplierItem
        {
            public int ID_Supplier { get; set; }
            public string SupplierName { get; set; } = "";
        }

        public AdmissionBook()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            LoadResponsibleUsers();
            LoadSuppliers();
            LoadReceipts();
            PrepareNewReceipt();
        }

        private string GenerateReceiptNumber(int nextId) => $"ПН-{nextId:D4}";

        private void LoadResponsibleUsers()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = @"
                    select u.ID_User, Surname + ' ' + Name + ISNULL(' ' + Patronymic, '') AS FullName from Users u
inner join UserRolesAssignments ura on ura.ID_User=u.ID_User
inner join UserRoles ur on ur.ID_Role=ura.ID_Role
where ur.RoleCode= 'LIBRARIAN'
ORDER BY Surname, Name;";

                var users = new ObservableCollection<UserItem>();
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            users.Add(new UserItem
                            {
                                ID_User = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_User"]),
                                FullName = reader["FullName"].ToString()
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
                CbResponsible.ItemsSource = users;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки ответственных лиц: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                CbResponsible.ItemsSource = new ObservableCollection<UserItem>();
            }
        }

        private void LoadSuppliers()
        {
            try
            {
                // Проверяем существование таблицы Suppliers
                bool tableExists = false;
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(
                        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'Suppliers'", conn))
                    {
                        tableExists = (int)cmd.ExecuteScalar() > 0;
                    }
                }

                if (!tableExists)
                {
                    System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("Таблица Suppliers не существует");
                    CbSupplier.ItemsSource = new ObservableCollection<SupplierItem>();
                    CbSupplier.IsEnabled = false;
                    return;
                }

                const string sql = "SELECT ID_Supplier, SupplierName FROM Suppliers ORDER BY SupplierName";
                var suppliers = new ObservableCollection<SupplierItem>();
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            suppliers.Add(new SupplierItem
                            {
                                ID_Supplier = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Supplier"]),
                                SupplierName = reader["SupplierName"].ToString()
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
                CbSupplier.ItemsSource = suppliers;
                CbSupplier.DisplayMemberPath = "SupplierName";
                CbSupplier.SelectedValuePath = "ID_Supplier";
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки поставщиков: {ex.Message}\n\nТаблица может отсутствовать в базе данных.",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                CbSupplier.ItemsSource = new ObservableCollection<SupplierItem>();
                CbSupplier.IsEnabled = false;
            }
        }

        private void PrepareNewReceipt()
        {
            int nextId = 1;
            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("SELECT ISNULL(MAX(IDReceipt), 0) + 1 FROM ReceiptBooks", conn))
                    {
                        var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                        if (result != null && int.TryParse(result.ToString(), out int maxId))
                            nextId = maxId;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch { }

            TbReceiptNumber.Text = GenerateReceiptNumber(nextId);
            TbReceiptDate.Text = DateTime.Now.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm");

            if (CbResponsible.Items.Count > 0) CbResponsible.SelectedIndex = 0;
            if (CbSupplier.ItemsSource != null && CbSupplier.Items.Count > 0) CbSupplier.SelectedIndex = 0;

            TbComment.Clear();

            _currentReceiptId = null;
            BtnSaveNew.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            BtnSaveChanges.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            BtnDelete.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
        }

        private void LoadReceipts()
        {
            try
            {
                // Проверяем наличие колонки SupplierID
                bool hasSupplierColumn = false;
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(
                        @"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
                          WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'ReceiptBooks' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'SupplierID'", conn))
                    {
                        hasSupplierColumn = (int)cmd.ExecuteScalar() > 0;
                    }
                }

                string query;
                if (hasSupplierColumn)
                {
                    query = @"
                        SELECT r.IDReceipt, r.ReceiptNumber, r.ReceiptDate, 
                               u.Surname + ' ' + u.Name + ISNULL(' ' + u.Patronymic, '') AS ResponsiblePerson,
                               ISNULL(s.SupplierName, '') AS SupplierName,
                               r.Comment
                        FROM ReceiptBooks r
                        LEFT JOIN Users u ON r.ID_ResponsibleUser = u.ID_User
                        LEFT JOIN Suppliers s ON r.SupplierID = s.ID_Supplier
                        ORDER BY r.ReceiptDate DESC";
                }
                else
                {
                    query = @"
                        SELECT r.IDReceipt, r.ReceiptNumber, r.ReceiptDate, 
                               u.Surname + ' ' + u.Name + ISNULL(' ' + u.Patronymic, '') AS ResponsiblePerson,
                               '' AS SupplierName,
                               r.Comment
                        FROM ReceiptBooks r
                        LEFT JOIN Users u ON r.ID_ResponsibleUser = u.ID_User
                        ORDER BY r.ReceiptDate DESC";
                }

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var list = new ObservableCollection<dynamic>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            list.Add(new
                            {
                                IDReceipt = reader["IDReceipt"],
                                ReceiptNumber = reader["ReceiptNumber"].ToString(),
                                ReceiptDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReceiptDate"]),
                                ResponsiblePerson = reader["ResponsiblePerson"].ToString(),
                                SupplierName = reader["SupplierName"].ToString(),
                                Comment = reader["Comment"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                            });
                        }
                        _allReceipts = list;
                        ApplyFilter("");
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                _allReceipts = new ObservableCollection<dynamic>();
                LvReceipts.ItemsSource = _allReceipts;
            }
        }

        private void ApplyFilter(string term)
        {
            if (_allReceipts == null) return;

            var filtered = _allReceipts.Where(r =>
                string.IsNullOrEmpty(term) ||
                r.ReceiptNumber.ToString().IndexOf(term, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 ||
                r.ResponsiblePerson.ToString().IndexOf(term, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 ||
                r.SupplierName.ToString().IndexOf(term, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 ||
                r.Comment.ToString().IndexOf(term, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0
            ).ToList();

            LvReceipts.ItemsSource = filtered;
        }

        private bool ValidateForm()
        {
            if (CbResponsible.SelectedValue == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите ответственное лицо.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        private void BtnSaveNew_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!ValidateForm()) return;

            try
            {
                int responsibleId = (int)CbResponsible.SelectedValue;
                int? supplierId = CbSupplier.SelectedValue as int?;
                string comment = TbComment.Text?.Trim();

                string number = TbReceiptNumber.Text;
                DateTime date = DateTime.Now;

                // Проверяем наличие колонки SupplierID
                bool hasSupplierColumn = false;
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(
                        @"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
                          WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'ReceiptBooks' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'SupplierID'", conn))
                    {
                        hasSupplierColumn = (int)cmd.ExecuteScalar() > 0;
                    }
                }

                string insertQuery;
                if (hasSupplierColumn)
                {
                    insertQuery = @"
                        INSERT INTO ReceiptBooks (ReceiptNumber, ReceiptDate, ID_ResponsibleUser, SupplierID, Comment)
                        VALUES (@Number, @Date, @ResponsibleID, @SupplierID, @Comment);";
                }
                else
                {
                    insertQuery = @"
                        INSERT INTO ReceiptBooks (ReceiptNumber, ReceiptDate, ID_ResponsibleUser, Comment)
                        VALUES (@Number, @Date, @ResponsibleID, @Comment);";
                }

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(insertQuery, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Number", number);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date", date);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ResponsibleID", responsibleId);
                        if (hasSupplierColumn)
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SupplierID", supplierId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Comment", comment ?? (object)DBNull.Value);

                        cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                        CustomMessageBox.Show("Накладная успешно создана.", "Успешно",
                            CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                        LoadReceipts();
                        PrepareNewReceipt();
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка сохранения: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void BtnSaveChanges_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!_currentReceiptId.HasValue)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Нет выбранной записи.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            if (!ValidateForm()) return;

            try
            {
                int responsibleId = (int)CbResponsible.SelectedValue;
                int? supplierId = CbSupplier.SelectedValue as int?;
                string comment = TbComment.Text?.Trim();

                // Проверяем наличие колонки SupplierID
                bool hasSupplierColumn = false;
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(
                        @"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
                          WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'ReceiptBooks' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'SupplierID'", conn))
                    {
                        hasSupplierColumn = (int)cmd.ExecuteScalar() > 0;
                    }
                }

                string updateQuery;
                if (hasSupplierColumn)
                {
                    updateQuery = @"
                        UPDATE ReceiptBooks 
                        SET ID_ResponsibleUser = @ResponsibleID, 
                            SupplierID = @SupplierID, 
                            Comment = @Comment
                        WHERE IDReceipt = @Id;";
                }
                else
                {
                    updateQuery = @"
                        UPDATE ReceiptBooks 
                        SET ID_ResponsibleUser = @ResponsibleID, 
                            Comment = @Comment
                        WHERE IDReceipt = @Id;";
                }

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(updateQuery, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ResponsibleID", responsibleId);
                        if (hasSupplierColumn)
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SupplierID", supplierId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Comment", comment ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Id", _currentReceiptId.Value);

                        int rows = cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                        if (rows > 0)
                        {
                            CustomMessageBox.Show("Изменения сохранены.", "Успешно",
                                CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                            LoadReceipts();
                            PrepareNewReceipt();
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            CustomMessageBox.Show("Запись не найдена.", "Ошибка",
                                CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка обновления: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void BtnDelete_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!_currentReceiptId.HasValue) return;

            var result = CustomMessageBox.Show("Удалить накладную?", "Подтверждение",
                CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo, CustomMessageBoxImage.Question);
            if (result != CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes) return;

            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("DELETE FROM ReceiptBooks WHERE IDReceipt = @Id", conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Id", _currentReceiptId.Value);
                        int rows = cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                        if (rows > 0)
                        {
                            CustomMessageBox.Show("Накладная удалена.", "Успешно",
                                CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                            LoadReceipts();
                            PrepareNewReceipt();
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            CustomMessageBox.Show("Запись уже удалена.", "Внимание",
                                CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка удаления: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LvReceipts_MouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (LvReceipts.SelectedItem == null) return;

            try
            {
                dynamic item = LvReceipts.SelectedItem;
                _currentReceiptId = item.IDReceipt;
                TbReceiptNumber.Text = item.ReceiptNumber;
                TbReceiptDate.Text = ((DateTime)item.ReceiptDate).ToString("dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm");

                // Установка ответственного лица
                CbResponsible.SelectedValue = GetUserIdByName(item.ResponsiblePerson);

                // Установка поставщика
                string supplierName = item.SupplierName?.ToString() ?? "";
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(supplierName))
                {
                    CbSupplier.SelectedValue = GetSupplierIdByName(supplierName);
                }
                else
                {
                    CbSupplier.SelectedIndex = 0;
                }

                TbComment.Text = item.Comment;

                BtnSaveNew.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                BtnSaveChanges.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                BtnDelete.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки записи: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private int? GetUserIdByName(string fullName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(fullName)) return null;
            try
            {
                const string sql = @"
                    SELECT TOP 1 ID_User FROM Users 
                    WHERE Surname + ' ' + Name + ISNULL(' ' + Patronymic, '') = @FullName";
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@FullName", fullName);
                        var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                        return result == null ? null : (int?)Convert.ToInt32(result);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private int? GetSupplierIdByName(string supplierName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(supplierName)) return null;
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT TOP 1 ID_Supplier FROM Suppliers WHERE SupplierName = @SupplierName";
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SupplierName", supplierName);
                        var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                        return result == null ? null : (int?)Convert.ToInt32(result);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private void SearchBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilter(SearchBox.Text.Trim());
        }

        private void ClosePage_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.GoBack();
        }

        private void Button_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                NavigationService?.Navigate(new AddUser());
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка навигации: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void BtnAddSupplier_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                NavigationService?.Navigate(new AddSupplier());
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка навигации: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            LoadResponsibleUsers();
            LoadSuppliers();
            LoadReceipts();
        }
    }

﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Media;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class BookRequestsManagement : Page
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;Encrypt=False;";
        private ObservableCollection<RequestItem> _allRequests;
        private int _librarianId;
        private System.Timers.Timer _notificationTimer;

        // Словари статусов из БД
        private Dictionary<int, string> _requestStatuses = new Dictionary<int, string>();
        private Dictionary<int, string> _itemStatuses = new Dictionary<int, string>();

        // Храним ID уже показанных уведомлений
        private HashSet<int> _shownNotificationIds = new HashSet<int>();

        #region Вспомогательные классы

        public class NotificationDetail
        {
            public int ID_Notification { get; set; }
            public int RequestID { get; set; }
            public string Message { get; set; } = "";
            public DateTime CreatedDate { get; set; }
            public bool IsRead { get; set; }
            public string UserName { get; set; } = "";
            public string RequestNumber { get; set; } = "";
            public List<BookDetail> Books { get; set; } = new List<BookDetail>();
        }

        public class BookDetail
        {
            public string Title { get; set; } = "";
            public string Author { get; set; } = "";
            public int Quantity { get; set; }
        }

        public class RequestItem
        {
            public int ID_Request { get; set; }
            public string RequestNumber { get; set; } = "";
            public DateTime RequestDate { get; set; }
            public int UserID { get; set; }
            public string UserName { get; set; } = "";
            public int? GroupID { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; } = "";
            public string LessonName { get; set; } = "";
            public DateTime LessonDate { get; set; }
            public int StatusID { get; set; }
            public string StatusName { get; set; } = "";
            public int TotalBooks { get; set; }
            public DateTime? ExpirationDate { get; set; }
            public int UserTypeID { get; set; }

            public SolidColorBrush StatusColor
            {
                get
                {
                    switch (StatusName)
                    {
                        case "Новая": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#3498DB"));
                        case "В обработке": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#F39C12"));
                        case "Выдана": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#1ABC9C"));
                        case "Отменена": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#E74C3C"));
                        case "Просрочена": return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#95A5A6"));
                        default: return new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#95A5A6"));
                    }
                }
            }

            public Visibility ConfirmVisible => (StatusName == "Новая") ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
            public Visibility IssueVisible => (StatusName == "В обработке") ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
            public Visibility CancelVisible => (StatusName != "Выдана" && StatusName != "Отменена" && StatusName != "Просрочена") ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        }

        public class RequestBookItem
        {
            public int ID_RequestItem { get; set; }
            public int BookID { get; set; }
            public string BookTitle { get; set; } = "";
            public string AuthorName { get; set; } = "";
            public int Quantity { get; set; }
            public int StatusID { get; set; }
            public string StatusName { get; set; } = "";
        }

        public BookRequestsManagement(int librarianId)
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _librarianId = librarianId;
            _notificationTimer = new System.Timers.Timer(30000);
            _notificationTimer.Elapsed += async (sender, e) => await CheckNewRequests();
            _notificationTimer.Start();
        }

        private async void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            LoadStatuses();
            LoadStatusFilters();
            await LoadDataAsync();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Загрузка статусов из БД в словари
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadStatuses()
        {
            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();

                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("SELECT ID_Status, StatusName FROM RequestStatuses ORDER BY ID_Status", conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                            _requestStatuses[reader.GetInt32(0)] = reader.GetString(1);
                    }

                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("SELECT ID_Status, StatusName FROM RequestItemStatuses ORDER BY ID_Status", conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                            _itemStatuses[reader.GetInt32(0)] = reader.GetString(1);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки статусов: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Загрузка статусов в выпадающий список фильтра
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadStatusFilters()
        {
            CbStatusFilter.Items.Clear();
            CbStatusFilter.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem { Content = "Все заявки", IsSelected = true });

            foreach (var status in _requestStatuses.Values)
            {
                CbStatusFilter.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem { Content = status });
            }
        }

        private int GetRequestStatusId(string statusName)
        {
            var pair = _requestStatuses.FirstOrDefault(s => s.Value == statusName);
            return pair.Key != 0 ? pair.Key : -1;
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadDataAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                await LoadRequests();
                await LoadUnreadNotificationsCount();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        #endregion

        #region Уведомления

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadUnreadNotificationsCount()
        {
            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RequestNotifications WHERE IsRead = 0", conn))
                    {
                        int count = (int)await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync();
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки счетчика уведомлений: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task CheckNewRequests()
        {
            try
            {
                List<NotificationDetail> newNotifications = new List<NotificationDetail>();

                string query = @"
                    SELECT 
                        n.ID_Notification, n.RequestID, n.Message, n.CreatedDate, n.IsRead,
                        CONCAT(rd.LastName, ' ', rd.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(rd.MiddleName, '')) AS UserName,
                        r.RequestNumber
                    FROM RequestNotifications n
                    INNER JOIN BookRequests br ON n.RequestID = br.ID_Request
                    LEFT JOIN ReaderForm rd ON br.UserID = rd.ReaderID
                    LEFT JOIN BookRequests r ON n.RequestID = r.ID_Request
                    WHERE n.IsRead = 0 
                      AND n.CreatedDate > DATEADD(minute, -1, GETDATE())
                    ORDER BY n.CreatedDate DESC";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                    {
                        while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                        {
                            int id = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Notification"]);
                            if (!_shownNotificationIds.Contains(id))
                            {
                                var detail = new NotificationDetail
                                {
                                    ID_Notification = id,
                                    RequestID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["RequestID"]),
                                    Message = reader["Message"].ToString(),
                                    CreatedDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["CreatedDate"]),
                                    IsRead = Convert.ToBoolean(reader["IsRead"]),
                                    UserName = reader["UserName"]?.ToString() ?? "Неизвестный пользователь",
                                    RequestNumber = reader["RequestNumber"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                                };
                                await LoadNotificationBooks(detail.RequestID, detail);
                                newNotifications.Add(detail);
                                _shownNotificationIds.Add(id);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (newNotifications.Any())
                {
                    Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                    {
                        SystemSounds.Beep.Play();
                        string message = "";
                        foreach (var notification in newNotifications)
                        {
                            string cleanMessage = notification.Message;
                            int userIndex = cleanMessage.IndexOf("от пользователя ID");
                            if (userIndex > 0)
                                cleanMessage = cleanMessage.Substring(0, userIndex).Trim();

                            message += $"📋 {cleanMessage}\n";
                            message += $"👤 От: {notification.UserName}\n";
                            message += $"📚 Книги:\n";
                            if (notification.Books.Any())
                                foreach (var book in notification.Books)
                                    message += $"   • {book.Title} - {book.Author} ({book.Quantity} шт.)\n";
                            else
                                message += $"   • Книги не указаны\n";
                            message += $"\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n\n";
                        }
                        CustomMessageBox.Show(message, "📢 Новые заявки на книги",
                            CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                        _ = LoadRequests();
                        _ = LoadUnreadNotificationsCount();
                    });
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка проверки новых заявок: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadNotificationBooks(int requestId, NotificationDetail detail)
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
                    SELECT b.TitleBook,
                           ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                           ri.Quantity
                    FROM RequestItems ri
                    JOIN Books b ON ri.BookID = b.IDBook
                    LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                    WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestId";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestId", requestId);
                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                detail.Books.Add(new BookDetail
                                {
                                    Title = reader["TitleBook"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    Author = reader["AuthorName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    Quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Quantity"])
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки книг для уведомления: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        #endregion

        #region Загрузка заявок

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadRequests()
        {
            await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(() =>
            {
                string query = @"
                    SELECT 
                        r.ID_Request, r.RequestNumber, r.RequestDate,
                        r.UserID,
                        CONCAT(rd.LastName, ' ', rd.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(rd.MiddleName, '')) AS UserName,
                        r.GroupID, g.GroupCode, r.LessonName, r.LessonDate,
                        r.StatusID, rs.StatusName, r.ExpirationDate, r.UserTypeID,
                        (SELECT SUM(Quantity) FROM RequestItems WHERE RequestID = r.ID_Request) AS TotalBooks
                    FROM BookRequests r
                    LEFT JOIN ReaderForm rd ON r.UserID = rd.ReaderID
                    LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                    LEFT JOIN RequestStatuses rs ON r.StatusID = rs.ID_Status
                    ORDER BY r.RequestDate DESC";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var items = new ObservableCollection<RequestItem>();
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            items.Add(new RequestItem
                            {
                                ID_Request = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Request"]),
                                RequestNumber = reader["RequestNumber"].ToString(),
                                RequestDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["RequestDate"]),
                                UserID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["UserID"]),
                                UserName = reader["UserName"].ToString(),
                                GroupID = reader["GroupID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["GroupID"]) : (int?)null,
                                GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                LessonName = reader["LessonName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                LessonDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["LessonDate"]),
                                StatusID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["StatusID"]),
                                StatusName = reader["StatusName"].ToString(),
                                ExpirationDate = reader["ExpirationDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ExpirationDate"]) : (DateTime?)null,
                                TotalBooks = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalBooks"]),
                                UserTypeID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["UserTypeID"])
                            });
                        }
                        Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                        {
                            _allRequests = items;
                            ApplyFilters();
                        });
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        #endregion

        #region Фильтры

        private void ApplyFilters()
        {
            if (_allRequests == null) return;

            string searchTerm = TbSearch.Text?.Trim().ToLower() ?? "";
            string statusFilter = (CbStatusFilter.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem)?.Content?.ToString() ?? "Все заявки";

            var filtered = _allRequests.AsEnumerable();

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm))
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(r =>
                    r.RequestNumber.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    r.UserName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    r.GroupCode.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    r.LessonName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm));
            }

            if (statusFilter != "Все заявки")
                filtered = filtered.Where(r => r.StatusName == statusFilter);

            DgRequests.ItemsSource = filtered.ToList();
        }

        private void TbSearch_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e) => ApplyFilters();
        private void CbStatusFilter_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e) => ApplyFilters();

        #endregion

                await ShowRequestDetails((int)btn.Tag);
        }

            DgRequestItems.ItemsSource = null;
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task ShowRequestDetails(int requestId)
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
                    SELECT 
                        r.RequestNumber,
                        CONCAT(rd.LastName, ' ', rd.FirstName, ' ', ISNULL(rd.MiddleName, '')) AS UserName,
                        rd.TypeID AS UserTypeID,
                        r.LessonName, r.LessonDate, r.RequestDate,
                        g.GroupCode, rs.StatusName, r.ExpirationDate,
                        ri.ID_RequestItem, ri.BookID,
                        b.TitleBook,
                        ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                        ri.Quantity,
                        ris.StatusName AS ItemStatusName
                    FROM BookRequests r
                    LEFT JOIN ReaderForm rd ON r.UserID = rd.ReaderID
                    LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                    LEFT JOIN RequestStatuses rs ON r.StatusID = rs.ID_Status
                    LEFT JOIN RequestItems ri ON r.ID_Request = ri.RequestID
                    LEFT JOIN Books b ON ri.BookID = b.IDBook
                    LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                    LEFT JOIN RequestItemStatuses ris ON ri.StatusID = ris.ID_Status
                    WHERE r.ID_Request = @RequestId";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestId", requestId);
                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            bool hasData = false;
                            int userTypeID = 0;
                            var items = new ObservableCollection<RequestBookItem>();

                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                if (!hasData)
                                {
                                    userTypeID = reader["UserTypeID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["UserTypeID"]) : 0;
                                    string userTypeName = userTypeID == 1 ? "Студент" : (userTypeID == 3 ? "Сотрудник" : "Неизвестно");

                                    Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                                    {
                                        TbRequestNumber.Text = $"Заявка №: {reader["RequestNumber"]}";
                                        TbUserName.Text = $"Заявитель: {reader["UserName"]}";
                                        TbUserType.Text = $"Тип: {userTypeName}";
                                        TbLessonInfo.Text = $"Занятие: {reader["LessonName"]}";
                                        TbRequestDate.Text = $"Дата создания: {Convert.ToDateTime(reader["RequestDate"]):dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm}";
                                        TbGroupInfo.Text = $"Группа: {reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "Не указана"}";
                                        TbStatus.Text = $"Статус: {reader["StatusName"]}";
                                        TbExpirationDate.Text = reader["ExpirationDate"] != DBNull.Value
                                            ? $"Срок брони: {Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ExpirationDate"]):dd.MM.yyyy}"
                                            : "";
                                    });
                                    hasData = true;
                                }

                                if (reader["ID_RequestItem"] != DBNull.Value)
                                {
                                    items.Add(new RequestBookItem
                                    {
                                        ID_RequestItem = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_RequestItem"]),
                                        BookID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["BookID"]),
                                        BookTitle = reader["TitleBook"]?.ToString() ?? "Не указано",
                                        AuthorName = reader["AuthorName"]?.ToString() ?? "Не указан",
                                        Quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Quantity"]),
                                        StatusName = reader["ItemStatusName"]?.ToString() ?? "Неизвестен"
                                    });
                                }
                            }

                            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                            {
                                DgRequestItems.ItemsSource = items;
                                DetailsPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;

                                if (items.Count == 0)
                                {
                                    var emptyList = new ObservableCollection<RequestBookItem>
                                    {
                                        new RequestBookItem { BookTitle = "Нет книг в заявке", AuthorName = "", Quantity = 0, StatusName = "" }
                                    };
                                    DgRequestItems.ItemsSource = emptyList;
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки деталей: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        #endregion

        #region Действия с заявками

        private async void ConfirmRequest_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!(sender is Button btn) || btn.Tag == null) return;
            int requestId = (int)btn.Tag;

            var request = _allRequests.FirstOrDefault(r => r.ID_Request == requestId);
            if (request == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Заявка не найдена.", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                return;
            }

            var result = CustomMessageBox.Show("Подтвердить заявку? Книги будут зарезервированы.", "Подтверждение",
                CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo, CustomMessageBoxImage.Question);

            if (result != CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes) return;

            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("sp_ReserveBooksAtomic", conn))
                    {
                        cmd.CommandType = System.Data.CommandType.StoredProcedure;
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestID", requestId);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserID", request.UserID);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReserveDays", 3);
                        await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                    }
                }
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Заявка подтверждена! Книги зарезервированы.", "Успешно",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                await LoadRequests();
                await LoadUnreadNotificationsCount();
                DetailsPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }
            catch (SqlException ex) when (ex.Number == 1205)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Система временно перегружена. Повторите попытку.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
            }
            catch (SqlException ex) when (ex.Message.Contains("недостаточно") || ex.Message.Contains("Недостаточно"))
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Недостаточно экземпляров книг для резервирования.\n\nВозможно, другие заявки уже забрали эти книги.",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка подтверждения: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void IssueBooks_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!(sender is Button btn) || btn.Tag == null) return;
            int requestId = (int)btn.Tag;

            var request = _allRequests.FirstOrDefault(r => r.ID_Request == requestId);
            if (request == null) return;

            int cancelledId = GetRequestStatusId("Отменена");
            if (cancelledId > 0 && request.StatusID == cancelledId)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Нельзя выдать книги по отмененной заявке.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            int processingStatusId = GetRequestStatusId("В обработке");
            if (processingStatusId > 0 && request.StatusID != processingStatusId)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Книги по заявке еще не готовы к выдаче. Сначала подтвердите заявку. Текущий статус: {request.StatusName}",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            var confirmResult = CustomMessageBox.Show(
                $"Выдать книги по заявке №{request.RequestNumber}?\n\nПользователь: {request.UserName}\nКниг: {request.TotalBooks} шт.",
                "Подтверждение выдачи", CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo, CustomMessageBoxImage.Question);

            if (confirmResult != CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes) return;

            var infoServicePage = new InformationServicePage();

            if (request.GroupID.HasValue && request.GroupID > 0)
            {
                infoServicePage.SetDataFromRequest(requestId, request.UserID, request.GroupID,
                    request.UserName, request.GroupCode, request.LessonName, request.LessonDate);
            }
            else
            {
                infoServicePage.SetDataFromRequestIndividual(requestId, request.UserID, request.UserName,
                    request.LessonName, request.LessonDate, request.UserTypeID);
            }

            NavigationService?.Navigate(infoServicePage);
        }

        private async void CancelRequest_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!(sender is Button btn) || btn.Tag == null) return;
            int requestId = (int)btn.Tag;

            var result = CustomMessageBox.Show("Отменить заявку? Зарезервированные книги будут возвращены в доступные.",
                "Подтверждение отмены", CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo, CustomMessageBoxImage.Question);

            if (result != CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes) return;

            try
            {
                int cancelledRequestStatusId = GetRequestStatusId("Отменена");
                if (cancelledRequestStatusId <= 0) cancelledRequestStatusId = 5;

                // Ищем ID статуса "Отменена" для позиций заявки
                int cancelledItemStatusId = _itemStatuses
                    .FirstOrDefault(s => s.Value == "Отменена").Key;
                if (cancelledItemStatusId <= 0) cancelledItemStatusId = 4;

                // Получаем ID статуса книги "В наличии"
                int availableBookStatusId;
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(
                        "SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%В наличии%'", conn))
                    {
                        availableBookStatusId = Convert.ToInt32(await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync());
                    }
                }

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var transaction = conn.BeginTransaction())
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            // 1. Возвращаем зарезервированные книги в статус "В наличии"
                            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(@"
                        UPDATE b
                        SET b.StatusBook = @AvailableStatus
                        FROM Books b
                        JOIN RequestItems ri ON b.IDBook = ri.BookID
                        WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestId 
                          AND ri.StatusID = 2 
                          AND b.StatusBook = (
                              SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Зарезервирована%'
                          )", conn, transaction))
                            {
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@AvailableStatus", availableBookStatusId);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestId", requestId);
                                await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                            }

                            // 2. Снимаем резерв с позиций заявки
                            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(@"
                        UPDATE RequestItems 
                        SET StatusID = @CancelledItemStatus 
                        WHERE RequestID = @RequestId AND StatusID = 2", conn, transaction))
                            {
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CancelledItemStatus", cancelledItemStatusId);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestId", requestId);
                                await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                            }

                            // 3. Меняем статус заявки на "Отменена"
                            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(
                                "UPDATE BookRequests SET StatusID = @StatusId WHERE ID_Request = @RequestId",
                                conn, transaction))
                            {
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StatusId", cancelledRequestStatusId);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestId", requestId);
                                await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                            }

                            transaction.Commit();
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            transaction.Rollback();
                            throw;
                        }
                    }
                }

                CustomMessageBox.Show("Заявка отменена. Книги возвращены в доступные.", "Успешно",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                await LoadRequests();
                await LoadUnreadNotificationsCount();
                DetailsPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка отмены: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        #endregion

        #region События DataGrid

        private void DgRequests_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DgRequests.SelectedItem is RequestItem selected)
                _ = ShowRequestDetails(selected.ID_Request);
        }

        #endregion
    }

﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using Diplom_Bibl.Helpers;
using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class BulkAddBooks : Page
    {
        string _connectionString = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;
        private int _defaultStatusId = 1;

        // Коллекции для комбобоксов
        private ObservableCollection<AuthorItem> _authors;
        private ObservableCollection<EditionTypeItem> _editionTypes;  // Заменяет ViewBook
        private ObservableCollection<PublisherItem> _publishers;
        private ObservableCollection<GenreItem> _genres;
        private ObservableCollection<ReceiptItem> _receipts;
        private ObservableCollection<CategoryItem> _categories;
        private ObservableCollection<FormatItem> _formats;
        private ObservableCollection<StatusItem> _statuses;

        public class AuthorItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayAuthors { get; set; }
        }

        public class PublisherItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayPH { get; set; }
        }

        public class GenreItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string DisplayGen { get; set; }
        }

        public class ReceiptItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string ReceiptNumber { get; set; }
            public DateTime ReceiptDate { get; set; }
            public string DisplayReceipt => $"{ReceiptNumber} от {ReceiptDate:dd.MM.yyyy}";
        }

        public class CategoryItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string CategoryName { get; set; }
            public string DisplayCategory => CategoryName;
        }

        // Вид издания (EditionTypes)
        public class EditionTypeItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string EditionTypeName { get; set; }
            public string EditionTypeNameDisplay => EditionTypeName;
        }

        public class FormatItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string FormatName { get; set; }
            public string DisplayFormat => FormatName;
        }

        public class StatusItem
        {
            public int ID { get; set; }
            public string Title_Status { get; set; }
            public string DisplayStatus => Title_Status;
        }

        public BulkAddBooks()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            LoadData();
            QuantityBox.TextChanged += QuantityBox_TextChanged;
            this.Loaded += (s, e) => UpdateInventoryPreview();
        }

        private async void LoadData()
        {
            await LoadAuthors();
            await LoadEditionTypes();    // Загружаем виды изданий вместо ViewBook
            await LoadPublishers();
            await LoadGenres();
            await LoadReceipts();
            await LoadCategories();
            await LoadFormats();
            await LoadStatuses();
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadAuthors()
        {
            try
            {
                await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    const string sql = "SELECT ID_Autor, SurnameAuthor, NameAuthor, PatronymicAuthor FROM Authors ORDER BY SurnameAuthor";
                    using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                    {
                        conn.Open();
                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            var items = new ObservableCollection<AuthorItem>();
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                int id = reader["ID_Autor"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Autor"]);
                                string surname = reader["SurnameAuthor"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                string name = reader["NameAuthor"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                string patronymic = reader["PatronymicAuthor"]?.ToString() ?? "";

                                items.Add(new AuthorItem
                                {
                                    ID = id,
                                    DisplayAuthors = $"{surname} {name} {patronymic}".Trim()
                                });
                            }
                            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                            {
                                _authors = items;
                                AuthorCombo.ItemsSource = _authors;
                                AuthorCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayAuthors";
                                AuthorCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID";
                            });
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки авторов: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        // Загрузка видов изданий (EditionTypes) - заменяет ViewBook
        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadEditionTypes()
        {
            try
            {
                await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    const string sql = "SELECT ID_EditionType, EditionTypeName FROM EditionTypes ORDER BY EditionTypeName";
                    using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                    {
                        conn.Open();
                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            var items = new ObservableCollection<EditionTypeItem>();
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                items.Add(new EditionTypeItem
                                {
                                    ID = reader["ID_EditionType"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_EditionType"]),
                                    EditionTypeName = reader["EditionTypeName"]?.ToString() ?? ""
                                });
                            }
                            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                            {
                                _editionTypes = items;
                                EditionTypeCombo.ItemsSource = _editionTypes;
                                EditionTypeCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "EditionTypeName";
                                EditionTypeCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID";
                            });
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки видов изданий: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadReceipts()
        {
            try
            {
                await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    const string sql = "SELECT IDReceipt, ReceiptNumber, ReceiptDate FROM ReceiptBooks ORDER BY ReceiptNumber DESC";
                    using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                    {
                        conn.Open();
                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            var items = new ObservableCollection<ReceiptItem>();
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                int id = reader["IDReceipt"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["IDReceipt"]);
                                string receiptNumber = reader["ReceiptNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                DateTime receiptDate = reader["ReceiptDate"] != DBNull.Value
                                    ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReceiptDate"])
                                    : DateTime.Now;

                                items.Add(new ReceiptItem
                                {
                                    ID = id,
                                    ReceiptNumber = receiptNumber,
                                    ReceiptDate = receiptDate
                                });
                            }
                            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                            {
                                _receipts = items;
                                ReceiptCombo.ItemsSource = _receipts;
                                ReceiptCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayReceipt";
                                ReceiptCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID";

                                if (_receipts.Count > 0) ReceiptCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
                            });
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки актов поступления: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadStatuses()
        {
            try
            {
                await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Run(() =>
                {
                    const string sql = "SELECT ID_Status, Title_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status NOT LIKE '%Списана%' AND Title_Status NOT LIKE '%Утрачен%' ORDER BY Title_Status";
                    using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                    {
                        conn.Open();
                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            var items = new ObservableCollection<StatusItem>();
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                int id = reader["ID_Status"] == DBNull.Value ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Status"]);
                                string title = reader["Title_Status"].ToString();
                                items.Add(new StatusItem { ID = id, Title_Status = title });
                                if (title.Contains("В наличии")) _defaultStatusId = id;
                            }
                            Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                            {
                                _statuses = items;
                                StatusCombo.ItemsSource = _statuses;
                                StatusCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayStatus";
                                StatusCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID";

                                if (items.Count > 0) StatusCombo.SelectedValue = _defaultStatusId;
                            });
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки статусов: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateInventoryPreview()
        {
            try
            {
                if (QuantityBox == null || InventoryPreviewText == null) return;

                int quantity = 1;
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(QuantityBox.Text)) int.TryParse(QuantityBox.Text, out quantity);
                if (quantity < 1) quantity = 1;

                int nextNumber = GetNextInventoryNumber();
                var previewNumbers = new System.Text.StringBuilder();

                for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(quantity, 5); i++)
                {
                    if (i > 0) previewNumbers.Append(", ");
                    previewNumbers.Append($"{nextNumber + i:D6}");
                }

                if (quantity > 5) previewNumbers.Append($" ... и ещё {quantity - 5}");
                InventoryPreviewText.Text = previewNumbers.ToString();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка в UpdateInventoryPreview: {ex.Message}");
                if (InventoryPreviewText != null) InventoryPreviewText.Text = "Ошибка генерации номеров";
            }
        }

        private int GetNextInventoryNumber()
        {
            const string sql = "SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(InventaryNumber AS INT)), 0) FROM Books WHERE ISNUMERIC(InventaryNumber) = 1";
            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    return (int)cmd.ExecuteScalar() + 1;
                }
            }
        }

        private bool ValidateForm()
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TitleBox.Text))
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите название книги.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                TitleBox.Focus();
                return false;
            }

            if (AuthorCombo.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите автора.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                AuthorCombo.Focus();
                return false;
            }

            if (EditionTypeCombo.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите вид издания.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                EditionTypeCombo.Focus();
                return false;
            }

            if (!int.TryParse(YearBox.Text, out int year) || year < 1000 || year > DateTime.Now.Year)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Введите корректный год (1000-{DateTime.Now.Year}).", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                YearBox.Focus();
                return false;
            }

            if (!int.TryParse(QuantityBox.Text, out int quantity) || quantity < 1 || quantity > 100)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите корректное количество экземпляров (1-100).", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                QuantityBox.Focus();
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        private void SaveButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!ValidateForm()) return;

            try
            {
                int quantity = int.Parse(QuantityBox.Text);
                string title = TitleBox.Text.Trim();
                int authorId = (int)AuthorCombo.SelectedValue;
                int editionTypeId = (int)EditionTypeCombo.SelectedValue;
                int? publisherId = PublisherCombo.SelectedValue as int?;
                int? genreId = GenreCombo.SelectedValue as int?;
                int? categoryId = CategoryCombo.SelectedValue as int?;
                int? formatId = FormatCombo.SelectedValue as int?;
                int? statusId = StatusCombo.SelectedValue as int? ?? _defaultStatusId;
                int? receiptId = ReceiptCombo.SelectedValue as int?;
                int year = int.Parse(YearBox.Text);
                string annotation = AnnotationBox.Text?.Trim();

                decimal price = 0;
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(PriceBox.Text))
                    decimal.TryParse(PriceBox.Text.Replace(',', '.'), out price);

                int nextNumber = GetNextInventoryNumber();
                int successCount = 0;

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var transaction = conn.BeginTransaction())
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            for (int i = 0; i < quantity; i++)
                            {
                                string invNumber = $"{nextNumber + i:D6}";

                                string query = @"
                                    INSERT INTO Books (
                                        InventaryNumber, TitleBook, Author, PublishingHouse, YearPublishing,
                                        Gener, StatusBook, Anotation, IDReceip, Price, TotalCopies, AvailableCopies,
                                        CategoryID, EditionTypeID, FormatID
                                    ) VALUES (
                                        @Inv, @Title, @Author, @Pub, @Year,
                                        @Genre, @Status, @Annot, @Receipt, @Price, 1, 1,
                                        @CategoryID, @EditionTypeID, @FormatID
                                    )";

                                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn, transaction))
                                {
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Inv", invNumber);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Title", title);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Author", authorId);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Pub", publisherId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Year", year);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Genre", genreId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Status", statusId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Annot", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(annotation) ? (object)DBNull.Value : annotation);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Receipt", receiptId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Price", price);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@CategoryID", categoryId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@EditionTypeID", editionTypeId);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@FormatID", formatId ?? (object)DBNull.Value);

                                    cmd.ExecuteNonQuery();
                                    successCount++;
                                }
                            }

                            transaction.Commit();

                            CustomMessageBox.Show($"Успешно добавлено {successCount} экземпляров книг!\n" +
                                          $"Инвентарные номера: {nextNumber:D6} - {nextNumber + quantity - 1:D6}",
                                "Успех", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);

                            ClearForm();
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            transaction.Rollback();
                            throw;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (SqlException ex) when (ex.Number == 2627)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Произошла ошибка при генерации инвентарных номеров. Возможно, в базе есть нечисловые инвентарные номера.",
                    "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при сохранении: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void ClearForm()
        {
            TitleBox.Clear();
            AuthorCombo.SelectedIndex = -1;
            EditionTypeCombo.SelectedIndex = -1;
            PublisherCombo.SelectedIndex = -1;
            GenreCombo.SelectedIndex = -1;
            CategoryCombo.SelectedIndex = -1;
            FormatCombo.SelectedIndex = -1;
            StatusCombo.SelectedValue = _defaultStatusId;
            YearBox.Clear();
            PriceBox.Clear();
            AnnotationBox.Clear();
            QuantityBox.Text = "1";
            ReceiptCombo.SelectedIndex = -1;
            UpdateInventoryPreview();
        }

        private void ClearButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            ClearForm();
        }
