        private void InitializeStats()
        {
            try
            {
                DateTime selectedDate = DatePicker.SelectedDate ?? DateTime.Today;
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    LoadOrCreateDailyStats(conn, selectedDate);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { ShowError("Ошибка загрузки статистики", ex); }
        }

        private void LoadOrCreateDailyStats(SqlConnection conn, DateTime date)
        {
            string query = @"SELECT id_record, delivery_book, delivery_certificate, events_count 
                             FROM InformationServiseTb WHERE date_record = @Date";
            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
            {
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date", date.Date);
                using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                {
                    if (reader.Read())
                    {
                        _currentRecordId = reader.GetInt32(0);
                        BooksCountBox.Text = reader.GetInt32(1).ToString();
                        ReferencesCountBox.Text = reader.GetInt32(2).ToString();
                        EventsCountBox.Text = reader.GetInt32(3).ToString();
                        SetEditMode(true);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        _currentRecordId = null;
                        BooksCountBox.Text = "0";
                        ReferencesCountBox.Text = "0";
                        EventsCountBox.Text = "0";
                        SetEditMode(false);
                    }
                }
            }
            UpdateStatsDisplay();
        }

        private void SetEditMode(bool isExisting)
        {
            SaveNewRecordButton.Visibility = isExisting ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
            SaveChangesButton.Visibility = isExisting ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
            DeleteButton.Visibility = isExisting ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
        }

        private void UpdateStatsDisplay()
        {
            BooksCountStat.Text = BooksCountBox.Text;
            ReferencesCountStat.Text = ReferencesCountBox.Text;
            EventsCountStat.Text = EventsCountBox.Text;
            IdRecordLabel.Content = _currentRecordId.HasValue ? $"ID записи: {_currentRecordId}" : "Новая запись";
        }

        private void UpdateDailyStats(int additionalBooks)
        {
            try
            {
                DateTime selectedDate = DatePicker.SelectedDate ?? DateTime.Today;
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    string checkQuery = "SELECT id_record, delivery_book FROM InformationServiseTb WHERE date_record = @Date";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(checkQuery, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date", selectedDate.Date);
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            if (reader.Read())
                            {
                                int currentId = reader.GetInt32(0);
                                int currentBooks = reader.GetInt32(1);
                                reader.Close();
                                ExecuteNonQuery(conn,
                                    "UPDATE InformationServiseTb SET delivery_book = @Books WHERE id_record = @ID",
                                    ("@Books", currentBooks + additionalBooks), ("@ID", currentId));
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                reader.Close();
                                ExecuteNonQuery(conn,
                                    "INSERT INTO InformationServiseTb (date_record, delivery_book, delivery_certificate, events_count) VALUES (@Date, @Books, 0, 0)",
                                    ("@Date", selectedDate.Date), ("@Books", additionalBooks));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка обновления статистики: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        #endregion

        #region Выдача книг

        private void CreateIssueButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!ValidateIssueForm(out int requestedQuantity)) return;

            if (ReaderTypeRadio.IsChecked == true)
                CreateIndividualIssuance(requestedQuantity);
            else
                CreateGroupIssuance(requestedQuantity);
        }

        private bool ValidateIssueForm(out int quantity)
        {
            quantity = 0;
            if (_selectedBook == null) { ShowWarning("Выберите книгу для выдачи."); return false; }
            if (!int.TryParse(QuantityBox?.Text, out quantity) || quantity <= 0) { ShowWarning("Укажите корректное количество."); return false; }
            if (quantity > _selectedBook.AvailableCopies) { ShowWarning($"Недостаточно экземпляров. Доступно: {_selectedBook.AvailableCopies}"); return false; }

            if (ReaderTypeRadio.IsChecked == true)
            {
                if (_selectedReader == null) { ShowWarning("Выберите читателя."); return false; }
            }
            else
            {
                if (_selectedGroup == null) { ShowWarning("Выберите группу."); return false; }
                if (_selectedTeacher == null) { ShowWarning("Выберите преподавателя."); return false; }
                if (_selectedStudent == null) { ShowWarning("Выберите студента."); return false; }
            }
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Создание индивидуальной выдачи книг.
        /// Использует только книги со статусом "В наличии" (НЕ зарезервированные).
        /// </summary>
        private async void CreateIndividualIssuance(int quantity)
        {
            try
            {
                List<int> bookIds = GetAvailableBookIds(_selectedBook.TitleBook, _selectedBook.AuthorName, quantity);

                if (bookIds.Count < quantity)
                {
                    ShowWarning($"Недостаточно экземпляров книги.\nТребуется: {quantity}, доступно: {bookIds.Count}");
                    return;
                }

                DateTime plannedReturnDate = _selectedReturnDate;

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var transaction = conn.BeginTransaction())
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            foreach (int bookId in bookIds)
                            {
                                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("sp_CreateIndividualIssuance", conn, transaction))
                                {
                                    cmd.CommandType = System.Data.CommandType.StoredProcedure;
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BookId", bookId);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", _selectedReader.ReaderID);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PlannedReturnDate", plannedReturnDate);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Notes", "Выдача через информационное обслуживание");
                                    cmd.Parameters.Add("@IssuanceId", System.Data.SqlDbType.Int).Direction = System.Data.ParameterDirection.Output;
                                    await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                                }
                            }

                            UpdateRequestStatusIfNeeded(conn, transaction);
                            transaction.Commit();
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            transaction.Rollback();
                            throw;
                        }
                    }
                }

                UpdateDailyStats(quantity);
                _selectedBook.AvailableCopies -= quantity;
                ShowSuccess($"Индивидуальная выдача успешно создана!\nВыдано книг: {quantity}\nДата возврата: {plannedReturnDate:dd.MM.yyyy}");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Ошибка при создании выдачи", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Создание групповой выдачи книг.
        /// Использует книги со статусом "В наличии" или "Зарезервирована",
        /// при выдаче статус меняется на "Выдана".
        /// </summary>
        private async void CreateGroupIssuance(int quantity)
        {
            try
            {
                List<int> bookIds = GetAvailableBookIdsForGroupIssue(_selectedBook.TitleBook, _selectedBook.AuthorName, quantity, _pendingRequestId);

                if (bookIds.Count < quantity)
                {
                    ShowWarning($"Недостаточно экземпляров книги.\nТребуется: {quantity}, доступно: {bookIds.Count}");
                    return;
                }

                DateTime plannedReturnDate = _selectedReturnDate;
                string bookIdsString = string.Join(",", bookIds);

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var transaction = conn.BeginTransaction())
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand("sp_CreateGroupIssuance", conn, transaction))
                            {
                                cmd.CommandType = System.Data.CommandType.StoredProcedure;
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupId", _selectedGroup.GroupID);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TeacherId", _selectedTeacher.TeacherID);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@StudentId", _selectedStudent.ReaderID);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@PlannedReturnDate", plannedReturnDate);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@SubjectName", _pendingLessonName ?? "Урок");
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Notes", "Групповая выдача");
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BookIds", bookIdsString);
                                cmd.Parameters.Add("@GroupIssuanceId", System.Data.SqlDbType.Int).Direction = System.Data.ParameterDirection.Output;
                                await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                            }

                            UpdateRequestStatusIfNeeded(conn, transaction);
                            transaction.Commit();
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            transaction.Rollback();
                            throw;
                        }
                    }
                }

                UpdateDailyStats(quantity);
                _selectedBook.AvailableCopies -= quantity;
                ShowSuccess($"Групповая выдача успешно создана!\nВыдано книг: {quantity}\nДата возврата: {plannedReturnDate:dd.MM.yyyy}");
                NavigationService?.GoBack();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowError("Ошибка при создании групповой выдачи", ex);
            }
        }

        private void UpdateRequestStatusIfNeeded(SqlConnection conn, SqlTransaction transaction)
        {
            if (!_pendingRequestId.HasValue) return;

            ExecuteNonQuery(conn,
                @"UPDATE BookRequests 
                  SET StatusID = (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Выдана'), 
                      IssuedDate = GETDATE() 
                  WHERE ID_Request = @RequestId",
                transaction, ("@RequestId", _pendingRequestId.Value));

            ExecuteNonQuery(conn,
                @"UPDATE RequestItems 
                  SET StatusID = (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestItemStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Выдана'),
                      IssuedQuantity = Quantity
                  WHERE RequestID = @RequestId",
                transaction, ("@RequestId", _pendingRequestId.Value));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получение ID книг со статусом "В наличии" (без зарезервированных).
        /// Используется для индивидуальной выдачи.
        /// </summary>
        private List<int> GetAvailableBookIds(string title, string author, int requiredQuantity)
        {
            var bookIds = new List<int>();
            try
            {
                string sql = @"
            SELECT TOP (@Qty) b.IDBook
            FROM Books b
            LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
            WHERE b.TitleBook = @Title 
              AND ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') = @Author
              AND b.AvailableCopies > 0
              AND b.StatusBook NOT IN (
                  SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Зарезервирована%'
              )
              AND b.StatusBook NOT IN (
                  SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Списана%'
              )
              AND b.StatusBook NOT IN (
                  SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Утрачен%'
              )
            ORDER BY b.IDBook";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Title", title);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Author", author);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Qty", requiredQuantity);
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader.Read())
                                bookIds.Add(reader.GetInt32(0));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка получения ID книг: {ex.Message}");
            }
            return bookIds;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получение ID книг со статусом "В наличии" или "Зарезервирована".
        /// Используется для групповой выдачи.
        /// </summary>
        private List<int> GetAvailableBookIdsForGroupIssue(string title, string author, int requiredQuantity, int? requestId = null)
        {
            var bookIds = new List<int>();
            try
            {
                string sql;

                if (requestId.HasValue)
                {
                    sql = @"
                SELECT TOP (@Qty) b.IDBook
                FROM Books b
                LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                WHERE b.TitleBook = @Title 
                  AND ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') = @Author
                  AND b.AvailableCopies > 0
                  AND b.StatusBook NOT IN (
                      SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Списана%'
                  )
                  AND b.StatusBook NOT IN (
                      SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Утрачен%'
                  )
                  AND (
                      b.StatusBook NOT IN (
                          SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Зарезервирована%'
                      )
                      OR b.IDBook IN (
                          SELECT ri.BookID FROM RequestItems ri WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestId
                      )
                  )
                ORDER BY b.IDBook";
                }
                else
                {
                    sql = @"
                SELECT TOP (@Qty) b.IDBook
                FROM Books b
                LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                WHERE b.TitleBook = @Title 
                  AND ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') = @Author
                  AND b.AvailableCopies > 0
                  AND b.StatusBook NOT IN (
                      SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Зарезервирована%'
                  )
                  AND b.StatusBook NOT IN (
                      SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Списана%'
                  )
                  AND b.StatusBook NOT IN (
                      SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Утрачен%'
                  )
                ORDER BY b.IDBook";
                }

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Title", title);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Author", author);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Qty", requiredQuantity);
                        if (requestId.HasValue)
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestId", requestId.Value);
                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            while (reader.Read())
                                bookIds.Add(reader.GetInt32(0));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка получения ID книг: {ex.Message}");
            }
            return bookIds;
        }

        #endregion

        #region Сохранение и удаление статистики

        private void SaveNewRecordButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => SaveRecord(false);
        private void SaveChangesButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) => SaveRecord(true);

        private void SaveRecord(bool isUpdate)
        {
            ParseStatsInput(out int books, out int references, out int events);

            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    if (isUpdate && _currentRecordId.HasValue)
                    {
                        ExecuteNonQuery(conn,
                            "UPDATE InformationServiseTb SET delivery_book = @Books, delivery_certificate = @Ref, events_count = @Events WHERE id_record = @ID",
                            ("@Books", books), ("@Ref", references), ("@Events", events), ("@ID", _currentRecordId.Value));
                        ShowSuccess("Запись обновлена!");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        if (CheckRecordExists(conn)) { ShowWarning("Запись за эту дату уже существует!"); return; }
                        ExecuteNonQuery(conn,
                            "INSERT INTO InformationServiseTb (date_record, delivery_book, delivery_certificate, events_count) VALUES (@Date, @Books, @Ref, @Events)",
                            ("@Date", (DatePicker.SelectedDate ?? DateTime.Today).Date), ("@Books", books), ("@Ref", references), ("@Events", events));
                        ShowSuccess("Запись сохранена!");
                    }
                }
                InitializeStats();
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { ShowError("Ошибка сохранения", ex); }
        }

        private void ParseStatsInput(out int books, out int references, out int events)
        {
            int.TryParse(BooksCountBox.Text, out books);
            int.TryParse(ReferencesCountBox.Text, out references);
            int.TryParse(EventsCountBox.Text, out events);
        }

        private bool CheckRecordExists(SqlConnection conn)
        {
            string sql = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM InformationServiseTb WHERE date_record = @Date";
            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
            {
                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Date", (DatePicker.SelectedDate ?? DateTime.Today).Date);
                return (int)cmd.ExecuteScalar() > 0;
            }
        }

        private void DeleteButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!_currentRecordId.HasValue) return;
            if (CustomMessageBox.Show("Удалить запись за этот день?", "Подтверждение",
                CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo, CustomMessageBoxImage.Question) != CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes) return;

            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    ExecuteNonQuery(conn, "DELETE FROM InformationServiseTb WHERE id_record = @ID", ("@ID", _currentRecordId.Value));
                }
                InitializeStats();
                ShowSuccess("Запись удалена!");
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { ShowError("Ошибка удаления", ex); }
        }

        public void SetDataFromRequest(int requestId, int userId, int? groupId, string userName, string groupCode, string lessonName, DateTime lessonDate)

            _pendingRequestId = requestId;

        private async void AutoFillFromRequest()
        {
            try
            {
                if (_pendingGroupId.HasValue && _pendingGroupId > 0)
                {
                    GroupTypeRadio.IsChecked = true;
                    await LoadAndSelectGroup(_pendingGroupCode);
                    await LoadAndSelectTeacher(_pendingUserId.Value, _pendingUserName);
                }
                else
                {
                    ReaderTypeRadio.IsChecked = true;
                    if (_pendingUserTypeId == 3)
                        await LoadAndSelectTeacher(_pendingUserId.Value, _pendingUserName);
                    else
                        await LoadAndSelectReader(_pendingUserId.Value, _pendingUserName);
                }

                await LoadRequestBooks(_pendingRequestId.Value);
                ShowSuccess($"Данные из заявки №{_pendingRequestId} загружены.");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка автозаполнения: {ex.Message}");
                ShowError("Ошибка загрузки данных из заявки", ex);
            }
        }

        private async Task LoadRequestBooks(int requestId)
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
            SELECT 
                MIN(ri.BookID) AS BookID,
                b.TitleBook,
                ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                SUM(ri.Quantity) AS Quantity
            FROM RequestItems ri
            JOIN Books b ON ri.BookID = b.IDBook
            LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
            WHERE ri.RequestID = @RequestId
            GROUP BY b.TitleBook, a.SurnameAuthor, a.NameAuthor, a.PatronymicAuthor";

                var booksFromRequest = new List<RequestBookItem>();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestId", requestId);
                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                booksFromRequest.Add(new RequestBookItem
                                {
                                    IDBook = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                    TitleBook = reader.GetString(1),
                                    AuthorName = reader.GetString(2),
                                    Quantity = reader.GetInt32(3)
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                foreach (var book in booksFromRequest)
                   book.AvailableCopies = await GetRealAvailableCopies(book.TitleBook, requestId);

                if (booksFromRequest.Any())
                {
                    var first = booksFromRequest.First();
                    var selected = _books.FirstOrDefault(b => b.TitleBook == first.TitleBook && b.AuthorName == first.AuthorName);

                    if (selected == null)
                    {
                        selected = new BookIssuanceService.BookInfo
                        {
                            IDBook = first.IDBook,
                            TitleBook = first.TitleBook,
                            AuthorName = first.AuthorName,
                            AvailableCopies = first.AvailableCopies
                        };
                        _books.Add(selected);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        selected.AvailableCopies = first.AvailableCopies;
                    }

                    _selectedBook = selected;
                    SelectedBookTitle.Text = selected.TitleBook;
                    SelectedBookAuthor.Text = selected.AuthorName;
                    SelectedBookPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    BookSearchBox.Text = selected.TitleBook;
                    BookSearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
                    AvailableQuantityText.Text = selected.AvailableCopies.ToString();
                    QuantityBox.Text = first.Quantity.ToString();
                    QuantityBox.IsEnabled = true;
                }
                else
                {
                    ShowWarning("В заявке нет книг для выдачи.");
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка LoadRequestBooks: {ex.Message}");
                ShowError("Ошибка загрузки книг из заявки", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Получение реального количества доступных экземпляров книги по названию.
        /// Для выдачи по заявке: исключает зарезервированные другими заявками,
        /// но включает зарезервированные ЭТОЙ заявкой.
        /// </summary>
        private async Task<int> GetRealAvailableCopies(string title, int? excludeRequestId = null)
        {
            try
            {
                string query;

                if (excludeRequestId.HasValue)
                {
                    // Для выдачи по заявке: исключаем зарезервированные другими заявками
                    query = @"
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM Books
                WHERE TitleBook = @Title
                  AND StatusBook NOT IN (
                      SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Списана%'
                  )
                  AND StatusBook NOT IN (
                      SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Утрачен%'
                  )
                  AND (
                     
                              StatusBook NOT IN(
                          SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Зарезервирована%'
                      )
                    
                              OR IDBook IN(
                          SELECT ri.BookID
                          FROM RequestItems ri
                          WHERE ri.RequestID = @ExcludeRequestId
                      )
                          )";
                }
                else
                {
                    // Для ручного поиска: исключаем все зарезервированные
                    query = @"
                SELECT COUNT(*)
                FROM Books
                WHERE TitleBook = @Title
                  AND StatusBook NOT IN (
                      SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Зарезервирована%'
                  )
                  AND StatusBook NOT IN (
                      SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Списана%'
                  )
                  AND StatusBook NOT IN (
                      SELECT ID_Status FROM StatusBook WHERE Title_Status LIKE '%Утрачен%'
                  )";
                }

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Title", title);
                        if (excludeRequestId.HasValue)
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ExcludeRequestId", excludeRequestId.Value);
                        var result = await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync();
                        return result != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(result) : 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка GetRealAvailableCopies: {ex.Message}");
                return 0;
            }
        }

        private async Task LoadAndSelectTeacher(int userId, string userName)
        {
            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    string query = "SELECT ReaderID, LastName, FirstName, MiddleName FROM ReaderForm WHERE ReaderID = @UserId";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserId", userId);
                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            if (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                _selectedTeacher = new BookIssuanceService.TeacherInfo
                                {
                                    TeacherID = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                    LastName = reader.GetString(1),
                                    FirstName = reader.GetString(2),
                                    MiddleName = reader["MiddleName"]?.ToString()
                                };
                                TeacherSearchBox.Text = _selectedTeacher.FullName;
                                TeacherSearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки преподавателя: {ex.Message}"); }
        }

        private async Task LoadAndSelectGroup(string groupCode)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(groupCode)) return;
            var group = _groups.FirstOrDefault(g => g.GroupCode == groupCode);
            if (group != null)
            {
                _selectedGroup = group;
                GroupSearchBox.Text = group.GroupCode;
                GroupSearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
                await LoadStudentsByGroup(group.GroupID);
            }
        }

        private async Task LoadStudentsByGroup(int groupId)
        {
            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    string query = @"SELECT DISTINCT rf.ReaderID, rf.LastName, rf.FirstName, rf.MiddleName, rf.CardNumber
                                     FROM ReaderForm rf WHERE rf.GroupID = @GroupId AND rf.TypeID = 1
                                     ORDER BY rf.LastName, rf.FirstName";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupId", groupId);
                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            _students.Clear();
                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                _students.Add(new BookIssuanceService.ReaderInfo
                                {
                                    ReaderID = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                    LastName = reader.GetString(1),
                                    FirstName = reader.GetString(2),
                                    MiddleName = reader["MiddleName"]?.ToString(),
                                    CardNumber = reader.GetString(4)
                                });
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки студентов: {ex.Message}"); }
        }

        private async Task LoadAndSelectReader(int userId, string userName)
        {
            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    string query = "SELECT ReaderID, LastName, FirstName, MiddleName, CardNumber FROM ReaderForm WHERE ReaderID = @UserId";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserId", userId);
                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            if (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                _selectedReader = new BookIssuanceService.ReaderInfo
                                {
                                    ReaderID = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                    LastName = reader.GetString(1),
                                    FirstName = reader.GetString(2),
                                    MiddleName = reader["MiddleName"]?.ToString(),
                                    CardNumber = reader.GetString(4)
                                };
                                ReaderSearchBox.Text = _selectedReader.DisplayInfo;
                                ReaderSearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки читателя: {ex.Message}"); }
        }

                if (ReturnDatePicker != null) ReturnDatePicker.SelectedDate = DateTime.Now.AddDays(14);

                if (ReaderSearchSection != null) ReaderSearchSection.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                if (GroupSearchSection != null) GroupSearchSection.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                if (ReturnDatePicker != null) ReturnDatePicker.SelectedDate = DateTime.Now.AddDays(30);

        }

        private void NumberValidationTextBox(object sender, TextCompositionEventArgs e) => e.Handled = !char.IsDigit(e.Text, 0);

        private void UpdateInventoryPreview()
        {
            if (_selectedBook == null) return;
            if (AvailableQuantityText != null) AvailableQuantityText.Text = _selectedBook.AvailableCopies.ToString();
            if (QuantityBox != null)
            {
                QuantityBox.IsEnabled = true;
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(QuantityBox.Text) || QuantityBox.Text == "0") QuantityBox.Text = "1";
                if (int.TryParse(QuantityBox.Text, out int qty) && qty > _selectedBook.AvailableCopies)
                    QuantityBox.Text = _selectedBook.AvailableCopies.ToString();
            }
        }

        private void ResetQuantity()
        {
            if (QuantityBox != null && _selectedBook != null) { QuantityBox.IsEnabled = true; QuantityBox.Text = "1"; }
        }

        {

        #region Вспомогательные методы UI

        private void ClearPlaceholder(TextBox box, string placeholder) { if (box.Text == placeholder) { box.Text = ""; box.Foreground = Brushes.Black; } }
        private void RestorePlaceholder(TextBox box, string placeholder, ListBox list) { if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(box.Text)) { box.Text = placeholder; box.Foreground = Brushes.Gray; list.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed; } }
        private bool IsPlaceholder(string text, string placeholder) => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text) || text == placeholder;
        private bool MatchReader(BookIssuanceService.ReaderInfo r, string search) { string s = search.ToLower(); return r.LastName.ToLower().Contains(s) || r.FirstName.ToLower().Contains(s) || r.CardNumber.ToLower().Contains(s); }
        private void ShowFilteredList(ListBox listBox, System.Collections.IList items) { if (items.Count > 0) { listBox.ItemsSource = items; listBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible; } else { listBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed; } }

        #endregion

        #region Вспомогательные методы БД и сообщений

        private void ExecuteNonQuery(SqlConnection conn, string sql, params (string, object)[] parameters)
        {
            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn)) { foreach (var p in parameters) cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue(p.Item1, p.Item2); cmd.ExecuteNonQuery(); }
        }

        private void ExecuteNonQuery(SqlConnection conn, string sql, SqlTransaction transaction, params (string, object)[] parameters)
        {
            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn, transaction)) { foreach (var p in parameters) cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue(p.Item1, p.Item2); cmd.ExecuteNonQuery(); }
        }

        private void ShowWarning(string message) => CustomMessageBox.Show(message, "Предупреждение", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
        private void ShowSuccess(string message) => CustomMessageBox.Show(message, "Успех", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
        private void ShowError(string title, Exception ex) => CustomMessageBox.Show($"{title}: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);

        #endregion
    }

﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;
using System;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using Microsoft.Win32;
using Excel = Microsoft.Office.Interop.Excel;
using Diplom_Bibl.Helpers;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class InventoryActReport : Page
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;
        private ObservableCollection<BookInventoryItem> _books;

        // Удаляем приватное поле _bookcategory — теперь используем публичное свойство

        private int _nextRowNumber = 1;

        // Публичное свойство для привязки данных
        public ObservableCollection<CategoryBooksItems> BookCategories { get; set; }

        public class BookInventoryItem
        {
            public int IDBook { get; set; }
            public int RowNumber { get; set; }
            public string BookFullTitle { get; set; } = "";
            public int YearPublishing { get; set; }
            public decimal Price { get; set; }
            public string InventaryNumber { get; set; } = "";
            public string Category { get; set; } = "";
            public string VerificationStatus { get; set; } = "В наличии";
            public string ReasonMissing { get; set; } = "";
            public bool CanEdit { get; set; } = true;
        }

        public class CategoryBooksItems
        {
            public int ID_Category { get; set; }
            public string CategoryName { get; set; }
            public string Description { get; set; }
        }

        public ObservableCollection<string> StatusOptions { get; set; }

        public InventoryActReport()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            StatusOptions = new ObservableCollection<string> { "В наличии", "Отсутствует" };

            // Инициализация коллекции категорий
            BookCategories = new ObservableCollection<CategoryBooksItems>();

            DataContext = this;
        }

        private async void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            try
            {
                StartDatePicker.SelectedDate = DateTime.Now.AddMonths(-1);
                EndDatePicker.SelectedDate = DateTime.Now;
                await LoadLibrarySettings();
                await LoadCommissionInfo();
                await LoadBooks();
                await LoadBookCatigories();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadLibrarySettings()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT TOP 1 OrganizationName FROM LibrarySettings ORDER BY ID_Setting";
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        var result = await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync();
                        if (result != null)
                        {
                            OrganizationName.Text = result.ToString();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки настроек: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadCommissionInfo()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = @"
                    SELECT TOP 1 ChairmanName, ChairmanPosition, 
                           Member1Name, Member1Position,
                           Member2Name, Member2Position,
                           OrderNumber, OrderDate
                    FROM InventoryCommissions WHERE IsActive = 1
                    ORDER BY CommissionDate DESC";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                    {
                        if (await reader.ReadAsync())
                        {
                            ChairmanInfo.Text = $"Председатель: {reader["ChairmanPosition"]} {reader["ChairmanName"]}";

                            string member1 = reader["Member1Name"]?.ToString();
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(member1))
                                Member1Info.Text = $"Члены комиссии: {reader["Member1Position"]} {member1}";

                            string member2 = reader["Member2Name"]?.ToString();
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(member2))
                                Member2Info.Text = $"{reader["Member2Position"]} {member2}";

                            string orderNumber = reader["OrderNumber"]?.ToString();
                            DateTime? orderDate = reader["OrderDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["OrderDate"]) : (DateTime?)null;

                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(orderNumber) && orderDate.HasValue)
                            {
                                OrderInfo.Text = $"Основание: приказ {orderNumber} от {orderDate.Value:dd.MM.yyyy}";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки комиссии: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadBooks()
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
                    SELECT 
                        b.IDBook,
                        CONCAT(a.SurnameAuthor, ' ', a.NameAuthor, ' ', ISNULL(a.PatronymicAuthor, ''), ' — ', b.TitleBook) AS BookFullTitle,
                        b.YearPublishing,
                        ISNULL(b.Price, 0) AS Price,
                        b.InventaryNumber,
                        bc.CategoryName AS Category
                    FROM Books b
                    LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                    LEFT JOIN BookCategories bc ON b.CategoryID = bc.ID_Category
                    ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

                _books = new ObservableCollection<BookInventoryItem>();
                int rowNum = 1;

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                    {
                        while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                        {
                            _books.Add(new BookInventoryItem
                            {
                                IDBook = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                RowNumber = rowNum++,
                                BookFullTitle = reader.GetString(1),
                                YearPublishing = reader.GetInt32(2),
                                Price = reader.GetDecimal(3),
                                InventaryNumber = reader.GetString(4),
                                Category = reader.IsDBNull(5) ? "Не указана" : reader.GetString(5),
                                VerificationStatus = "В наличии",
                                ReasonMissing = ""
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                _nextRowNumber = rowNum;
                ApplyFilters();
                UpdateTotals();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки книг: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadBookCatigories()
        {
            return LoadBookCatigories(CategoryFilterCombo);
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadBookCatigories(ComboBox categoryFilterCombo)
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
            SELECT 
                bc.ID_Category,            
                bc.CategoryName AS Category
            FROM BookCategories bc
            ORDER BY bc.CategoryName";

                // Очищаем существующую коллекцию
                BookCategories.Clear();

                // Добавляем «Все книги» как первый элемент
                BookCategories.Add(new CategoryBooksItems
                {
                    ID_Category = -1, // специальный ID для фильтра «Все»
                    CategoryName = "Все книги"
                });

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                    {
                        while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                        {
                            BookCategories.Add(new CategoryBooksItems
                            {
                                ID_Category = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                CategoryName = reader.IsDBNull(1) ? "Не указана" : reader.GetString(1),
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                ApplyFilters();
                UpdateTotals();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки категории книг: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }




        private void ApplyFilters()
        {
            if (_books == null) return;

            var filtered = _books.AsEnumerable();

            string statusFilter = (StatusFilterCombo.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem)?.Content?.ToString() ?? "Все книги";
            if (statusFilter == "В наличии")
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.VerificationStatus == "В наличии");
            else if (statusFilter == "Отсутствуют")
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.VerificationStatus == "Отсутствует");

            string categoryFilter = (CategoryFilterCombo.SelectedItem as ComboBoxItem)?.Content?.ToString() ?? "Все книги";
            if (categoryFilter != "Все книги")
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.Category == categoryFilter);

            BooksDataGrid.ItemsSource = filtered.ToList();
            UpdateTotals();
        }

        private void UpdateTotals()
        {
            var currentList = BooksDataGrid.ItemsSource as System.Collections.IEnumerable;
            if (currentList == null) return;

            var list = currentList.Cast<BookInventoryItem>().ToList();
            TotalBooksCount.Text = list.Count.ToString();
            BooksPresentCount.Text = list.Count(b => b.VerificationStatus == "В наличии").ToString();
            BooksMissingCount.Text = list.Count(b => b.VerificationStatus == "Отсутствует").ToString();
        }

        private void StatusFilter_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void CategoryFilter_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyFilters();
        }

        private void GenerateReport_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_books == null || _books.Count == 0)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Нет данных для формирования отчета.", "Информация",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            CustomMessageBox.Show("Акт сформирован. Проверьте данные в таблице и при необходимости отредактируйте статус проверки.\n\nЗатем экспортируйте в Excel.",
                "Отчет готов", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
        }

        private void ExportToExcel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            var items = BooksDataGrid.ItemsSource as System.Collections.IEnumerable;
            if (items == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Нет данных для экспорта.", "Информация",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            var data = items.Cast<BookInventoryItem>().ToList();
            if (data.Count == 0)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Нет данных для экспорта.", "Информация",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            SaveFileDialog saveFileDialog = new SaveFileDialog
            {
                Filter = "Excel файлы (*.xlsx)|*.xlsx",
                FileName = $"Акт_проверки_фонда_{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd_HHmm}.xlsx"
            };

            if (saveFileDialog.ShowDialog() == true)
            {
                try
                {
                    ExportToExcel(data, saveFileDialog.FileName);
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Отчёт сохранён:\n{saveFileDialog.FileName}", "Успешно",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка экспорта: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                }
            }
        }

        private void ExportToExcel(System.Collections.Generic.List<BookInventoryItem> data, string filePath)
        {
            Excel.Application excelApp = null;
            Excel.Workbook workbook = null;
            Excel.Worksheet worksheet = null;

            try
            {
                excelApp = new Excel.Application();
                excelApp.Visible = false;

                workbook = excelApp.Workbooks.Add();
                worksheet = workbook.ActiveSheet;
                worksheet.Name = "Акт проверки фонда";

                int currentRow = 1;

                // Заголовок организации
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = OrganizationName.Text;
                var titleRange = (Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1];
                titleRange.Font.Bold = true;
                titleRange.Font.Size = 14;
                titleRange.Merge(worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 7]);
                currentRow += 2;

                // Название акта
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = $"АКТ № ___ от \"__\" _______ 20__ г.";
                titleRange = (Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1];
                titleRange.Font.Bold = true;
                titleRange.Font.Size = 16;
                titleRange.Merge(worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 7]);
                currentRow++;

                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = "проверки библиотечного фонда";
                titleRange = (Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1];
                titleRange.Font.Size = 14;
                titleRange.Merge(worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 7]);
                currentRow += 2;

                // Основание
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = OrderInfo.Text;
                currentRow += 2;

                // Заголовки таблицы
                string[] headers = { "№ п/п", "Автор, заглавие", "Год издания", "Цена", "Инвентарный номер", "Отметка о проверке", "Причина отсутствия" };
                for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
                {
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, i + 1] = headers[i];
                    var range = (Excel.Range)worksheet.Cells[currentRow, i + 1];
                    range.Font.Bold = true;
                    range.Interior.Color = System.Drawing.Color.LightGray.ToArgb();
                }
                currentRow++;

                // Данные
                foreach (var item in data)
                {
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = item.RowNumber;
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 2] = item.BookFullTitle;
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 3] = item.YearPublishing;
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 4] = item.Price;
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 5] = item.InventaryNumber;
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 6] = item.VerificationStatus;
                    worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 7] = item.ReasonMissing;
                    currentRow++;
                }

                // Итоги
                currentRow++;
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 1] = "Итого проверено книг:";
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 2] = data.Count;
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 3] = "В наличии:";
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 4] = data.Count(b => b.VerificationStatus == "В наличии");
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 5] = "Отсутствует:";
                worksheet.Cells[currentRow, 6] = data.Count(b => b.VerificationStatus == "Отсутствует");

                worksheet.Columns.AutoFit();
                workbook.SaveAs(filePath, Excel.XlFileFormat.xlOpenXMLWorkbook);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (worksheet != null) System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(worksheet);
                if (workbook != null)
                {
                    workbook.Close(false);
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(workbook);
                }
                if (excelApp != null)
                {
                    excelApp.Quit();
                    System.Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal.ReleaseComObject(excelApp);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

        public class BookSearchItem
        {
            public int IDBook { get; set; }
            public string DisplayName { get; set; }
            public string TitleBook { get; set; }
            public string AuthorName { get; set; }
        }

        public class AuthorFilterItem
        {
            public int ID_Author { get; set; }
            public string DisplayAuthors { get; set; }
        }

        public class BookGroupItem
        {
            public int GroupId { get; set; }
            public string TitleBook { get; set; }
            public string AuthorName { get; set; }
            public int? AuthorID { get; set; }
            public int YearPublishing { get; set; }
            public string PublishingHouseName { get; set; }
            public int? PublisherID { get; set; }
            public string GenreName { get; set; }
            public int? GenreID { get; set; }
            public int TotalCopies { get; set; }
            public int AvailableCopies { get; set; }
            public int IssuedCopies { get; set; }
            public int DisposedCopies { get; set; }
            public string StatusName { get; set; }
            public int? StatusID { get; set; }
            public List<int> BookIds { get; set; }

            private SolidColorBrush _statusColor;
            private string _statusText;

            /// <summary>
            /// Цвет статуса:
            /// - Зеленый (#28A745) - если есть книги в наличии
            /// - Желтый (#FFC107) - если есть выданные книги
            /// - Красный (#DC3545) - если все книги списаны
            /// </summary>
            public SolidColorBrush StatusColor
            {
                get
                {
                    if (_statusColor != null) return _statusColor;

                    if (AvailableCopies > 0 && IssuedCopies == 0)
                        _statusColor = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#28A745"));
                    else if (AvailableCopies > 0 && IssuedCopies > 0)
                        _statusColor = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#FFC107"));
                    else if (AvailableCopies == 0 && IssuedCopies > 0)
                        _statusColor = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#DC3545"));
                    else
                        _statusColor = new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#6C757D"));

                    return _statusColor;
                }
            }

            /// <summary>
            /// Текст статуса для отображения
            /// </summary>
            public string StatusText
            {
                get
                {
                    if (AvailableCopies > 0 && IssuedCopies == 0)
                        return "В наличии";
                    else if (AvailableCopies > 0 && IssuedCopies > 0)
                        return "Частично выдана";
                    else if (AvailableCopies == 0 && IssuedCopies > 0)
                        return "Выдана";
                    else
                        return "Списана";
                }
            }
        }

        }

        // ==================== ПОИСК И ФИЛЬТРАЦИЯ ====================

        private void SetSearchPlaceholder()
        {
            _isSearchPlaceholderActive = true;
            CbBookSearch.Text = "Введите название книги или автора...";
            CbBookSearch.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
        }

        private void ClearSearchPlaceholder()
        {
            if (_isSearchPlaceholderActive)
            {
                _isSearchPlaceholderActive = false;
                CbBookSearch.Text = "";
                CbBookSearch.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
            }
        }

        private void CbBookSearch_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            ClearSearchPlaceholder();
        }

        private void CbBookSearch_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(CbBookSearch.Text))
            {
                SetSearchPlaceholder();
                if (!_isBookSearchProgrammatic)
                {
                    ApplyAllFilters();
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Обработчик нажатия клавиш в ComboBox (для Backspace)
        /// </summary>
        private void CbBookSearch_PreviewKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            var comboBox = sender as ComboBox;
            if (comboBox == null) return;

            // Очистка при нажатии Backspace или Delete
            if (e.Key == Key.Back || e.Key == Key.Delete)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(comboBox.Text) || comboBox.Text.Length <= 1)
                {
                    SetSearchPlaceholder();
                    ApplyAllFilters();
                }
            }
            // Очистка при нажатии Escape
            else if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
            {
                SetSearchPlaceholder();
                ApplyAllFilters();
                e.Handled = true;
            }
        }

        private void CbBookSearch_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (CbBookSearch.SelectedItem is BookSearchItem selectedBook)
            {
                _isBookSearchProgrammatic = true;
                CbBookSearch.Text = selectedBook.TitleBook;
                ApplyAllFilters();
                _isBookSearchProgrammatic = false;
            }
        }

        // ==================== ЗАГРУЗКА ДАННЫХ ====================

        private void LoadBooksForSearch()
        {
            try
            {
                string sql = @"
                    SELECT DISTINCT
                        MIN(b.IDBook) AS IDBook,
                        b.TitleBook,
                        ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName
                    FROM Books b
                    LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                    WHERE b.StatusBook != 5
                    GROUP BY b.TitleBook, a.SurnameAuthor, a.NameAuthor, a.PatronymicAuthor
                    ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

                _allBooksForSearch.Clear();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            string title = reader["TitleBook"].ToString();
                            string author = reader["AuthorName"].ToString();

                            _allBooksForSearch.Add(new BookSearchItem
                            {
                                IDBook = Convert.ToInt32(reader["IDBook"]),
                                TitleBook = title,
                                AuthorName = author,
                                DisplayName = $"{title} - {author}".TrimEnd(' ', '-')
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                CbBookSearch.ItemsSource = _allBooksForSearch;
                CbBookSearch.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayName";
                CbBookSearch.SelectedValuePath = "IDBook";
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки списка книг: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private void LoadAuthorsForFilter()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT ID_Autor, SurnameAuthor, NameAuthor, PatronymicAuthor FROM Authors ORDER BY SurnameAuthor";

                _allAuthors.Clear();
                _allAuthors.Add(new AuthorFilterItem { ID_Author = 0, DisplayAuthors = "Все авторы" });

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            int id = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Autor"]);
                            string surname = reader["SurnameAuthor"].ToString();
                            string name = reader["NameAuthor"].ToString();
                            string patronymic = reader["PatronymicAuthor"]?.ToString() ?? "";

                            _allAuthors.Add(new AuthorFilterItem
                            {
                                ID_Author = id,
                                DisplayAuthors = $"{surname} {name} {patronymic}".Trim()
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                FilterAuthorCombo.ItemsSource = _allAuthors;
                FilterAuthorCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID_Author";
                FilterAuthorCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayAuthors";
                FilterAuthorCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки авторов: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadStatuses()
        {
            try
            {
                const string sql = "SELECT ID_Status, TRIM(Title_Status) AS Title_Status FROM StatusBook ORDER BY Title_Status";

                _allStatuses.Clear();
                _allStatuses.Add(new StatusItem { ID_Status = 0, Title_Status = "Все статусы" });

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            _allStatuses.Add(new StatusItem
                            {
                                ID_Status = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ID_Status"]),
                                Title_Status = reader["Title_Status"].ToString().Trim()
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                FilterStatusCombo.ItemsSource = _allStatuses;
                FilterStatusCombo.DisplayMemberPath = "DisplayName";
                FilterStatusCombo.SelectedValuePath = "ID_Status";
                FilterStatusCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;

            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки статусов: {ex.Message}",
                   "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadBooks()
        {
            try
            {
                string sql = @"
                    SELECT 
                        MIN(b.IDBook) AS GroupId,
                        b.TitleBook,
                        ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                        MIN(b.Author) AS AuthorID,
                        MIN(b.YearPublishing) AS YearPublishing,
                        MIN(p.TitlePublishingHouse) AS PublishingHouseName,
                        MIN(b.PublishingHouse) AS PublisherID,
                        MIN(g.TitleGener) AS GenreName,
                        MIN(b.Gener) AS GenreID,
                        COUNT(*) AS TotalCopies,
                        SUM(CASE WHEN s.Title_Status LIKE '%В наличии%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AvailableCopies,
                        SUM(CASE WHEN s.Title_Status LIKE '%Выдан%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IssuedCopies,
                        SUM(CASE WHEN s.Title_Status LIKE '%Списана%' OR s.Title_Status LIKE '%Утрачен%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DisposedCopies,
                        MAX(s.Title_Status) AS StatusName,
                        MAX(b.StatusBook) AS StatusID
                    FROM Books b
                    LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                    LEFT JOIN PublishingHouse p ON b.PublishingHouse = p.IDPublishingHouse
                    LEFT JOIN GenersBook g ON b.Gener = g.ID_Gener
                    LEFT JOIN StatusBook s ON b.StatusBook = s.ID_Status
                    GROUP BY b.TitleBook, a.SurnameAuthor, a.NameAuthor, a.PatronymicAuthor
                    ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

                var yearsSet = new HashSet<int>();
                _allBooks.Clear();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            var book = new BookGroupItem
                            {
                                GroupId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["GroupId"]),
                                TitleBook = reader["TitleBook"].ToString(),
                                AuthorName = reader["AuthorName"].ToString(),
                                AuthorID = reader["AuthorID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["AuthorID"]) : (int?)null,
                                YearPublishing = Convert.ToInt32(reader["YearPublishing"]),
                                PublishingHouseName = reader["PublishingHouseName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                PublisherID = reader["PublisherID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["PublisherID"]) : (int?)null,
                                GenreName = reader["GenreName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                GenreID = reader["GenreID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["GenreID"]) : (int?)null,
                                TotalCopies = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalCopies"]),
                                AvailableCopies = Convert.ToInt32(reader["AvailableCopies"]),
                                IssuedCopies = Convert.ToInt32(reader["IssuedCopies"]),
                                DisposedCopies = Convert.ToInt32(reader["DisposedCopies"]),
                                StatusName = reader["StatusName"]?.ToString() ?? "Неизвестно",
                                StatusID = reader["StatusID"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["StatusID"]) : (int?)null,
                                BookIds = new List<int>()
                            };

                            _allBooks.Add(book);

                            if (book.YearPublishing > 0)
                                yearsSet.Add(book.YearPublishing);
                        }
                    }
                }

                LoadAuthorsForFilter();
                LoadStatuses();
                LoadGenres();
                LoadPublishers();
                LoadBooksForSearch();
                LoadYearFilters(yearsSet.ToList());

                ApplyAllFilters();
                UpdateStatistics();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки книг: {ex.Message}",
                   "Ошибка", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadYearFilters(List<int> years)
        {
            FilterYearCombo.Items.Clear();
            FilterYearCombo.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem { Content = "Все годы", IsSelected = true });

            foreach (var year in years.OrderByDescending(y => y))
            {
                FilterYearCombo.Items.Add(new ComboBoxItem { Content = year.ToString() });
            }

            FilterYearCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
        }

        // ==================== ПРИМЕНЕНИЕ ФИЛЬТРОВ ====================

        private void ApplyAllFilters()
        {
            if (_allBooks == null || _allBooks.Count == 0) return;

            string searchTerm = _isSearchPlaceholderActive ? "" : CbBookSearch.Text?.Trim().ToLower() ?? "";

            int selectedAuthorId = GetSelectedAuthorId();
            int selectedStatusId = GetSelectedId(FilterStatusCombo);
            int selectedGenreId = GetSelectedId(FilterGenreCombo);
            int selectedPublisherId = GetSelectedId(FilterPublisherCombo);

            string yearFilter = "Все годы";
            if (FilterYearCombo.SelectedItem is ComboBoxItem yearItem)
            {
                yearFilter = yearItem.Content.ToString();
            }

            var filtered = _allBooks.AsEnumerable();

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchTerm))
            {
                filtered = filtered.Where(b =>
                    b.TitleBook.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm) ||
                    b.AuthorName.ToLower().Contains(searchTerm));
            }

            if (selectedAuthorId > 0)
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.AuthorID == selectedAuthorId);

            if (selectedStatusId > 0)
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.StatusID == selectedStatusId);

            if (selectedGenreId > 0)
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.GenreID == selectedGenreId);

            if (selectedPublisherId > 0)
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.PublisherID == selectedPublisherId);

            if (yearFilter != "Все годы" && int.TryParse(yearFilter, out int year))
                filtered = filtered.Where(b => b.YearPublishing == year);

            var resultList = filtered.ToList();

            _filteredBooks.Clear();
            foreach (var item in resultList)
                _filteredBooks.Add(item);

            DgBooks.ItemsSource = _filteredBooks;
            SearchCountLabel.Text = $"Найдено: {resultList.Count} из {_allBooks.Count} наименований";
        }

        private int GetSelectedAuthorId()
        {
            if (FilterAuthorCombo.SelectedValue != null && int.TryParse(FilterAuthorCombo.SelectedValue.ToString(), out int id))
                return id;
            return 0;
        }

        private int GetSelectedId(ComboBox comboBox)
        {
            if (comboBox.SelectedValue != null && int.TryParse(comboBox.SelectedValue.ToString(), out int id))
                return id;
            return 0;
        }

        // ==================== СТАТИСТИКА ====================

        private void UpdateStatistics()
        {
            if (_allBooks == null || _allBooks.Count == 0) return;

            TotalBooksCount.Text = _allBooks.Count.ToString();

            int totalCopies = _allBooks.Sum(b => b.TotalCopies);
            int availableCopies = _allBooks.Sum(b => b.AvailableCopies);
            int issuedCopies = _allBooks.Sum(b => b.IssuedCopies);
            int disposedCopies = _allBooks.Sum(b => b.DisposedCopies);

            TotalCopiesCount.Text = totalCopies.ToString();
            AvailableBooksCount.Text = availableCopies.ToString();
            IssuedBooksCount.Text = issuedCopies.ToString();
            DisposedBooksCount.Text = disposedCopies.ToString();
        }

        // ==================== ОБРАБОТЧИКИ ====================

        private void FilterCombo_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            ApplyAllFilters();
        }

        private void ClearFiltersBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            FilterAuthorCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterStatusCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterGenreCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterPublisherCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            FilterYearCombo.SelectedIndex = 0;
            SetSearchPlaceholder();
            ApplyAllFilters();
        }

        private void DgBooks_MouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!(DgBooks.SelectedItem is BookGroupItem selectedBook)) return;

            try
            {
                Mouse.OverrideCursor = Cursors.Wait;
                int firstBookId = GetFirstBookIdByGroup(selectedBook.TitleBook, selectedBook.AuthorName);
                if (firstBookId > 0)
                {
                    NavigationService?.Navigate(new AddBook(firstBookId));
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при открытии книги: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                Mouse.OverrideCursor = null;
            }
        }

        private int GetFirstBookIdByGroup(string title, string authorName)
        {
            try
            {
                string sql = @"
                    SELECT TOP 1 b.IDBook
                    FROM Books b
                    LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                    WHERE b.TitleBook = @Title 
                      AND ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') = @AuthorName";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_conn))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Title", title);
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@AuthorName", authorName);
                        var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                        return result != null ? Convert.ToInt32(result) : 0;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                return 0;
            }
        }

        // ==================== НАВИГАЦИЯ ====================

        private void AdmissionBook_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.Navigate(new AdmissionBook());
        }

        private void AddBook_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.Navigate(new AddBook());
        }

        private void DisposalBook_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.Navigate(new DisposalAct());
        }

        private void BulkAddBook_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.Navigate(new BulkAddBooks());
        }

        private void FundMovementBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            NavigationService?.Navigate(new FundMovementPage());
        }

        private void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            LoadBooks();
        }
    }
}
