        /// <summary>
        /// Загрузка данных пользователя и определение видимости панели группы
        /// </summary>
        private void LoadUserData()
        {
            try
            {
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    string typeQuery = "SELECT TypeName FROM ReaderType WHERE TypeID = @TypeID";
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(typeQuery, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TypeID", _currentUserTypeId);
                        var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();
                        TbUserType.Text = result?.ToString() ?? "";
                    }
                }

                // Для преподавателей (TypeID = 3) показываем выбор группы
                if (_currentUserTypeId == 3)
                {
                    GroupPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
                    LoadGroups();
                }
                else
                {
                    GroupPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки данных: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void LoadGroups()
        {
            try
            {
                const string query = "SELECT GroupID, GroupCode FROM Groups ORDER BY GroupCode";
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        var groups = new ObservableCollection<GroupItem>();

                        // Отладочный вывод - посмотрим сколько колонок
                        for (int i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
                        {
                            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Колонка {i}: {reader.GetName(i)} - Тип: {reader.GetFieldType(i)}");
                        }

                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            // Пробуем разные способы чтения
                            object groupIdObj = reader[0];  // Первая колонка
                            object groupCodeObj = reader[1]; // Вторая колонка

                            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"GroupID: {groupIdObj} (тип: {groupIdObj?.GetType()})");
                            System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"GroupCode: {groupCodeObj} (тип: {groupCodeObj?.GetType()})");

                            int groupId = Convert.ToInt32(groupIdObj);
                            string groupCode = groupCodeObj?.ToString() ?? "";

                            groups.Add(new GroupItem
                            {
                                GroupID = groupId,
                                GroupCode = groupCode
                            });
                        }
                        CbGroup.ItemsSource = groups;
                        CbGroup.DisplayMemberPath = "GroupCode";
                        CbGroup.SelectedValuePath = "GroupID";
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки групп: {ex.Message}\n{ex.StackTrace}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }
        #endregion

        #region Работа с книгами

        /// <summary>
        /// Загрузка доступных книг (сгруппированных по названию и автору)
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="searchTerm">Поисковый запрос</param>
        private void LoadAvailableBooks(string searchTerm = "")
        {
            try
            {
                string query = @"
            SELECT 
                MIN(b.IDBook) AS IDBook,
                b.TitleBook, 
                ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                SUM(dbo.fn_GetActuallyAvailableForRequest(b.IDBook)) AS AvailableCopies
            FROM Books b
            LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
            WHERE dbo.fn_GetActuallyAvailableForRequest(b.IDBook) > 0";

                // Условие поиска добавляется ДО GROUP BY
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
                {
                    query += " AND (b.TitleBook LIKE @Search OR a.SurnameAuthor LIKE @Search)";
                }

                query += @" GROUP BY b.TitleBook, a.SurnameAuthor, a.NameAuthor, a.PatronymicAuthor
                    ORDER BY b.TitleBook";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(query, conn))
                    {
                        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(searchTerm))
                        {
                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Search", $"%{searchTerm}%");
                        }

                        using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                        {
                            _availableBooks = new ObservableCollection<BookItem>();
                            while (reader.Read())
                            {
                                int available = reader.GetInt32(3);
                                if (available > 0)
                                {
                                    _availableBooks.Add(new BookItem
                                    {
                                        IDBook = reader.GetInt32(0),
                                        TitleBook = reader.GetString(1),
                                        AuthorName = reader.GetString(2),
                                        AvailableCopies = available
                                    });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                DgAvailableBooks.ItemsSource = _availableBooks;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки книг: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Добавление книги в заявку
        /// </summary>
        private void AddBookToRequest(BookItem book)
        {
            if (_selectedBooks == null)
                _selectedBooks = new ObservableCollection<SelectedBookItem>();

            int actualAvailable = book.AvailableCopies;

            if (actualAvailable <= 0)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Книга '{book.TitleBook}' временно недоступна.",
                    "Книга недоступна", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return;
            }

            // Проверяем, не добавлена ли уже эта книга
            SelectedBookItem existing = _selectedBooks.FirstOrDefault(b => b.BookTitle == book.TitleBook && b.AuthorName == book.AuthorName);

            if (existing != null)
            {
                // Увеличиваем количество, если не превышает доступное
                if (existing.Quantity + 1 <= actualAvailable)
                    existing.Quantity++;
                else
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Доступно только {actualAvailable} экземпляров этой книги.", "Предупреждение",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
            }
            else
            {
                // Добавляем новую книгу
                _selectedBooks.Add(new SelectedBookItem
                {
                    IDBook = book.IDBook,
                    BookTitle = book.TitleBook,
                    AuthorName = book.AuthorName,
                    Quantity = 1,
                    MaxQuantity = actualAvailable
                });
            }

            DgSelectedBooks.ItemsSource = _selectedBooks;
            UpdateTotalCount();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Обновление общего количества выбранных книг
        /// </summary>
        private void UpdateTotalCount()
        {
            int total = _selectedBooks?.Sum(b => b.Quantity) ?? 0;
            TbTotalBooks.Text = total.ToString();
        }

        #endregion

        #region Генерация номера заявки

        /// <summary>
        /// Генерация уникального номера заявки в формате ЗАЯВ-ГГГГММДД-XXXX
        /// </summary>
        private string GenerateUniqueRequestNumber()
        {
            try
            {
                string datePart = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd");
                int sequence = 1;

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    conn.Open();
                    string sql = @"
                        SELECT TOP 1 RequestNumber 
                        FROM BookRequests 
                        WHERE RequestNumber LIKE @Pattern 
                        ORDER BY ID_Request DESC";

                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Pattern", $"ЗАЯВ-{datePart}-%");
                        var result = cmd.ExecuteScalar();

                        if (result != null && result != DBNull.Value)
                        {
                            string lastNumber = result.ToString();
                            int lastDashIndex = lastNumber.LastIndexOf('-');
                            if (lastDashIndex >= 0 && lastDashIndex + 1 < lastNumber.Length)
                            {
                                string seqStr = lastNumber.Substring(lastDashIndex + 1);
                                if (int.TryParse(seqStr, out int lastSeq))
                                    sequence = lastSeq + 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                return $"ЗАЯВ-{datePart}-{sequence:D4}";
            }
            catch
            {
                // В случае ошибки генерируем случайный номер
                return $"ЗАЯВ-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd}-{new Random().Next(1, 9999):D4}";
            }
        }

        #endregion

        /// <summary>
        /// Удаление книги из заявки
        /// </summary>
        private void BtnRemoveBook_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (sender is Button button && button.DataContext is SelectedBookItem selectedBook && _selectedBooks != null)
            {
                _selectedBooks.Remove(selectedBook);
                DgSelectedBooks.ItemsSource = _selectedBooks;
                UpdateTotalCount();
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Изменение количества экземпляров книги
        /// </summary>
        private void Quantity_ValueChanged(object sender, RoutedPropertyChangedEventArgs<object> e)
        {
            if (sender is IntegerUpDown spinner && spinner.DataContext is SelectedBookItem book)
            {
                int newValue = spinner.Value ?? 1;
                if (newValue < 1)
                    spinner.Value = 1;
                if (newValue > book.MaxQuantity)
                {
                    CustomMessageBox.Show($"Доступно только {book.MaxQuantity} экземпляров этой книги.", "Предупреждение",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                    spinner.Value = book.MaxQuantity;
                }
                book.Quantity = spinner.Value ?? 1;
                UpdateTotalCount();
            }
        }

                if (NavigationService != null && NavigationService.CanGoBack)

                else
                    Application.Current.MainWindow?.Close();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        #region Валидация и отправка заявки

        /// <summary>
        /// Валидация формы перед отправкой
        /// </summary>
        private bool ValidateForm()
        {
            // Проверка названия занятия
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TbLessonName.Text))
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Введите название занятия/предмета.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }

            // Проверка даты занятия
            if (!DpLessonDateSimple.SelectedDate.HasValue)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите дату занятия.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }

            // Дату нельзя выбрать раньше сегодня
            if (DpLessonDateSimple.SelectedDate.Value.Date < DateTime.Today)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Дата занятия не может быть раньше сегодняшнего дня.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }

            // Для преподавателя обязателен выбор группы
            if (_currentUserTypeId == 3 && CbGroup.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите группу.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }

            // Проверка выбора пары
            if (CbLessonPeriod.SelectedItem == null)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Выберите пару / время занятия.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }

            // Проверка наличия выбранных книг
            if (_selectedBooks == null || _selectedBooks.Count == 0)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show("Добавьте хотя бы одну книгу в заявку.", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Warning);
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Отправка заявки (основной метод сохранения)
        /// </summary>
        private async void BtnSubmitRequest_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Валидация формы
            if (!ValidateForm()) return;

            // Блокируем кнопку, чтобы избежать повторной отправки
            BtnSubmitRequest.IsEnabled = false;

            try
            {
                // Получаем ID группы (только для преподавателей)
                int? groupId = CbGroup.SelectedValue != null ? Convert.ToInt32(CbGroup.SelectedValue) : (int?)null;

                // Дата занятия (без времени)
                DateTime lessonDate = DpLessonDateSimple.SelectedDate.Value.Date;

                // Время занятия (выбранная пара)
                string lessonTime = null;
                if (CbLessonPeriod.SelectedItem is SchedulePeriodItem selectedPeriod)
                {
                    lessonTime = selectedPeriod.StartTime;
                }

                // Генерация уникального номера заявки
                string generatedNumber = GenerateUniqueRequestNumber();

                // Подключение к базе данных
                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();

                    // Начинаем транзакцию для согласованности данных
                    using (var transaction = conn.BeginTransaction())
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            string insertRequestSql = @"
     INSERT INTO BookRequests (
         RequestNumber, UserID, UserTypeID, GroupID, LessonName, 
         LessonDate, LessonTime, StatusID, RequestDate, ExpirationDate, CreatedDate
     ) VALUES (
         @RequestNumber, @UserID, @UserTypeID, @GroupID, @LessonName,
         @LessonDate, @LessonTime, 
         (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Новая'),
         GETDATE(), DATEADD(DAY, 1, @LessonDate), GETDATE()
     );
     SELECT SCOPE_IDENTITY();";

                            int requestId;
                            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(insertRequestSql, conn, transaction))
                            {
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestNumber", generatedNumber);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserID", _currentReaderId);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserTypeID", _currentUserTypeId);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupID", groupId.HasValue ? (object)groupId.Value : DBNull.Value);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@LessonName", TbLessonName.Text.Trim());
                                cmd.Parameters.Add("@LessonDate", SqlDbType.Date).Value = lessonDate;
                                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(lessonTime) && TimeSpan.TryParse(lessonTime, out TimeSpan parsedTime))
                                    {
                                    cmd.Parameters.Add("@LessonTime", SqlDbType.Time).Value = parsedTime;
                                    }
                                else
                                    {
                                    cmd.Parameters.Add("@LessonTime", SqlDbType.Time).Value = DBNull.Value;
                                    }
                                // Временная отладка — скопируй этот текст и выполни в SSMS
                                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("=== SQL DEBUG ===");
                                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine(cmd.CommandText);
                                foreach (SqlParameter p in cmd.Parameters)
                                {
                                    System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"{p.ParameterName} = {p.Value} (Type: {p.SqlDbType})");
                                }
                                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine("=== END SQL DEBUG ===");
                                requestId = Convert.ToInt32(await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync());
                            }

                            // 2. Вставка книг в заявку
                            string insertItemsSql = @"
                                INSERT INTO RequestItems (RequestID, BookID, Quantity, StatusID)
                                VALUES (@RequestID, @BookID, @Quantity, 
                                    (SELECT ID_Status FROM RequestItemStatuses WHERE StatusName = 'Ожидает'))";

                            foreach (var book in _selectedBooks)
                            {
                                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(insertItemsSql, conn, transaction))
                                {
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestID", requestId);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@BookID", book.IDBook);
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Quantity", book.Quantity);
                                    await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                                }
                            }

                            // 3. Создание уведомления для библиотекаря
                            string insertNotificationSql = @"
                                INSERT INTO RequestNotifications (RequestID, NotificationTypeID, Message, IsRead, CreatedDate)
                                VALUES (@RequestID, 
                                    (SELECT ID_Type FROM NotificationTypes WHERE TypeName = 'Новая заявка'),
                                    @Message, 0, GETDATE())";

                            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(insertNotificationSql, conn, transaction))
                            {
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@RequestID", requestId);
                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Message", $"Новая заявка №{generatedNumber}");
                                await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                            }

                            // Фиксируем транзакцию
                            transaction.Commit();

                            // Сообщаем об успехе
                            CustomMessageBox.Show($"Заявка №{generatedNumber} успешно создана!\n\nПосле обработки библиотекарем вы получите уведомление.",
                                "Успешно", CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);

                            // Очищаем форму
                            ClearForm();
                        }
                        catch
                        {
                            // В случае ошибки откатываем изменения
                            transaction.Rollback();
                            throw;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при создании заявки: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
            finally
            {
                // Разблокируем кнопку
                BtnSubmitRequest.IsEnabled = true;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Очистка формы после успешного создания заявки
        /// </summary>
        private void ClearForm()
        {
            TbLessonName.Clear();
            DpLessonDateSimple.SelectedDate = DateTime.Today;
            CbLessonPeriod.SelectedIndex = -1;
            CbGroup.SelectedIndex = -1;
            if (_selectedBooks != null)
                _selectedBooks.Clear();
            DgSelectedBooks.ItemsSource = null;
            UpdateTotalCount();
            LoadAvailableBooks();
        }

        #endregion
    }
}

﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Services;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Data;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using Diplom_Bibl.Controls;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Pages
{
    public partial class ReturnBooksPage : Page
    {
        private readonly string _connectionString = "Server=DMITRIJ;Database=DiplomBibl;Integrated Security=True;";
        private readonly BookIssuanceService _issuanceService;
        private ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceService.ReaderInfo> _readers;
        private ObservableCollection<object> _allIssuances;

        private BookIssuanceService.ReaderInfo _selectedReader;
        private bool _isPlaceholderActive = true;

        // Класс для отображения групповых выдач с деталями
        public class GroupIssuanceDisplayItem
        {
            public int GroupIssuanceId { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; }
            public string TeacherName { get; set; }
            public int TeacherId { get; set; }
            public string StudentName { get; set; }
            public int StudentId { get; set; }
            public string SubjectName { get; set; }
            public DateTime IssuanceDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime PlannedReturnDate { get; set; }
            public int TotalBooks { get; set; }
            public int ReturnedBooks { get; set; }
            public int RemainingBooks => TotalBooks - ReturnedBooks;
            public string Status { get; set; }
            public ObservableCollection<GroupBookGroup> BookGroups { get; set; }

            public bool IsOverdue => DateTime.Now > PlannedReturnDate && Status == "Выдана";

            public SolidColorBrush OverdueColor => IsOverdue ?
                new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#DC3545")) :
                new SolidColorBrush((Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString("#28A745"));

            public string DisplayName => $"👥 Группа {GroupCode}";
            public string TeacherInfo => $"Преподаватель: {TeacherName}";
            public string StudentInfo => $"Студент: {StudentName}";
            public string SubInfo => $"Всего книг: {TotalBooks}, возвращено: {ReturnedBooks}";
            public bool ReturnButtonVisible => RemainingBooks > 0;
            public bool ReturnAllButtonVisible => RemainingBooks > 0;
        }

        public class GroupBookItem
        {
            public int ItemId { get; set; }
            public int IDBook { get; set; }
            public string BookTitle { get; set; }
            public string AuthorName { get; set; }
            public string InventaryNumber { get; set; }
            public int Quantity { get; set; }
            public int ReturnedQuantity { get; set; }
            public int RemainingQuantity => Quantity - ReturnedQuantity;
            public bool IsFullyReturned => RemainingQuantity == 0;
        }

        public class GroupBookGroup
        {
            public string BookTitle { get; set; }
            public string AuthorName { get; set; }
            public int TotalQuantity { get; set; }
            public int TotalReturned { get; set; }
            public int RemainingQuantity => TotalQuantity - TotalReturned;
            public List<GroupBookItem> Items { get; set; }
            public string DisplayName => $"{BookTitle} - {AuthorName}";
        }

        public ReturnBooksPage()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            _issuanceService = new BookIssuanceService(_connectionString);
            _readers = new ObservableCollection<BookIssuanceService.ReaderInfo>();
            _allIssuances = new ObservableCollection<object>();

            LoadReaders();
        }

        private void LoadReaders()
        {
            try
            {
                _readers = _issuanceService.GetReaders();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки читателей: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private async void LoadActiveIssuances(int readerId, string readerType)
        {
            try
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"=== ЗАГРУЗКА ВЫДАЧ для читателя ID={readerId}, тип={readerType} ===");

                _allIssuances.Clear();

                // Загружаем индивидуальные выдачи
                var activeIssuances = _issuanceService.GetReaderActiveIssuances(readerId);
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Загружено индивидуальных выдач: {activeIssuances.Count}");

                foreach (var item in activeIssuances)
                {
                    _allIssuances.Add(new
                    {
                        Type = "individual",
                        item.Id,
                        item.BookTitle,
                        item.InventaryNumber,
                        item.IssuanceDate,
                        item.PlannedReturnDate,
                        item.Status,
                        IsOverdue = item.IsOverdue,
                        OverdueColor = item.OverdueColor,
                        DisplayName = $"📚 {item.BookTitle}",
                        SubInfo = $"Инв. №: {item.InventaryNumber}",
                        ReturnButtonVisible = true,
                        ReturnAllButtonVisible = false,
                        BookGroups = (object)null
                    });
                }

                // Загружаем групповые выдачи, если это сотрудник/преподаватель
                if (readerType.ToLower().Contains("сотрудник") || readerType.ToLower().Contains("преподаватель"))
                {
                    await LoadGroupIssuancesForDisplay(readerId);
                }
                else
                {
                    System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Читатель не является сотрудником, групповые выдачи не загружаются");
                }

                Dispatcher.Invoke(() =>
                {
                    IssuancesList.ItemsSource = _allIssuances;
                    BooksSection.Visibility = _allIssuances.Any() ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                    NoBooksText.Visibility = _allIssuances.Any() ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки выдач: {ex.Message}");
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка загрузки выдач: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadGroupIssuancesForDisplay(int teacherId)
        {
            try
            {
                string sql = @"
                    SELECT 
                        gi.GroupIssuanceId,
                        g.GroupCode,
                        gi.SubjectName,
                        gi.IssuanceDate,
                        gi.PlannedReturnDate,
                        gi.Status,
                        t.ReaderID AS TeacherId,
                        t.LastName + ' ' + t.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(t.MiddleName, '') AS TeacherName,
                        s.ReaderID AS StudentId,
                        s.LastName + ' ' + s.FirstName + ' ' + ISNULL(s.MiddleName, '') AS StudentName
                    FROM GroupBookIssuance gi
                    INNER JOIN Groups g ON gi.GroupId = g.GroupID
                    INNER JOIN ReaderForm t ON gi.TeacherId = t.ReaderID
                    LEFT JOIN ReaderForm s ON gi.StudentId = s.ReaderID
                    WHERE gi.Status = 'Выдана' 
                      AND gi.TeacherId = @TeacherId
                    ORDER BY gi.PlannedReturnDate";

                var groupIssuances = new List<GroupIssuanceDisplayItem>();

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@TeacherId", teacherId);

                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                var groupIssuance = new GroupIssuanceDisplayItem
                                {
                                    GroupIssuanceId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["GroupIssuanceId"]),
                                    GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    TeacherName = reader["TeacherName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    TeacherId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TeacherId"]),
                                    StudentName = reader["StudentName"]?.ToString() ?? "Не указан",
                                    StudentId = reader["StudentId"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToInt32(reader["StudentId"]) : 0,
                                    SubjectName = reader["SubjectName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    IssuanceDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["IssuanceDate"]),
                                    PlannedReturnDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["PlannedReturnDate"]),
                                    Status = reader["Status"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    BookGroups = new ObservableCollection<GroupBookGroup>()
                                };

                                groupIssuances.Add(groupIssuance);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Загружаем книги для каждой групповой выдачи
                foreach (var group in groupIssuances)
                {
                    await LoadGroupBooks(group);
                }

                // Добавляем в общую коллекцию
                foreach (var group in groupIssuances)
                {
                    _allIssuances.Add(new
                    {
                        Type = "group",
                        Id = group.GroupIssuanceId,
                        GroupCode = group.GroupCode,
                        TeacherName = group.TeacherName,
                        TeacherId = group.TeacherId,
                        StudentName = group.StudentName,
                        StudentId = group.StudentId,
                        SubjectName = group.SubjectName,
                        IssuanceDate = group.IssuanceDate,
                        PlannedReturnDate = group.PlannedReturnDate,
                        Status = group.Status,
                        TotalBooks = group.TotalBooks,
                        ReturnedBooks = group.ReturnedBooks,
                        RemainingBooks = group.RemainingBooks,
                        IsOverdue = group.IsOverdue,
                        OverdueColor = group.OverdueColor,
                        BookGroups = group.BookGroups,
                        DisplayName = group.DisplayName,
                        TeacherInfo = group.TeacherInfo,
                        StudentInfo = group.StudentInfo,
                        SubInfo = group.SubInfo,
                        ReturnButtonVisible = group.ReturnButtonVisible,
                        ReturnAllButtonVisible = group.ReturnAllButtonVisible
                    });
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки групповых выдач: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadGroupBooks(GroupIssuanceDisplayItem group)
        {
            try
            {
                string sql = @"
                    SELECT 
                        b.TitleBook,
                        ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                        SUM(git.Quantity) AS TotalQuantity,
                        SUM(git.ReturnedQuantity) AS TotalReturned
                    FROM GroupIssuanceItems git
                    INNER JOIN Books b ON git.BookId = b.IDBook
                    LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                    WHERE git.GroupIssuanceId = @GroupIssuanceId
                    GROUP BY b.TitleBook, a.SurnameAuthor, a.NameAuthor, a.PatronymicAuthor";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupIssuanceId", group.GroupIssuanceId);

                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                var bookGroup = new GroupBookGroup
                                {
                                    BookTitle = reader["TitleBook"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    AuthorName = reader["AuthorName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                    TotalQuantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalQuantity"]),
                                    TotalReturned = Convert.ToInt32(reader["TotalReturned"]),
                                    Items = new List<GroupBookItem>()
                                };

                                group.BookGroups.Add(bookGroup);
                                group.TotalBooks += bookGroup.TotalQuantity;
                                group.ReturnedBooks += bookGroup.TotalReturned;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Загружаем отдельные экземпляры для возврата
                await LoadGroupBookItems(group);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки книг: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task LoadGroupBookItems(GroupIssuanceDisplayItem group)
        {
            try
            {
                string sql = @"
                    SELECT 
                        git.ItemId,
                        b.IDBook,
                        b.InventaryNumber,
                        git.Quantity,
                        git.ReturnedQuantity,
                        b.TitleBook
                    FROM GroupIssuanceItems git
                    INNER JOIN Books b ON git.BookId = b.IDBook
                    WHERE git.GroupIssuanceId = @GroupIssuanceId";

                using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                {
                    await conn.OpenAsync();
                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                    {
                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupIssuanceId", group.GroupIssuanceId);

                        using (var reader = await cmd.ExecuteReaderAsync())
                        {
                            while (await reader.ReadAsync())
                            {
                                string bookTitle = reader["TitleBook"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                                var bookGroup = group.BookGroups.FirstOrDefault(g => g.BookTitle == bookTitle);

                                if (bookGroup != null)
                                {
                                    bookGroup.Items.Add(new GroupBookItem
                                    {
                                        ItemId = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ItemId"]),
                                        IDBook = Convert.ToInt32(reader["IDBook"]),
                                        BookTitle = bookTitle,
                                        InventaryNumber = reader["InventaryNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                        Quantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["Quantity"]),
                                        ReturnedQuantity = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ReturnedQuantity"])
                                    });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"Ошибка загрузки экземпляров: {ex.Message}");
            }
        }

        private void ReaderSearchBox_GotFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_isPlaceholderActive && ReaderSearchBox.Text == "Введите фамилию, имя или номер билета...")
            {
                ReaderSearchBox.Text = "";
                ReaderSearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
                _isPlaceholderActive = false;
            }
        }

        private void ReaderSearchBox_LostFocus(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ReaderSearchBox.Text))
            {
                ReaderSearchBox.Text = "Введите фамилию, имя или номер билета...";
                ReaderSearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
                _isPlaceholderActive = true;
                ReadersListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }
        }

        private void ReaderSearchBox_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (ReadersListBox == null) return;

            string search = ReaderSearchBox.Text.Trim();
            if (_isPlaceholderActive || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(search))
            {
                ReadersListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
                return;
            }

            var filtered = _readers.Where(r =>
                r.LastName.ToLower().Contains(search.ToLower()) ||
                r.FirstName.ToLower().Contains(search.ToLower()) ||
                r.CardNumber.ToLower().Contains(search.ToLower())).Take(10).ToList();

            if (filtered.Any())
            {
                ReadersListBox.ItemsSource = filtered;
                ReadersListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            }
            else
            {
                ReadersListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            }
        }

        private void ReadersListBox_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (ReadersListBox?.SelectedItem is BookIssuanceService.ReaderInfo selected)
            {
                SelectReader(selected);
            }
        }

        private void SelectReader(BookIssuanceService.ReaderInfo reader)
        {
            _selectedReader = reader;
            ReaderSearchBox.Text = reader.DisplayInfo;
            ReaderSearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Black;
            ReadersListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

            ReaderFullNameText.Text = reader.FullName;
            ReaderCardNumberText.Text = reader.CardNumber;
            ReaderTypeText.Text = reader.TypeName;
            ReaderInfoSection.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;

            LoadActiveIssuances(reader.ReaderID, reader.TypeName);
        }

        private void ClearReaderButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            _selectedReader = null;
            ReaderSearchBox.Text = "Введите фамилию, имя или номер билета...";
            ReaderSearchBox.Foreground = Brushes.Gray;
            _isPlaceholderActive = true;
            ReadersListBox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            ReaderInfoSection.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            BooksSection.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            _allIssuances.Clear();
        }

        private void ReturnIndividualBook(int issuanceId)
        {
            try
            {
                var result = CustomMessageBox.Show(
                    "Вернуть книгу?",
                    "Подтверждение возврата",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo,
                    CustomMessageBoxImage.Question);

                if (result == CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes)
                {
                    _issuanceService.ReturnBook("individual", issuanceId);

                    CustomMessageBox.Show("Книга успешно возвращена!", "Успех",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);

                    if (_selectedReader != null)
                    {
                        LoadActiveIssuances(_selectedReader.ReaderID, _selectedReader.TypeName);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при возврате книги: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private async void ReturnGroupBooks(int groupIssuanceId, ObservableCollection<GroupBookGroup> bookGroups, bool returnAll = false)
        {
            try
            {
                if (returnAll)
                {
                    int totalRemaining = bookGroups.Sum(g => g.RemainingQuantity);
                    var result = CustomMessageBox.Show(
                        $"Вернуть все оставшиеся книги ({totalRemaining} шт.)?",
                        "Подтверждение возврата всех книг",
                        CustomMessageBoxButton.YesNo,
                        CustomMessageBoxImage.Question);

                    if (result != CustomMessageBoxResult.Yes) return;

                    using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                    {
                        await conn.OpenAsync();
                        using (var transaction = conn.BeginTransaction())
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                foreach (var bookGroup in bookGroups.Where(g => g.RemainingQuantity > 0))
                                {
                                    foreach (var book in bookGroup.Items.Where(i => i.RemainingQuantity > 0))
                                    {
                                        string updateBooksSql = @"
                                            UPDATE Books 
                                            SET 
                                                CopiesInUse = CopiesInUse - @Quantity,
                                                AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies + @Quantity,
                                                StatusBook = CASE WHEN AvailableCopies + @Quantity > 0 THEN 1 ELSE StatusBook END
                                            WHERE IDBook = @IDBook";

                                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(updateBooksSql, conn, transaction))
                                        {
                                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@IDBook", book.IDBook);
                                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@Quantity", book.RemainingQuantity);
                                            await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                                        }

                                        string updateItemsSql = @"
                                            UPDATE GroupIssuanceItems 
                                            SET ReturnedQuantity = Quantity
                                            WHERE ItemId = @ItemId";

                                        using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(updateItemsSql, conn, transaction))
                                        {
                                            cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ItemId", book.ItemId);
                                            await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                string updateStatusSql = @"
                                    UPDATE GroupBookIssuance 
                                    SET ReturnDate = GETDATE(), Status = 'Возвращена'
                                    WHERE GroupIssuanceId = @GroupIssuanceId";

                                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(updateStatusSql, conn, transaction))
                                {
                                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupIssuanceId", groupIssuanceId);
                                    await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                                }

                                transaction.Commit();

                                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Все книги успешно возвращены!", "Успех",
                                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);
                            }
                            catch
                            {
                                transaction.Rollback();
                                throw;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    await ShowPartialReturnDialog(groupIssuanceId, bookGroups);
                }

                if (_selectedReader != null)
                {
                    LoadActiveIssuances(_selectedReader.ReaderID, _selectedReader.TypeName);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при возврате групповых книг: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private async System.Threading.Tasks.Task ShowPartialReturnDialog(int groupIssuanceId, ObservableCollection<GroupBookGroup> bookGroups)
        {
            try
            {
                var dialog = new Window
                {
                    Title = "Возврат книг группы",
                    Width = 500,
                    Height = 400,
                    WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner,
                    Owner = Window.GetWindow(this)
                };

                var panel = new StackPanel { Margin = new Thickness(20) };

                panel.Children.Add(new TextBlock
                {
                    Text = "Выберите книги для возврата:",
                    FontSize = 14,
                    FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold,
                    Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 15)
                });

                var listBox = new ListBox
                {
                    Height = 250,
                    SelectionMode = SelectionMode.Multiple,
                    Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 0, 15)
                };

                foreach (var bookGroup in bookGroups.Where(g => g.RemainingQuantity > 0))
                {
                    foreach (var book in bookGroup.Items.Where(i => i.RemainingQuantity > 0))
                    {
                        var checkBox = new CheckBox
                        {
                            Content = $"{bookGroup.BookTitle} (Инв. №: {book.InventaryNumber})",
                            Tag = book,
                            Margin = new Thickness(5)
                        };
                        listBox.Items.Add(checkBox);
                    }
                }

                panel.Children.Add(listBox);

                var buttonPanel = new StackPanel
                {
                    Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal,
                    HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right
                };

                var returnButton = new Button
                {
                    Content = "Возврат",
                    Width = 100,
                    Height = 35,
                    Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 10, 0),
                    Style = (Style)Application.Current.Resources["SaveButtonStyle"]
                };

                var cancelButton = new Button
                {
                    Content = "Отмена",
                    Width = 100,
                    Height = 35,
                    Style = (Style)Application.Current.Resources["PrimaryButtonStyle"],
                    Background = (SolidColorBrush)Application.Current.Resources["LightGray"],
                    Foreground = (SolidColorBrush)Application.Current.Resources["TextColor"]
                };

                returnButton.Click += async (s, args) =>
                {
                    try
                    {
                        int returnedCount = 0;
                        using (var conn = new SqlConnection(_connectionString))
                        {
                            await conn.OpenAsync();
                            using (var transaction = conn.BeginTransaction())
                            {
                                try
                                {
                                    foreach (CheckBox checkBox in listBox.Items)
                                    {
                                        if (checkBox.IsChecked == true && checkBox.Tag is GroupBookItem book)
                                        {
                                            string updateBooksSql = @"
                                                UPDATE Books 
                                                SET 
                                                    CopiesInUse = CopiesInUse - 1,
                                                    AvailableCopies = AvailableCopies + 1,
                                                    StatusBook = 1
                                                WHERE IDBook = @IDBook";

                                            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(updateBooksSql, conn, transaction))
                                            {
                                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@IDBook", book.IDBook);
                                                await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                                            }

                                            string updateItemsSql = @"
                                                UPDATE GroupIssuanceItems 
                                                SET ReturnedQuantity = ReturnedQuantity + 1
                                                WHERE ItemId = @ItemId";

                                            using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(updateItemsSql, conn, transaction))
                                            {
                                                cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ItemId", book.ItemId);
                                                await cmd.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                                            }

                                            returnedCount++;
                                        }
                                    }

                                    string checkSql = @"
                                        SELECT COUNT(*) 
                                        FROM GroupIssuanceItems 
                                        WHERE GroupIssuanceId = @GroupIssuanceId 
                                          AND Quantity > ReturnedQuantity";

                                    using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(checkSql, conn, transaction))
                                    {
                                        cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupIssuanceId", groupIssuanceId);
                                        int remaining = (int)await cmd.ExecuteScalarAsync();

                                        if (remaining == 0)
                                        {
                                            string updateStatusSql = @"
                                                UPDATE GroupBookIssuance 
                                                SET ReturnDate = GETDATE(), Status = 'Возвращена'
                                                WHERE GroupIssuanceId = @GroupIssuanceId";

                                            using (var cmd2 = new SqlCommand(updateStatusSql, conn, transaction))
                                            {
                                                cmd2.Parameters.AddWithValue("@GroupIssuanceId", groupIssuanceId);
                                                await cmd2.ExecuteNonQueryAsync();
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }

                                    transaction.Commit();
                                }
                                catch
                                {
                                    transaction.Rollback();
                                    throw;
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        CustomMessageBox.Show($"Возвращено книг: {returnedCount}", "Успех",
                            CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Information);

                        dialog.Close();

                        if (_selectedReader != null)
                        {
                            LoadActiveIssuances(_selectedReader.ReaderID, _selectedReader.TypeName);
                        }
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при возврате: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                            CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
                    }
                };

                cancelButton.Click += (s, args) => dialog.Close();

                buttonPanel.Children.Add(returnButton);
                buttonPanel.Children.Add(cancelButton);
                panel.Children.Add(buttonPanel);

                dialog.Content = panel;
                dialog.ShowDialog();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                CustomMessageBox.Show($"Ошибка при открытии диалога возврата: {ex.Message}", "Ошибка",
                    CustomMessageBoxButton.OK, CustomMessageBoxImage.Error);
            }
        }

        private void ReturnButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            var button = sender as Button;
            var context = button?.DataContext;

            if (context == null) return;

            var type = context.GetType();
            var typeName = type.GetProperty("Type")?.GetValue(context)?.ToString();

            if (typeName == "individual")
            {
                var id = (int)type.GetProperty("Id")?.GetValue(context);
                ReturnIndividualBook(id);
            }
            else if (typeName == "group")
            {
                var id = (int)type.GetProperty("Id")?.GetValue(context);
                var bookGroups = type.GetProperty("BookGroups")?.GetValue(context) as ObservableCollection<GroupBookGroup>;
                if (bookGroups != null)
                {
                    ReturnGroupBooks(id, bookGroups, false);
                }
            }
        }

        private void ReturnAllButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            var button = sender as Button;
            var context = button?.DataContext;

            if (context == null) return;

            var type = context.GetType();
            var typeName = type.GetProperty("Type")?.GetValue(context)?.ToString();

            if (typeName == "group")
            {
                var id = (int)type.GetProperty("Id")?.GetValue(context);
                var bookGroups = type.GetProperty("BookGroups")?.GetValue(context) as ObservableCollection<GroupBookGroup>;
                if (bookGroups != null)
                {
                    ReturnGroupBooks(id, bookGroups, true);
                }
            }
        }

        private void Page_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            LoadReaders();
        }
    }

    public class GroupTypeVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            return (value is string typeName && typeName == "group")
                ? Visibility.Visible
                : Visibility.Collapsed;
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }

﻿using Diplom_Bibl.Helpers;
using iTextSharp.text;
using iTextSharp.text.pdf;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Data.SqlClient;
using System.IO;

namespace Diplom_Bibl.Services
{
    public static class ReaderCardPdfService
    {
        static string conn_str = DatabaseHelper.ConnectionString;

        // Модель истории выдачи
        private class IssuanceHistoryItem
        {
            public DateTime IssuanceDate { get; set; }
            public string InventaryNumber { get; set; }
            public string BookTitle { get; set; }
            public string AuthorName { get; set; }
            public DateTime PlannedReturnDate { get; set; }
            public DateTime? ReturnDate { get; set; }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Генерирует читательский билет в формате PDF по ID читателя
        /// </summary>
        public static byte[] GenerateReaderCardPdf(int readerId)
        {
            try
            {
                var reader = LoadReaderData(readerId);
                if (reader == null) throw new ArgumentException("Читатель не найден.");

                var history = LoadIssuanceHistory(readerId);

                using (var ms = new MemoryStream())
                {
                    Document document = new Document(PageSize.A4, 30, 30, 30, 30);
                    PdfWriter writer = PdfWriter.GetInstance(document, ms);
                    document.Open();

                    BaseFont baseFont;
                    try
                    {
                        baseFont = BaseFont.CreateFont(@"C:\Windows\Fonts\times.ttf", BaseFont.IDENTITY_H, BaseFont.EMBEDDED);
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        baseFont = BaseFont.CreateFont(BaseFont.HELVETICA, BaseFont.CP1250, BaseFont.NOT_EMBEDDED);
                    }

                    Font fontNormal = new Font(baseFont, 10);
                    Font fontBold = new Font(baseFont, 10, Font.BOLD);
                    Font fontHeader = new Font(baseFont, 14, Font.BOLD);
                    Font fontSmall = new Font(baseFont, 8);
                    Font fontTitle = new Font(baseFont, 16, Font.BOLD);

                    // Определяем тип читателя (студент или сотрудник/преподаватель)
                    bool isStudent = reader.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("студент") ?? false;

                    if (isStudent)
                    {
                        GenerateStudentCard(document, reader, history, fontNormal, fontBold, fontHeader, fontSmall, fontTitle);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        GenerateEmployeeCard(document, reader, history, fontNormal, fontBold, fontHeader, fontSmall, fontTitle);
                    }

                    document.Close();
                    return ms.ToArray();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                throw new Exception($"Ошибка генерации читательского билета: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Генерирует два экземпляра читательского билета
        /// </summary>
        public static byte[] GenerateReaderCardPdfTwoCopies(int readerId)
        {
            try
            {
                var reader = LoadReaderData(readerId);
                if (reader == null) throw new ArgumentException("Читатель не найден.");

                var history = LoadIssuanceHistory(readerId);

                using (var ms = new MemoryStream())
                {
                    Document document = new Document(PageSize.A4, 30, 30, 30, 30);
                    PdfWriter writer = PdfWriter.GetInstance(document, ms);
                    document.Open();

                    BaseFont baseFont;
                    try
                    {
                        baseFont = BaseFont.CreateFont(@"C:\Windows\Fonts\times.ttf", BaseFont.IDENTITY_H, BaseFont.EMBEDDED);
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        baseFont = BaseFont.CreateFont(BaseFont.HELVETICA, BaseFont.CP1250, BaseFont.NOT_EMBEDDED);
                    }

                    Font fontNormal = new Font(baseFont, 10);
                    Font fontBold = new Font(baseFont, 10, Font.BOLD);
                    Font fontHeader = new Font(baseFont, 14, Font.BOLD);
                    Font fontSmall = new Font(baseFont, 8);
                    Font fontTitle = new Font(baseFont, 16, Font.BOLD);

                    bool isStudent = reader.TypeName?.ToLower().Contains("студент") ?? false;

                    // Первая копия
                    if (isStudent)
                        GenerateStudentCard(document, reader, history, fontNormal, fontBold, fontHeader, fontSmall, fontTitle);
                    else
                        GenerateEmployeeCard(document, reader, history, fontNormal, fontBold, fontHeader, fontSmall, fontTitle);

                    document.NewPage();

                    // Вторая копия
                    if (isStudent)
                        GenerateStudentCard(document, reader, history, fontNormal, fontBold, fontHeader, fontSmall, fontTitle);
                    else
                        GenerateEmployeeCard(document, reader, history, fontNormal, fontBold, fontHeader, fontSmall, fontTitle);

                    document.Close();
                    return ms.ToArray();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                throw new Exception($"Ошибка генерации читательского билета: {ex.Message}", ex);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Генерация читательского билета для СТУДЕНТА
        /// </summary>
        private static void GenerateStudentCard(Document document, ReaderData reader, List<IssuanceHistoryItem> history,
            Font fontNormal, Font fontBold, Font fontHeader, Font fontSmall, Font fontTitle)
        {
            // Создаем таблицу для двух колонок
            PdfPTable mainTable = new PdfPTable(2);
            mainTable.WidthPercentage = 100;
            mainTable.SetWidths(new float[] { 35f, 65f });
            mainTable.SpacingBefore = 10;
            mainTable.SpacingAfter = 10;

            // ======= ЛЕВАЯ КОЛОНКА (Заметки библиотекаря) =======
            PdfPCell leftCell = new PdfPCell();
            leftCell.Border = Rectangle.NO_BORDER;
            leftCell.VerticalAlignment = Element.ALIGN_TOP;
            leftCell.PaddingRight = 10;

            Paragraph leftNotesTitle = new Paragraph("Заметки библиотекаря", fontBold);
            leftNotesTitle.Alignment = Element.ALIGN_CENTER;
            leftCell.AddElement(leftNotesTitle);
            leftCell.AddElement(new Paragraph(" "));

            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++)
            {
                Paragraph line = new Paragraph("__________________________________________", fontSmall);
                line.Alignment = Element.ALIGN_LEFT;
                leftCell.AddElement(line);
                leftCell.AddElement(new Paragraph(" "));
            }

            mainTable.AddCell(leftCell);

            // ======= ПРАВАЯ КОЛОНКА (Данные читателя + история) =======
            PdfPCell rightCell = new PdfPCell();
            rightCell.Border = Rectangle.NO_BORDER;
            rightCell.VerticalAlignment = Element.ALIGN_TOP;
            rightCell.PaddingLeft = 10;

            // Заголовок
            Paragraph title = new Paragraph("ФОРМУЛЯР ЧИТАТЕЛЯ", fontTitle);
            title.Alignment = Element.ALIGN_CENTER;
            rightCell.AddElement(title);
            rightCell.AddElement(new Paragraph(" "));

            // Номер билета
            Paragraph numberParagraph = new Paragraph($"№ {reader.CardNumber}", fontBold);
            numberParagraph.Alignment = Element.ALIGN_CENTER;
            rightCell.AddElement(numberParagraph);
            rightCell.AddElement(new Paragraph(" "));

            // Данные читателя
            AddStudentFieldToCell(rightCell, "Фамилия", reader.LastName, fontBold, fontNormal);
            AddStudentFieldToCell(rightCell, "Имя", reader.FirstName, fontBold, fontNormal);
            AddStudentFieldToCell(rightCell, "Отчество", reader.MiddleName ?? "", fontBold, fontNormal);
            AddStudentFieldToCell(rightCell, "Специальность", reader.Speciality ?? "", fontBold, fontNormal);
            AddStudentFieldToCell(rightCell, "Группа", reader.GroupCode ?? "", fontBold, fontNormal);
            AddStudentFieldToCell(rightCell, "Телефон", reader.PhoneNumber ?? "", fontBold, fontNormal);
            AddStudentAddressToCell(rightCell, "Домашний адрес (по прописке)", reader.HomeAddress ?? "_____________________________", fontBold, fontNormal);
            AddStudentFieldToCell(rightCell, "Состоит читателем библиотеки с", reader.MembershipStartDate.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy"), fontBold, fontNormal);
            AddStudentSignatureToCell(rightCell, "Правила обязуюсь выполнять", "_________________________", fontBold, fontNormal);

            rightCell.AddElement(new Paragraph(" "));
            rightCell.AddElement(new Paragraph(" "));

            // Таблица истории выдач
            Paragraph historyTitle = new Paragraph("История выдачи книг", fontBold);
            historyTitle.Alignment = Element.ALIGN_CENTER;
            rightCell.AddElement(historyTitle);
            rightCell.AddElement(new Paragraph(" "));

            PdfPTable historyTable = new PdfPTable(5);
            historyTable.WidthPercentage = 100;
            historyTable.SetWidths(new float[] { 10f, 15f, 40f, 15f, 20f });

            // Заголовки таблицы
            AddTableHeader(historyTable, "Дата выдачи", fontBold);
            AddTableHeader(historyTable, "Инв. №", fontBold);
            AddTableHeader(historyTable, "Автор и заглавие книги", fontBold);
            AddTableHeader(historyTable, "Роспись читателя", fontBold);
            AddTableHeader(historyTable, "Отметка о возвращении", fontBold);

            // Данные истории (последние 10 выдач)
            int rowCount = 0;
            foreach (var item in history)
            {
                if (rowCount++ >= 15) break;
                AddTableCell(historyTable, item.IssuanceDate.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy"), fontNormal);
                AddTableCell(historyTable, item.InventaryNumber, fontNormal);
                AddTableCell(historyTable, $"{item.AuthorName} — {item.BookTitle}", fontNormal);
                AddTableCell(historyTable, "", fontNormal);
                AddTableCell(historyTable, item.ReturnDate?.ToString("dd.MM.yyyy") ?? "", fontNormal);
            }

            // Заполняем пустые строки до 15
            for (int i = rowCount; i < 15; i++)
            {
                AddTableCell(historyTable, "", fontNormal);
                AddTableCell(historyTable, "", fontNormal);
                AddTableCell(historyTable, "", fontNormal);
                AddTableCell(historyTable, "", fontNormal);
                AddTableCell(historyTable, "", fontNormal);
            }

            rightCell.AddElement(historyTable);
            mainTable.AddCell(rightCell);
            document.Add(mainTable);
        }

        private static void AddStudentFieldToCell(PdfPCell cell, string label, string value, Font fontBold, Font fontNormal)
        {
            Paragraph p = new Paragraph();
            p.Add(new Chunk($"{label}: ", fontBold));
            p.Add(new Chunk(value, fontNormal));
            cell.AddElement(p);
        }

        private static void AddStudentAddressToCell(PdfPCell cell, string label, string value, Font fontBold, Font fontNormal)
        {
            Paragraph labelPara = new Paragraph(label, fontBold);
            cell.AddElement(labelPara);
            Paragraph valuePara = new Paragraph(value, fontNormal);
            valuePara.IndentationLeft = 10;
            cell.AddElement(valuePara);
        }

        private static void AddStudentSignatureToCell(PdfPCell cell, string label, string signature, Font fontBold, Font fontNormal)
        {
            Paragraph p = new Paragraph();
            p.Add(new Chunk($"{label} ", fontBold));
            p.Add(new Chunk(signature, fontNormal));
            cell.AddElement(p);
        }

        private static void AddEmployeeFieldToCell(PdfPCell cell, string label, string value, Font fontBold, Font fontNormal)
        {
            Paragraph p = new Paragraph();
            p.Add(new Chunk($"{label} ", fontBold));
            p.Add(new Chunk(value, fontNormal));

        {

        private static void AddTableHeader(PdfPTable table, string text, Font font)
        {
            PdfPCell cell = new PdfPCell(new Phrase(text, font));
            cell.BackgroundColor = new BaseColor(230, 230, 230);
            cell.HorizontalAlignment = Element.ALIGN_CENTER;
            cell.Padding = 5;
            table.AddCell(cell);
        }

        private static void AddTableCell(PdfPTable table, string text, Font font)
        {
            PdfPCell cell = new PdfPCell(new Phrase(text, font));
            cell.Padding = 4;
            table.AddCell(cell);
        }

        // ==================== ЗАГРУЗКА ДАННЫХ ИЗ БД ====================

        private static ReaderData LoadReaderData(int readerId)
        {
            const string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    r.ReaderID, r.CardNumber, r.LastName, r.FirstName, r.MiddleName,
                    r.TypeID, rt.TypeName,
                    r.GroupID, g.GroupCode,
                    r.Post, p.Post_Name,
                    r.Speciality, r.PhoneNumber, r.HomeAddress,
                    r.MembershipStartDate, r.FormFillDate
                FROM ReaderForm r
                LEFT JOIN ReaderType rt ON r.TypeID = rt.TypeID
                LEFT JOIN Groups g ON r.GroupID = g.GroupID
                LEFT JOIN Post p ON r.Post = p.ID_Post
                WHERE r.ReaderID = @ReaderId";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(conn_str))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", readerId);
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        if (reader.Read())
                        {
                            return new ReaderData
                            {
                                ReaderID = Convert.ToInt32(reader["ReaderID"]),
                                CardNumber = reader["CardNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                LastName = reader["LastName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                FirstName = reader["FirstName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                MiddleName = reader["MiddleName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                TypeName = reader["TypeName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                GroupCode = reader["GroupCode"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                Speciality = reader["Speciality"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                PhoneNumber = reader["PhoneNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                HomeAddress = reader["HomeAddress"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                PostName = reader["Post_Name"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                MembershipStartDate = reader["MembershipStartDate"] != DBNull.Value
                                    ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["MembershipStartDate"])
                                    : DateTime.Now
                            };
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return null;
        }

        private static List<IssuanceHistoryItem> LoadIssuanceHistory(int readerId)
        {
            var history = new List<IssuanceHistoryItem>();

            const string sql = @"
                SELECT 
                    i.IssuanceDate,
                    b.InventaryNumber,
                    b.TitleBook,
                    ISNULL(a.SurnameAuthor + ' ' + a.NameAuthor + ' ' + a.PatronymicAuthor, '') AS AuthorName,
                    i.PlannedReturnDate,
                    i.ReturnDate
                FROM BookIssuance i
                INNER JOIN Books b ON i.BookId = b.IDBook
                LEFT JOIN Authors a ON b.Author = a.ID_Autor
                WHERE i.ReaderId = @ReaderId
                ORDER BY i.IssuanceDate DESC";

            using (var conn = new SqlConnection(conn_str))
            {
                conn.Open();
                using (var cmd = new SqlCommand(sql, conn))
                {
                    cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@ReaderId", readerId);
                    using (var reader = cmd.ExecuteReader())
                    {
                        while (reader.Read())
                        {
                            history.Add(new IssuanceHistoryItem
                            {
                                IssuanceDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["IssuanceDate"]),
                                InventaryNumber = reader["InventaryNumber"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                BookTitle = reader["TitleBook"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                AuthorName = reader["AuthorName"]?.ToString() ?? "",
                                PlannedReturnDate = Convert.ToDateTime(reader["PlannedReturnDate"]),
                                ReturnDate = reader["ReturnDate"] != DBNull.Value ? Convert.ToDateTime(reader["ReturnDate"]) : (DateTime?)null
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            return history;
        }

        private class ReaderData
        {
            public int ReaderID { get; set; }
            public string CardNumber { get; set; }
            public string LastName { get; set; }
            public string FirstName { get; set; }
            public string MiddleName { get; set; }
            public string TypeName { get; set; }
            public string GroupCode { get; set; }
            public string Speciality { get; set; }
            public string PhoneNumber { get; set; }
            public string HomeAddress { get; set; }
            public string PostName { get; set; }
            public DateTime MembershipStartDate { get; set; }
        }
    }

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;

namespace Diplom_Bibl
{
    // Добавьте этот класс в файл ReportViewWindow.xaml.cs или в отдельный файл
    public class ReportRow
    {
        public int IdRecord { get; set; }
        // Используем Nullable DateTime
        public DateTime? DateRecord { get; set; } // Теперь может быть null
        public int DeliveryBook { get; set; }
        public int DeliveryCertificate { get; set; }
        public int EventsCount { get; set; }
        public bool IsSummary { get; set; } = false;

        // Конструктор для обычной записи
        public ReportRow(int id, DateTime date, int books, int refs, int events)
        {
            IdRecord = id;
            DateRecord = date; // Присваиваем как есть
            DeliveryBook = books;
            DeliveryCertificate = refs;
            EventsCount = events;
            IsSummary = false;
        }

        // Конструктор для строки итога
        public ReportRow(int totalBooks, int totalRefs, int totalEvents)
        {
            IdRecord = -1;
            DateRecord = null; // Явно присваиваем null
            DeliveryBook = totalBooks;
            DeliveryCertificate = totalRefs;
            EventsCount = totalEvents;
            IsSummary = true;
        }
    }
}
